# ADR-013: Baggage-driven activity enricher for `Kun.Observability`

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/ADR-013-Kun.Observability-enricher.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/ADR-013-Kun.Observability-enricher.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

**Status**: Accepted
**Date**: 2026-04-24
**Author**: claude-kun (Kun framework specialist)
**Extends**: [ADR-004](/sdk/kun/architecture/adr-004-kun-observability-module.md) — _Kun.Observability module decision_
**Supersedes**: none

**Context**: `KunActivitySources` pre-registers the four framework
sources (`Kun.Mediator`, `Kun.EventBus.Outbox`, `Kun.Grpc`,
`Kun.Saga`). Spans from those sources reach the Aspire / Jaeger UI
correctly, but carry no `tenant.id` / `user.id` tags. Operators
filtering by tenant or correlating spans to application logs end up
doing the join by hand every time. The information _exists_ —
`ITenantContext` knows the tenant, `ICurrentUser` knows the user, the
Outbox envelope carries a `message_id` — but there's no wired path
from those sources to span tags.

***

## Decision

Read enrichment values from OpenTelemetry **baggage** rather than
from scoped DI services, and mirror a whitelisted set of baggage
keys onto span tags at `Activity` start time via a
`BaseProcessor<Activity>` registered into the `TracerProviderBuilder`.

Consumer code that has tenant/user/outbox info pushes the values into
baggage once (usually at the request entry point — `Kun.Gateway`
already does this for the S2S JWT tenant claim via an
`IEndpointFilter`), and the baggage rides the ambient
`AsyncLocal<>`-backed context across HTTP / gRPC / async hops,
reaching every downstream Activity without additional wiring.

### Hook point: `OnEnd`, not `OnStart`

The mirror happens in `BaseProcessor<Activity>.OnEnd`, not
`OnStart`. Rationale — `OnStart` runs the instant `Activity.Start()`
is called, which is _before_ consumer code inside the activity
body has a chance to call `SetBaggage` on it. `OnEnd` runs just
before the activity leaves the pipeline toward exporters and sees
every baggage entry that was set at any point in the activity's
lifespan. This handles both idiomatic cases cleanly:

1. Baggage set at request boundary → child activity inherits it →
   `OnEnd` mirrors it to tags.
2. Baggage set mid-activity (less common but legal) → `OnEnd` still
   sees the final baggage state and mirrors it.

Exporters receive the tagged activity on the same pipeline pass
because `OnEnd` precedes the exporter call in OTel's processor
chain.

### Why baggage and not scoped DI

The intuitive design — "processor constructor takes
`IServiceProvider`, resolves `ITenantContext` on each `OnStart`" —
breaks for three reasons:

1. `BaseProcessor<Activity>` instances are singletons in the OTel
   pipeline. Resolving scoped services from the root provider
   throws at runtime.
2. Even with `IServiceScopeFactory`, the processor has no way to
   know _which_ scope to resolve against. The activity being
   started may have been queued by a background service whose scope
   closed before the activity reaches the exporter.
3. Background contexts (Saga executor, Outbox publisher, timers)
   either have no DI scope or have a different scope than the
   originating request. Trying to thread the "right" scope through
   every activity-emitting code path is exactly the hand-stitching
   this ADR is meant to eliminate.

Baggage sidesteps all three. It is the W3C-standard async-propagated
context slot. `Activity.Current?.Baggage` is always accessible, no
DI needed, no lifetime confusion.

### Canonical baggage keys

```csharp
public static class KunBaggageKeys
{
    public const string TenantId         = "tenant.id";
    public const string UserId           = "user.id";
    public const string OutboxMessageId  = "outbox.message_id";
}
```

Names follow OpenTelemetry semconv naming (`namespace.attribute`).
Other baggage keys present on the activity are **ignored** — the
processor copies only the whitelisted set. Consumers that want
additional tags add them at the code site that already has the
value; they do not register a new enricher.

### Default posture: opt-in

New flag `KunObservabilityOptions.EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage`,
**default `false`**. Two reasons for opt-in:

- Adds a processor to the tracing pipeline and thus a few
  nanoseconds per span. Negligible in practice but we keep
  observability features additive and measurable.
- Baggage can carry values a downstream operator did not expect to
  see exported (e.g., sensitive PII a consumer service pushed in a
  custom key). Although this processor copies only the whitelisted
  keys, explicit opt-in forces callers to think about the baggage
  contract their service is producing.

Downstream services enable the flag in their
`builder.Services.AddKunObservability(o => o.EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage = true)`
call.

### Processor scope

The processor operates only on activities whose `ActivitySource.Name`
is in `KunActivitySources.All` — framework-owned spans. ASP.NET Core
/ HttpClient / EF Core instrumentation spans are handled by their
respective built-in enrichers and should not be touched by this one.

### AOT safety

`BaseProcessor<Activity>` is an abstract class with no generic
constraints; extending it is AOT-safe. `Activity.Baggage` returns a
non-generic `IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string?>>` which
materialises via the BCL without reflection. No `MakeGenericType`,
no `Expression` trees. The existing
`<IsAotCandidate>true</IsAotCandidate>` on `Kun.Observability` stays
unchanged.

### What it is **not**

- **Not a log-record enricher.** `OpenTelemetry.Logs.LogRecord` has a
  separate `AttributeEnricher` surface — that's F1.
- **Not a metric-dimension enricher.** Most Kun metrics are counters
  without labels today; adding dimensions is premature. F-out.
- **Not a replacement for explicit, code-site tagging.** Handlers
  that know they just processed a specific resource (`order.id`,
  `saga.instance_id`) should still call
  `Activity.Current?.SetTag("order.id", id)` at the site — baggage
  is for cross-cutting dimensions, not per-entity identifiers.

***

## Alternatives considered

### Capture `IServiceScopeFactory` and resolve per-activity

Rejected — see §Why baggage and not scoped DI above. The scope
uncertainty makes this design incorrect for background-issued
activities.

### `ActivityListener` registered globally

Equivalent capability but `ActivityListener` is less structured than
a `BaseProcessor` and cannot participate cleanly in the
`TracerProviderBuilder` lifecycle; two callbacks (`ActivityStarted`,
`ActivityStopped`) duplicate the `BaseProcessor` model without
benefit. Chose `BaseProcessor<Activity>` for consistency with the
rest of the OTel SDK wiring.

### Force every framework component to call `Activity.SetTag`

Rejected. That's exactly the "Mediator behaviour / Outbox publisher /
Saga executor / Grpc interceptor all know how to tag tenant_id"
hand-stitching we're replacing. Any future activity-emitting site
would have to remember the incantation.

### Full `IKunActivityEnricher` pluggable interface + registry

Considered as a larger surface. Rejected for this ADR's scope — the
built-in baggage-to-tags mapper covers the known need; adding a
pluggable enricher abstraction should wait until a concrete second
implementation appears. YAGNI, revisit if consumer service demands a
custom enricher that can't be expressed as "push this value into
baggage".

***

## Follow-ups

- **F1 — Resolved 2026-04-24 (KN-SELF-006)**: Log-record enricher
  that mirrors the same baggage keys onto `LogRecord.Attributes`.
  See §F1 resolution below.
- **F2**: Expose baggage-tagging demo in `Kun.Sample.AppHost`
  Aspire dashboard when the samples move beyond placeholder.
- **F3**: If a concrete consumer need surfaces for a non-baggage
  enrichment source (e.g., reading from a distributed cache or an
  S2S JWT without baggage plumbing), promote to a pluggable
  `IKunActivityEnricher` abstraction. Until then, this ADR is the
  complete surface.

***

## Impact on existing code

Purely additive. `AddKunObservability` gains one optional flag
(default off). `Kun.Observability.csproj` takes no new
`PackageReference`. Existing Aspire / OTLP pipelines remain
unchanged for consumers that do not flip the opt-in flag.

***

## §F1 resolution (2026-04-24, KN-SELF-006) — log-record enricher

Span enrichment alone still forces operators to join spans ↔ logs
by hand (e.g. `tenant.id` filter works in the Aspire trace UI but
not in its log tab). KN-SELF-006 closes the loop by shipping a
companion `KunBaggageLogRecordProcessor` that mirrors the same
whitelisted baggage subset onto `LogRecord.Attributes`.

### Shape, in one paragraph

Internal `BaseProcessor<LogRecord>` hooked at `OnEnd`. Reads
`Activity.Current?.Baggage` (logs, unlike activities, do **not**
auto-carry baggage; baggage lives on the ambient
`Activity.Current` instead). For each key in `KunBaggageKeys.All`
that is present on baggage, **add** it as a `LogRecord` attribute
if the attribute is not already there. Never overwrite a
consumer-set attribute: the log statement's own `tenant.id=…`
call wins.

### Why `OnEnd`, not `OnStart`

Same reason as the span enricher (see §Hook point above) — the
ambient state we care about is finalised at `OnEnd`, not when the
log call first enters the processor chain.

### Why "add if missing" instead of "overwrite"

A `LogRecord` that already carries `tenant.id` either came from
(a) a consumer-written log statement that deliberately set a
per-entity tenant for that record, or (b) an earlier instrumentation
pipeline. In both cases overwriting would surprise the author of
the log call. The enricher defers to the explicit set.

### Opt-in flag

New `KunObservabilityOptions.EnrichLogsFromBaggage` (default
`false`). Mirrors the posture of `EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage` —
explicit flip forces consumers to think about what baggage contract
their service produces.

### Tests

`tests/Kun.Observability.Tests/LogBaggageEnrichmentTests.cs`
covers: baggage-present → attribute mirrored; flag off → no mirror;
log-statement already set the key → kept; no `Activity.Current` →
no crash, no attrs added.

### AOT safety

`BaseProcessor<LogRecord>` + `Activity.Baggage` enumeration + the
LogRecord attribute API are all reflection-free. `Kun.Observability`
keeps `IsAotCandidate=true`; ILC pass stays 0-warning.

# ADR-014: Result-returning validation pipeline behavior

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/ADR-014-Validation-Result-behavior.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/ADR-014-Validation-Result-behavior.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

**Status**: Accepted
**Date**: 2026-04-24
**Author**: claude-kun (Kun framework specialist)
**Extends**: [ADR-011](/sdk/kun/architecture/adr-011-result-async-extensions.md) — consumer
of the `Result<T>` composition surface.
**Supersedes**: none

**Context**: `src/Kun.Validation/Behaviors/ValidationPipelineBehavior.cs`
is the **exception-throwing** validator pipeline behavior: any
validator error turns into `ValidationException`. That matches how
validators in most .NET codebases have historically worked, but it
conflicts with the Kun-wide rule in `kun/CLAUDE.md`
§Architectural constraints:

> Business failures use `Result` / `Result<T>`, not exceptions.

Handlers that return `Result<T>` still have to sit behind a
try/catch for `ValidationException` at every call site, or trust
ASP.NET / gRPC middleware to translate the exception — both of
which mask the failure at the handler-composition layer ADR-011
tried to make ergonomic.

The throwing behavior's own XML doc already called this out:

> For Result-based semantics (returning
> `Result.Fail(Error.Validation(...))` instead of throwing), compose
> this behavior inside a user-written "ValidationResultAdapter"
> behavior — shipped as a follow-up.

KN-SELF-007 is that follow-up.

***

## Decision

Ship a second pipeline behavior,
`ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TValue>`, that runs the
validators in the same loop the throwing variant uses but on
aggregated errors **returns** `Result<TValue>.Fail(Error.Validation(
"request.invalid", …))` instead of throwing. Handlers downstream
never see an exception for business-validation failures.

### Scope — `Result<TValue>` only

Only the generic `Result<TValue>` variant ships in this task. The
non-generic `Result` variant (for commands with no return value) is
deliberately out of scope:

- Most Kun handlers return a value. The dominant pattern is
  `IRequest<Result<OrderDto>>`, not `IRequest<Result>`.
- Adding the non-generic variant doubles the DI-registration
  surface (one helper per constrained TResponse).
- Void-returning commands keep working with the throwing
  `ValidationPipelineBehavior`; the exception-path cost is
  acceptable for a small minority.

Tracked as **F1** below.

### DI registration — explicit, per request type

A behavior constrained as
`IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, Result<TValue>> where TRequest :
IRequest<Result<TValue>>` cannot be registered as an open-generic
against the full `IPipelineBehavior<,>` surface — the DI container
would try to close it for every `(TRequest, TResponse)` pair and
hit a runtime type-system failure for non-Result responses.

Instead, consumers register per request type:

```csharp
services.AddKunMediator(mediator =>
{
    mediator
        .AddValidator<CreateOrderCommand, CreateOrderValidator>()
        .AddValidationResultBehavior<CreateOrderCommand, OrderDto>();
});
```

This mirrors the existing
`AddValidator<TRequest, TValidator>()` pattern — explicit,
greppable, AOT-safe.

### Coexistence with the throwing variant

Consumers pick one or the other **per request type**. Registering
both behaviors for the same `TRequest` would result in
non-deterministic order-dependent behavior (first one in the pipeline
wins; the second runs on the already-converted result). We do not
ship a runtime diagnostic for this misconfiguration because:

- Detecting it cleanly would require enumerating all registered
  pipeline behaviors at Mediator build time — not currently a public
  hook.
- The misconfiguration is rare and loud once it occurs (double-wrapped
  validation messages stand out).

Doc guardrail only — `src/Kun.Validation/AGENTS.md` gets a "Result vs
exception" subsection pointing at this ADR.

### Error shape

Aggregated `ValidationError.Message` strings are joined with `"; "`
into the `Error.Message`. `Error.Code` is the constant
`"request.invalid"`. Consumers who need structured error payloads
(per-field error dicts) can post-process the returned `Result` via
ADR-011 `.Match` / `.Bind` — the framework does not ship a second
`Error` shape per validator, because the dominant consumer behavior
(gRPC 400, HTTP 400 JSON body) is already served.

### AOT safety

- No reflection. `typeof(Result<TValue>)` is compile-time-known per
  closed generic.
- `Error.Validation` and `Result<TValue>.Fail` are pure BCL — no
  source-generator dependency.
- The validator loop is the same shape the throwing variant uses
  and has been AOT-green since Kun.Validation shipped as
  `IsAotCandidate=true`.

***

## Alternatives considered

### One behavior that catches `ValidationException` and converts

Catch the existing exception and translate to `Result.Fail`. Works
without requiring a separate behavior but keeps the
throw-and-catch overhead (allocating the exception, building its
stack trace). Rejected — defeats the performance argument for using
`Result` and hides the conversion from code review.

### Open-generic DI registration with a runtime type check

Register `IPipelineBehavior<,>` → `ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<,>`
and have the behavior short-circuit when `TResponse` isn't
`Result<T>`. Rejected — type-system constraints at the registration
level are cleaner than behavior-body runtime checks, and consumer
code composing the pipeline would silently skip validation for any
misregistered closure.

### Modify the existing throwing behavior in place

Change the current `ValidationPipelineBehavior` to return `Result`
when the response type matches, throw otherwise. Rejected — silent
behavioural change to an already-shipped extension surface; would
require a CHANGELOG breaking note and a migration guide. Much
safer to ship a sibling behavior.

### Provide a source generator that emits a registration per handler

Scan the assembly for `IRequestHandler<*, Result<*>>` and register
the right behavior closure. Rejected for this ADR — source
generators are deferred Kun-wide per `docs/roadmap.md` §环境与流程类
until M5 post-review. The explicit `AddValidationResultBehavior`
extension is the short-term surface; an SG can wrap it later.

***

## Follow-ups

- **F1**: Non-generic `Result` variant —
  `ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<TRequest>` for
  `IRequest<Result>`. **Resolved 2026-04-24 (KN-SELF-012)** —
  shipped as a sibling class in the same file as the generic
  variant, registered via the single-type-param overload
  `AddValidationResultBehavior<TRequest>()` on `KunMediatorBuilder`.
  The "doubled registration surface" concern from §Scope
  (`Result<TValue>` only) turned out to be a single DI-extension
  overload; the per-request-type explicit-registration pattern
  was already the dominant surface, so the incremental cost
  was small.
- **F2**: Structured error payload (`Error.Validation` subtype
  carrying a per-field error dict). Defer until consumers have a
  concrete need past the joined-message default.
- **F3**: Convenience extension that registers the behavior for
  every `IRequestHandler<*, Result<*>>` discovered in an assembly.
  Requires source generator — see Alternatives §Modify-existing.

***

## Impact on existing code

Purely additive. The existing throwing
`ValidationPipelineBehavior` is untouched. Consumers not opting in
see no change. `Kun.Validation.csproj` gains no new
`PackageReference`.

# ADR-015: Outbox pattern design for `Kun.EventBus`

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/ADR-015-Outbox-pattern.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/ADR-015-Outbox-pattern.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

**Status**: Accepted (retroactive)
**Date**: 2026-04-24
**Author**: claude-kun (Kun framework specialist)
**Extends**: `docs/architecture/why-outbox.md` (primer)
**Supersedes**: none

**Context**: Integration events fan out to downstream services over
RabbitMQ. A naive implementation publishes during the write-side
handler — which either (a) publishes before commit (downstream sees
an event for a state that never existed if the transaction rolls
back), or (b) publishes after commit (downstream never sees an
event if the app crashes between `SaveChanges` and `Publish`). The
Outbox pattern closes both failure modes by persisting a message
row _inside_ the write transaction and publishing asynchronously.

Kun ships the pattern end-to-end, but the rollout predates the ADR
index. `kun/CLAUDE.md` §Outbox has the normative rules; this ADR
walks through the design so new contributors can reason about the
type surface without reverse-engineering it.

***

## Decision

### Type surface

All abstractions live in `Kun.EventBus`; the persistence half
lives in `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`. Two modules because:

1. `Kun.EventBus` must stay AOT-candidate and take no EF Core
   dependency — the publisher loop and the consumer idempotency
   machinery do not need EF Core.
2. `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` is the one place we accept non-AOT
   trade-offs (ADR-004 trail), and atomic enqueue+save _has_ to
   run inside `DbContext.SaveChangesAsync`.

| Namespace / type | Role |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Kun.EventBus.Outbox.OutboxMessage` | Persisted row: `Id`, `EventTypeId`, `Payload`, `Status`, `TraceParent`, `TraceState`, retry counters. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Outbox.OutboxStatus` | `Pending` / `Published` / `Failed`. Enum. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Outbox.IIntegrationEventOutbox` | Consumer-facing append API: `EnqueueAsync(IIntegrationEvent, CancellationToken)`. Called from handler code. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Outbox.IOutboxWriter` | Low-level write primitive — used by the EF Core accumulator and by any hand-rolled `IIntegrationEventOutbox` implementation. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.IOutboxMessageStore` | Read / update store the publisher pump talks to (`ReadPendingBatchAsync`, `MarkPublishedAsync`, `MarkFailedAsync`). |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.IOutboxLockProvider` | Distributed lease so multiple pods don't double-publish. `TryAcquireAsync(lockName, ttl, ct)` returns `IAsyncDisposable?`; `null` means another instance holds it. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.OutboxPublisherBackgroundService` | Hosted service running the read → lock → publish → mark loop. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.OutboxPublisherOptions` | Batch size, poll interval, lease TTL, failure backoff. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.NullOutboxLockProvider` | Explicit single-pod opt-in only — never the production default. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.RedisOutboxLockProvider` | Multi-pod production default — SET NX + EX. |
| `Kun.EventBus.Background.Internal.ProcessedMessageStore` | Consumer-side "seen before?" cache backing `IdempotentConsumerDecorator<T>` (ADR-003 trail). |
| `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.IntegrationEventOutboxAccumulator` | Collects aggregate-produced `IIntegrationEvent`s during `SaveChangesAsync` and writes `OutboxMessage` rows in the same transaction. |
| `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.OutboxMessageConfiguration` | `IEntityTypeConfiguration<OutboxMessage>` — table name, column types, partial index on `Status = Pending` + `CreatedAt` ordering. |

### Atomicity boundary

The contract is: **Outbox enqueue + aggregate save commit together
or neither.** Enforced by
`IntegrationEventOutboxAccumulator.AccumulateBeforeSave` hooked into
`KunDbContext.SaveChangesAsync`:

1. `ChangeTracker.Entries<IAggregateRoot>()` gives all tracked
   aggregates.
2. For each, drain `DomainEvents` → convert to `IIntegrationEvent`
   via the domain-event handler chain → materialise as
   `OutboxMessage` rows on the same `DbContext`.
3. `ClearDomainEvents()` on every aggregate so replay doesn't
   double-enqueue.
4. The single `SaveChangesAsync` call writes both aggregate changes
   and outbox rows in one EF Core transaction.

There is **no** "open transaction, publish, commit, close" dance.
The publish is asynchronous and happens in a separate process
(background service), decoupled from the write-side transaction
by the persisted outbox row.

### Publisher pump

`OutboxPublisherBackgroundService` runs in every hosting process
with the EventBus registered. On each tick:

S1-KUN-002（2026-10-09）修订：默认 `EfOutboxMessageStore` 在 PostgreSQL 事务里以 `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` 领取 Pending 且已到重试时间的消息，持有行锁直到本批次状态提交。broker 发布使用 confirms + mandatory；失败将指数退避时间保存至 `NextAttemptAt`，达到上限保持 Failed 供运维重放。

自定义非事务存储须显式配置分布式锁；Null 锁仅供明确单实例场景。数据库提交与 broker 确认不构成跨系统事务，确认后崩溃仍可能重放；消费者必须业务幂等。

### Consumer idempotency

Publishing is **at-least-once**. Consumers `IdempotentConsumerDecorator<T>`
wraps every `IIntegrationEventHandler<T>`; first run writes the
stable event ID into `IProcessedMessageStore` (Redis
`SETNX + EX` keyed on `{eventTypeId}:{eventId}`). Subsequent
deliveries short-circuit before the handler body. See ADR trail
for `Kun.EventBus.IntegrationEvent` idempotency; this ADR only
states the contract: **handlers must be safe to re-invoke** and
the framework will make the decorator path cheap for them.

### W3C trace propagation

`OutboxMessage.TraceParent` + `TraceState` capture
`Activity.Current?.Id` / `TraceStateString` at enqueue. The
publisher restores them on the outgoing envelope (`traceparent`
header) so the downstream consumer joins the original trace when
it starts its own activity via `ActivitySource.StartActivity` with
the parent id from the header.

**Note** — this is _trace context_ propagation (W3C Trace Context
spec), not _baggage_ propagation (ADR-013). Baggage is ambient
cross-cutting data (tenant / user / outbox-message-id)
deliberately mirrored onto spans and logs by the enricher; trace
context is _just the trace ID chain_. Kun keeps the two concepts
separate so that baggage can be audited / stripped at system
boundaries without affecting trace correlation.

### Stable event IDs — format and registry

All integration events are tagged with a stable string identifier
`"{bounded-context}.{name}.v{n}"` — e.g. `order.placed.v1`,
`billing.invoice.paid.v2`. Two non-negotiables:

- **Never** `Type.AssemblyQualifiedName`. Renaming a CLR type or
  moving it across assemblies breaks every persisted row. The
  stable ID is the wire contract.
- **Versioned suffix** (`v1`, `v2`, …) is bumped on breaking payload
  changes. Non-breaking additions (new optional property) keep
  the version.

`IEventTypeRegistry` resolves `eventTypeId ↔ CLR Type` at runtime.
Consumers register via `IEventTypeRegistrar` in their DI
composition root; missing registrations fail loudly on publisher
startup rather than silently at publish time.

***

## What Outbox does **not** do

- **Read-side projections / read models.** Those belong in CQRS
  Query handlers (`Kun.Dapper`). Outbox is the write-side egress.
- **Saga orchestration.** `Kun.Saga` ADR-S01 is the orchestrator;
  Saga steps use integration events for cross-service handoffs but
  the orchestration state lives in its own table.
- **Command routing.** Commands go through `Kun.Mediator`. Outbox
  carries _events_ only.
- **Snapshotting / rehydration.** Outbox is for _outgoing_
  messages. Inbound replay + aggregate rehydration is the read-
  side concern.

***

## Alternatives considered

### Direct publish inside the handler

Rejected — either breaks atomicity (publish before commit) or
loses messages (publish after commit + crash). See §Context.

### Change Data Capture (Debezium / Postgres logical replication)

Captures state changes, not semantic intents. You get _row
changed_ messages; the consumer then has to reverse-engineer
"what business event happened?" Kun's integration events carry
semantics (`OrderPlaced`, not `INSERT orders VALUES (…)`), so a
CDC approach would need a translator layer that introduces the
same complexity as Outbox without its atomicity advantages.
Revisit only if an explicit data-lake / audit replay need appears.

### Transactional outbox tables per-bounded-context

Each bounded context gets its own table. Considered, rejected —
no concrete benefit in the single-DB-per-service layout we run
today; one shared `__outbox_messages__` table with
`EventTypeId` prefixing the bounded context is simpler and the
partial-index-on-`Pending` query cost is identical. Revisit if a
service needs per-context publishing priorities.

### Kafka source + compacted topics as ledger

Moves the atomicity problem to the storage layer (Kafka-backed
state store). Operationally heavier than Postgres for the current
scale and mixes write-authority (DB) with event-authority (Kafka).
Deferred indefinitely.

***

## Impact on existing code

None — this ADR is retroactive. The types described are the
types that have been shipping since Phase-1 M2. Cross-links to
this ADR land as part of KN-SELF-011 AC-2.

## Follow-ups

- **F1**: Dead-letter handling — `Failed`-status rows above retry
  cap today sit in the table forever; needs a janitor job or a
  dedicated DLQ table. Tracked as backlog item.
- **F2**: Per-tenant batch priority — some tenants' events are
  time-sensitive (webhook SLAs). Weight-based batch selection
  sits outside the current `ReadPendingBatchAsync`.
- **F3**: Outbox-specific test helpers in
  `Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore` (ADR-012 §F1 referenced this
  as a companion module). \*\*Resolved 2026-04-24 (KN-SELF-014
  - KN-SELF-016)\*\* — shipped as a sibling module to
    `Kun.Testing` with `IsAotCandidate=false` (matches
    `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`). Public surface is
    `OutboxAssertions` with three helpers —
    `ShouldHaveOutboxMessage` / `ShouldHaveExactlyOneOutboxMessage` /
    `ShouldNotHaveOutboxMessage` — each offered as both an
    extension on `IEnumerable<OutboxMessage>` (for tests that
    pre-query a snapshot) and `DbContext` (for one-liner
    assertions after `SaveChangesAsync`). All helpers throw
    `KunAssertionException` with a mismatch message that includes
    the helper name, expected `EventTypeId`, observed match
    count, and the distinct `EventTypeId`s actually present.
    Tests cover every helper × overload × pass/fail path
    (11 tests; `UseInMemoryDatabase` for the `DbContext`
    overload fixture). See also
    [docs/guides/validating-commands.md](/sdk/kun/guides/validating-commands.md)
    for the validation-side sibling guide that KN-SELF-013
    shipped.

## 事件契约包拆分（S1-KUN-010，2026-10-14）

`IntegrationEventIdAttribute`、`IEventTypeRegistrar`（含源生成 `JsonTypeInfo<T>` 重载）与 `IEventTypeRegistry` 迁入 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`，保持 `Kun.EventBus` 命名空间。该包只依赖 `Kun.Core`，不带 Redis、broker、DI 或宿主实现。`Kun.EventBus` 依赖新包并为迁移类型保留类型转发，现有注册表和 Outbox 行为不变。

`IIntegrationEvent` 原本定义于 `Kun.Core.Domain`，仍保留唯一类型；新抽象包通过传递依赖与类型转发导出它。这样契约包只引用新包即可声明事件，同时保持 Core 的根层地位、旧消费者的类型身份与源/二进制兼容性。

# ADR-016 配置可靠性、权限端口与能力目录

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/ADR-016-platform-ports.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/ADR-016-platform-ports.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

状态：Accepted。日期：2026-10-09。执行依据：Qian 已接受的 ADR-006、ADR-007 与任务 S1-KUN-006；本文记录上游框架的落位，不引入新的权限模型。

## 决策

- 新增 `Kun.Authorization` 抽象包，仅定义主体、可解释判定、`IPermissionChecker`、`IDataPermissionFilter`、`IFieldPolicy`、命令静态权限声明与端点元数据，不提供 RBAC/ABAC 引擎或数据库实现。
- HTTP 经 `AddKunAuthorization()` 与 `RequireKunPermission()` 接入 ASP.NET Core 策略；Mediator 命令实现 `IPermissionProtectedRequest` 并装配 `AddPermissionBehavior`，漏装时 Mediator 构建即拒绝（2026.10.13 起）；gRPC 的四种调用形态读取 `[RequiresPermission]` 元数据。缺少引擎一律拒绝，判定先于 handler 与流首帧读取。身份认证由已有 Security/Identity 入口提供；平台策略与权限管理属于下游。
- `Kun.Mediator` 的 handler 注册可同时接收稳定能力 ID、请求和响应 `JsonTypeInfo`，经 `ICapabilityRegistry` 枚举 JSON Schema 2020-12。目录本身不等于调用授权；上层必须按权限与 scope 过滤后对外暴露。
- `AddKunOptions<T>` 在变更后重新创建和校验候选值，成功才替换当前值；拒绝时保留旧对象并增加 `kun.configuration.reload.rejected`，日志不写配置内容。关键配置维持 ValidateOnStart，可选配置可延后至首次读取。Schema 导出表达 JSON 形状；DataAnnotations 与自定义语义校验仍由 validator 执行。
- `Kun.Configuration.Apollo` 是独立 HTTP 配置源，支持 properties namespace 的有序叠加、长轮询、通知修订回传、AccessKey HMAC-SHA1、服务端故障转移与本地缓存。HMAC-SHA1 仅用于遵守 Apollo 既有协议，不用于新密码学设计。配置源不负责租户配置、secretRef 解析、发布审批或审计，这些由平台 Provider 负责。
- `KunExceptionHandler` 通过 `IProblemDetailsService` 输出，让宿主可以安装自定义错误写入器。它不再绕过宿主直接序列化 ProblemDetails。

## 依赖与兼容

`Kun.Authorization` 只依赖 `Kun.Core`；Mediator、ASP.NET Core 与 gRPC 向下依赖它。Apollo provider 仅依赖标准 Configuration/Logging 抽象，无平台依赖。两包均开启 AOT 分析并加入 CI 发布矩阵。

旧仓储接口仍有兼容实现，不能删掉后假装从未使用：以 `KUNLEGACY001` 标记废弃，保留 EF 与旧存储内部兼容代码；新下游代码以 Banned API 门禁拒绝旧入口。新存储包是 `Kun.Storage.Abstractions`，其中接口的实际全名为 `Kun.Storage.IFileStorage`；旧 `Kun.Storage` 包中的接口是 `Kun.Storage.Abstractions.IFileStorage`。

`AddKunDapper` / `AddKunDapperNpgsql` 新增 `Func<ReadDbOptions>` 重载，解决 init-only 属性无法在 Action 内赋值，同时保留原方法二进制签名。慢请求阈值使用 `PerformanceBehaviorOptions.ThresholdMs`，原构造器和 500ms 默认值不变。

## 验证与边界

配置测试覆盖非法值、类型绑定错误、拒绝指标、有效修订恢复、可选配置、Schema 实例验证。Apollo 测试通过替身 HTTP 协议覆盖签名、缓存、鉴权失败不回退、离线启动失败、快照校验、长轮询修订回传；这是协议集成验收，未声明已对接生产 Apollo。

权限测试覆盖缺失引擎、明确拒绝与允许，以及 HTTP/Mediator/gRPC 判定顺序；错误处理中测试宿主写入器真正接管响应。没有在框架中实现租户 RBAC、字段脱敏算法或行级 SQL 编译器。

# ADR: P2-D SaaS 多租户 3-策略架构

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

**Status**: Part 1 Accepted (2026-04-23) · Part 2 Accepted (2026-04-23) · Part 3 Accepted (2026-04-23)
**Phase**: 2 （白皮书 §12.2 乘风破浪）
**Scope**: `Kun.Core.MultiTenancy` + `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy`（未来）
**Supersedes**: 无（增量于 P0-3 schema-per-service、P1-4 `TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor`、既有 `ITenantContext`）

***

## Context

白皮书 §12.2 承诺 v1.5 提供 **SaaS 多租户完整方案（共享库 / 独立 Schema / 独立库 三种隔离策略）**。当前 (2026-04-23 `develop`) 已有的多租户基础件是：

| 组件 | 位置 | 用途 |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ITenantContext` | `src/Kun.Core/MultiTenancy/ITenantContext.cs` | 抽象，返回 `TenantId` / `IsMultiTenant` |
| `NullTenantContext` | 同上 | 非多租户宿主或后台任务 |
| `JwtTenantContext`（非本 ADR 范围） | `Kun.Security` | HTTP/gRPC 请求时从 S2S JWT claim 抽 |
| `IMultiTenant` 全局过滤器 | `KunDbContext.OnModelCreating` | 对 `IMultiTenant` 实体自动追加 `e.TenantId == ctx.TenantId` 过滤 |
| `TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor` | `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/Interceptors/` | 每笔事务开启时 `SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @t, true)`，用 Postgres RLS 做 defence-in-depth |
| `AddKunTenantRls()` 扩展 | `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/DependencyInjection/KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` | 消费者显式开启 RLS 拦截器 |

**现实情况**：上面的组合 = **Shared 策略（所有租户同库同 schema，用 `TenantId` 列 + RLS 双层防御）**。它已落地并通过 Sprint 1 集成测试。

Phase 2 要补的是两条**真正的新策略**：

- **Schema-per-tenant**：同库不同 schema，每个 tenant 有独立 schema；
- **Database-per-tenant**：每 tenant 独立连接字符串与独立数据库实例。

两者都需要新的运行时基础件：DbContext 实例化工厂、模型缓存键、迁移调度、连接解析。

***

## Decision

### D1. Shared 策略 = 现有 `AddKunTenantRls` + `IMultiTenant` 全局过滤器（不新加包装 API）

**不引入** `AddKunMultiTenancy(Strategy=Shared)` 之类的包装扩展来"统一入口"。现有 `AddKunTenantRls()` 已经是惯用、已公开 API；再套一层 strategy-flag 会让消费者在两个完全等价的入口之间选择。这是 YAGNI 原则 —— 多策略 API 只有在 2+ 策略同时落地时才有实际价值。

Part 2（SchemaPerTenant）落地时再评估是否需要新增 `AddKunMultiTenancy(Strategy=…)` 作为 "multi-entry dispatcher"；届时 Shared 路径可以委托到现有 `AddKunTenantRls` 而不破坏任何现有 consumer。

### D2. `TenantIsolationStrategy` 枚举 NOW 落地（forward-looking 类型）

即使当前只有 Shared 可用，`Kun.Core.MultiTenancy.TenantIsolationStrategy { Shared, SchemaPerTenant, DatabasePerTenant }` 枚举在 Part 1 就落地。理由：

- 消费者选型文档需要这个稳定的词汇表（`docs/guides/saas-multitenancy.md` 的决策树）；
- 未来 `ITenantProvisioner` / `ITenantDbContextFactory` 签名会引用它；
- 枚举是零运行成本的前瞻 API，不会增加维护负担。

Part 2 / Part 3 未交付前，`SchemaPerTenant` / `DatabasePerTenant` 值有"定义但未实现"的语义。文档显式声明。

### D3. DbContext 实例化模型（按策略分叉）

| 策略 | DbContext 作用域 | 模型缓存键 |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Shared | Scoped（现状，EF Core 默认） | 默认 `IModelCacheKeyFactory`（按 Type 键） |
| SchemaPerTenant（Part 2） | Scoped + **需要 `ITenantDbContextFactory<TContext>`** 在 scope 起始时用当前 `ITenantContext.TenantId` 构建正确的 `MigrationsHistoryTable.Schema` 与 `DefaultSchema` | **必须**提供自定义 `IModelCacheKeyFactory`，把 `TenantId` 并入缓存键，否则第二个租户复用第一个租户的模型 → schema 错位 |
| DatabasePerTenant（Part 3） | Scoped + `IDbConnectionResolver` 在 `OnConfiguring` 时用 `ITenantContext.TenantId` 解析连接字符串 | 默认 `IModelCacheKeyFactory` 即可（模型结构相同，只换连接） |

### D4. 迁移调度模型（按策略分叉）

| 策略 | 迁移触发时机 | 谁来发起 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Shared | App 启动时 `context.Database.MigrateAsync()`（或部署流水线手工） | 宿主 |
| SchemaPerTenant | **租户开户时**通过 `ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync(new TenantInfo(tenantId))` 触发；实现内部切到该租户 schema 做迁移 | `ITenantProvisioner` 实现 |
| DatabasePerTenant | **租户开户时**通过 `ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync` 触发；实现先创建数据库/连接、再运行迁移 | `ITenantProvisioner` 实现 |

App-start 批量迁移对 Schema/DatabasePerTenant **不适用**（启动时可能尚未注册所有租户，或租户是运行时动态创建）。

### D5. 租户生命周期接口 `ITenantProvisioner`

Part 1 定义契约：

```csharp
public interface ITenantProvisioner
{
    Task ProvisionAsync(TenantInfo tenant, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task DeprovisionAsync(string tenantId, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
```

- **幂等性约定**：`ProvisionAsync` 重复调用必须无副作用（用 `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS` / `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS` 语义）。
- **Null 实现默认**：`NullTenantProvisioner` 两个方法都返回 `Task.CompletedTask`，让 Shared 策略的消费者不用写空实现。
- **Part 2 / Part 3 才提供非空实现**：`SchemaPerTenantProvisioner` / `DatabasePerTenantProvisioner`。

### D6. DI 生命周期规则

| 组件 | 生命周期 | 原因 |
| -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `ITenantContext` | Scoped | 按请求/消息绑定（现状） |
| `ITenantProvisioner` | Singleton | 无状态，仅依赖配置与日志 |
| `ITenantDbContextFactory<TContext>` (Part 2) | Scoped | 依赖 scoped `ITenantContext` |
| `IDbConnectionResolver` (Part 3) | Singleton（或 Scoped，取决于实现是否需要 scoped 依赖） | 默认 Singleton |

***

## Alternatives Considered

### A1. "为 Shared 加一个 `AddKunMultiTenancy(Strategy=Shared)` 包装入口，与 Part 2/3 对齐"

**拒绝**：YAGNI。现有 `AddKunTenantRls` 已经是稳定 API，加包装只会让消费者选择困扰。Part 2 / Part 3 要上线时 `AddKunMultiTenancy` 才有 2+ 策略可选，那时再评估。

### A2. "用特性/反射自动发现 `ITenantProvisioner` 实现"

**拒绝**：违反本仓库 `CLAUDE.md` 的 AOT-first 原则；显式 DI 注册与强约定足够清晰。

### A3. "SchemaPerTenant 通过动态 `SET search_path` 替代 `DefaultSchema`"

**拒绝（推迟到 Part 2 再讨论）**：`search_path` 切换的事务语义与 RLS + PgBouncer 交互复杂，需要 Part 2 集成测试验证；此时先在 ADR 记录为 open question。

### A4. "Database-per-tenant 在单一 `DbContext` 实例内通过 `Database.SetConnectionString` 运行时切换"

**拒绝（推迟到 Part 3 再讨论）**：EF Core 对运行时切连接的模型缓存语义不稳定；更可能的路径是 `ITenantDbContextFactory` 每次从池里按 tenant 取一个已绑定连接的实例。

***

## Consequences

### Positive

- Shared 策略消费者零破坏：现有 `AddKunTenantRls` 签名与行为不变。
- Part 1 完全无运行时耦合：4 个新类型都是纯契约，`Kun.Core` 的零第三方依赖约束保持。
- Part 2 / Part 3 的实现者有稳定的目标契约（`TenantIsolationStrategy` 枚举 + `ITenantProvisioner` 接口）。

### Negative

- `TenantIsolationStrategy.SchemaPerTenant` / `.DatabasePerTenant` 在 Part 2 / Part 3 前属于"定义但未实现"的值。消费者若提前用会在未来策略 dispatcher 里拿到 `NotSupportedException`。Part 2 落地时这个语义会被解除。
- `ITenantProvisioner` 的生命周期钩子（开户/注销）与业务域的 tenant onboarding 流程是解耦的；消费者需要自己把这两个调用接到业务流里，框架不做自动编排。

### Neutral

- 现有 `NullTenantContext` 与新增 `NullTenantProvisioner` 的"null 对象模式"是仓库的既有风格延伸，不是新约定。

***

## Deferred to Part 2 (SchemaPerTenant)

- `ITenantDbContextFactory<TContext>` 接口定义与实现；
- 自定义 `IModelCacheKeyFactory` 把 `TenantId` 并入缓存键；
- `SchemaPerTenantProvisioner`：`CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "{tenantId}"` + 在该 schema 下跑 EF migrations；
- `KunDbContext` 的 `OnConfiguring` 重载，读取 scoped `ITenantContext.TenantId` → 调 `UseKunSchema`；
- PgBouncer transaction-pool 兼容性集成测试（schema 切换跨连接的副作用）。

## Deferred to Part 3 (DatabasePerTenant)

- `IDbConnectionResolver` 抽象 + 基于 `IOptionsMonitor<TenantsConnectionOptions>` 的内置实现；
- `DatabasePerTenantProvisioner`：创建数据库 + 跑 migrations + 可选 bootstrap seeding；
- 跨租户 admin 查询的反模式文档（建议走单独的 `AdminDbContext`，显式枚举所有连接）；
- 多区域部署下租户连接发现的运维模式（可选，与 Phase 3 多区域话题挂钩）。

***

## Follow-ups

1. Part 2 kickoff 单独起 ralplan（`SchemaPerTenant` 的模型缓存键与迁移时序是需要 consensus 的决策）。
2. Part 3 kickoff 之前先与运维对齐 secrets 管理（每租户一条连接字符串意味着 secret scale 线性增长）。
3. 当 Part 2 或 Part 3 任一交付时，在 `docs/roadmap-p2.md` P2-D 章节更新状态，并回补 `docs/guides/saas-multitenancy.md` 的决策树。

# ADR-S02: Introduce `Kun.Sandbox` Module — E2B-compatible sandbox abstraction for Kun consumers

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/architecture/ADR-S02-Kun.Sandbox-module.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/architecture/ADR-S02-Kun.Sandbox-module.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

**Status**: Accepted
**Date**: 2026-04-23
**Author**: claude-kun (Kun framework specialist)
**Related specs**:

- `NeuroAgent_Sandbox_Spec_v1.1.md` §2 / §4 / §14 (E2B-compatible surface)
- `ADR-S01-E2B-compatible-API.md` (Supervisor REST API adopts E2B v2 shape)

***

## 1. Context

NeuroAgent is building a self-hosted Sandbox Supervisor that exposes an
E2B-compatible REST API (see ADR-S01). The _Python_ harness
(`neuroagent-python`) will drive that Supervisor through an E2B-style
SDK. But sandbox usage is not a Python-only concern: the **C# business
services** in `neuroagent-csharp` have first-class "run this code / run
this command / produce these files" scenarios that today are pushed up
to the Python harness even when the business logic lives in .NET:

- **Platform: data preprocessing** — ingest + transform uploaded CSV/XLSX
  into normalised parquet/JSON before handing to analysts.
- **Edge: document render** — run `weasyprint` / `pandoc` to convert
  reports generated by C# business logic.
- **Platform: lightweight one-off scripts** — tenant-supplied validation
  rules or transform functions that must execute in isolation.
- **Notification: chart render** — headless Chromium to turn a
  dashboard snapshot into a PNG attached to an email.

These flows currently have three bad options:

1. **Round-trip through the Python harness** — the C# service calls the
   Python agent service just to borrow a sandbox. Extra hop, extra auth
   surface, harness tooling is agent-centric not service-centric.
2. **Each .NET service reinvents a Supervisor HTTP client** — drift,
   duplicated auth / retry / tracing logic, each service has to learn
   the E2B v2 schema from scratch.
3. **Run code directly in the service process** — unacceptable: no
   isolation, no egress control, no tenant-scoped audit.

The framework layer is the correct place to unify this. Kun already
owns other horizontal infrastructures consumers rely on
(`Kun.EventBus`, `Kun.Storage`, `Kun.Identity`, …); sandbox execution
is the same category: an abstraction with pluggable backends and a
stable surface.

At the same time, ADR-S01 established **E2B v2 as the canonical REST
shape** for the Supervisor. The .NET abstraction should mirror that
shape exactly so that (a) the code reads the same as the Python SDK,
(b) future migration to E2B Cloud is equally cheap for .NET consumers,
and (c) nothing in `Kun.Sandbox` becomes a competing abstraction
relative to the Supervisor spec.

## 2. Problem

Provide a .NET-idiomatic sandbox abstraction that:

1. Lets any C# service in `neuroagent-csharp` (or a future Kun consumer)
   create sandboxes, run processes, read/write files, and kill
   sandboxes — without knowing whether the backend is a local stub, the
   self-hosted Supervisor, or E2B Cloud.
2. Aligns the interface contract 1-to-1 with the E2B v2 API shape
   (endpoints, fields, camelCase JSON), so consumers who already learned
   the Python SDK can read .NET call sites unchanged.
3. Preserves Kun's AOT / zero-reflection posture — callable from
   `Kun.Gateway`, `Kun.AspNetCore`, or any AOT-strict service.
4. Does **not** ship a runtime. The runtime lives in
   `neuroagent-python/sandbox_supervisor` (Python, per Spec v1.1 §14).
   `Kun.Sandbox` is abstraction + client.

## 3. Decision Drivers

- **D1 — consumer parity**: C# services must have the same sandbox
  ergonomics the Python harness already enjoys. Today they don't.
- **D2 — no drift from the Supervisor spec**: every divergence between
  the .NET contract and the Supervisor REST contract is a future bug.
- **D3 — E2B Cloud path preserved**: if Mode D (ADR-S01 §14.4) is ever
  adopted, .NET consumers should migrate by flipping a registration
  line, not by rewriting call sites.
- **D4 — AOT strict**: .NET services in this repo publish AOT.
  Sandbox client code must not introduce runtime reflection.
- **D5 — testability**: unit tests for business code that calls a
  sandbox must not require Docker; an in-memory provider must exist.

## 4. Options Considered

### Option 1 — No Kun module; each C# service writes its own Supervisor client

**Rejected.** Directly violates D1 / D2. Guarantees drift. Every
consumer re-learns the E2B schema.

### Option 2 — Kun hosts the _runtime_ (port the Python Supervisor into .NET)

**Rejected.** The Supervisor runtime is deliberately owned by
`neuroagent-python` because it manages Docker / gVisor / Envoy /
Browser CDP proxying — all concerns where the Python ecosystem is
stronger and the team's existing ops playbook is already invested.
Re-implementing in .NET gives no consumer value, doubles the operational
surface, and violates Spec v1.1 §14 "Supervisor is Python".

### Option 3 — Kun ships a thin abstraction + client, backends are pluggable (✅ selected)

**Selected.** `Kun.Sandbox` contains:

- **Abstractions** — `ISandboxProvider`, `ISandboxHandle`, `IProcesses`,
  `IFiles`, and request/response records whose fields mirror the E2B v2
  REST shape one-to-one (camelCase at the JSON boundary, .NET-idiomatic
  PascalCase in code via `JsonPropertyName` on records).
- **Implementations** (pluggable):
  - `InMemorySandboxProvider` — fake for unit tests; no Docker, no network.
  - `SupervisorSandboxProvider` — HTTP client against
    `/v2/sandboxes/*` on the NeuroAgent Supervisor (Phase 1 production path).
  - `E2BCloudSandboxProvider` — skeleton that throws `NotImplementedException`;
    to be filled in when Phase 2+ Mode D is actually scoped.
- **DI** — `services.AddKunSandbox(opts => opts.UseSupervisor(url, cert) | opts.UseE2BCloud(key, team) | opts.UseInMemory())`.

## 5. Decision

**Adopt Option 3.** The framework layer gains a new module:

```
src/Kun.Sandbox/
  Kun.Sandbox.csproj             (IsAotCandidate=true)
  AGENTS.md
  Abstractions/
    ISandboxProvider.cs
    ISandboxHandle.cs
    IProcesses.cs
    IFiles.cs
    SandboxCreateOptions.cs
    ProcessRunOptions.cs
    ProcessResult.cs
    FileEntry.cs
  Implementations/
    InMemorySandboxProvider.cs
    SupervisorSandboxProvider.cs
    E2BCloudSandboxProvider.cs
  Extensions/
    ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
  Internal/
    SandboxJsonContext.cs        (source-generated JSON for AOT)
```

**The interface contract is "the E2B v2 API in C# records"**:

- `ISandboxProvider.CreateAsync(SandboxCreateOptions, CT)` maps to
  `POST /v2/sandboxes`.
- `ISandboxHandle.Processes.RunAsync(cmd, ProcessRunOptions, CT)` maps
  to `POST /v2/sandboxes/{id}/processes`.
- `ISandboxHandle.Files.ReadAsync/WriteAsync/ListAsync/DeleteAsync`
  map to `GET/POST/GET .../list/DELETE /v2/sandboxes/{id}/files` (with
  `?path=` query parameters per Spec v1.1 §4.5).
- `ISandboxHandle.KillAsync()` maps to
  `DELETE /v2/sandboxes/{id}`.

Record fields carry `[JsonPropertyName]` attributes that emit
**camelCase** at the JSON boundary (matching E2B) while keeping
idiomatic PascalCase inside the .NET code. NeuroAgent extensions
(secret scope, browser, egress, max commands) live under a
`NeuroagentExtension` property on `SandboxCreateOptions` serialised as
the `neuroagent` sub-object — exactly mirroring the spec.

## 6. Consequences

### Positive

- C# business services can directly consume sandboxes through a
  typed, AOT-friendly API without learning HTTP / E2B schemas inline.
- The abstraction is backend-agnostic: swapping
  `UseSupervisor` → `UseE2BCloud` is a one-line change when Mode D is
  scoped.
- Unit tests can use `InMemorySandboxProvider` with no Docker
  dependency.
- The interface contract is the E2B v2 shape, so .NET call sites and
  Python SDK call sites read the same — lower cognitive load for
  engineers crossing stacks.

### Negative / Trade-offs

- `Kun.Sandbox` must track E2B v2 API evolution. Mitigation: monitor
  E2B changelog (same rule as ADR-S01). Breaking changes cascade
  through `Kun.Sandbox` to all consumers; that is intended.
- `Kun.Sandbox` does **not** own a runtime. Any expectation that a
  local `UseInMemory()` provides real isolation is wrong — it is a test
  fake. AGENTS.md and XML docs are explicit about this.
- The Supervisor client path requires S2S JWT + mTLS to the Supervisor.
  Callers must wire `Kun.Security` (or an equivalent S2S token source)
  into the `HttpClient` via a `DelegatingHandler`. Docs show the
  canonical wiring.

### Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Consumer drifts the record shape away from E2B schema | CI contract test: `SandboxCreateOptions` / `ProcessResult` JSON output diffed against a golden fixture derived from E2B v2 docs; diff > 0 fails the build. |
| `InMemorySandboxProvider` leaks into production wiring | `AddKunSandbox` + `UseInMemory` name signals "test only"; AGENTS.md calls it out; follow-up can add a `KUN_SANDBOX_ALLOW_INMEMORY_IN_PROD=false` guard if abuse appears. |
| Supervisor upgrades a field shape mid-flight | Records use `[JsonPropertyName]` + `JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull` so additive changes are backward-compatible; breaking changes require an explicit version bump. |
| E2B Cloud provider is tempting to "finish early" | The stub throws `NotImplementedException` with a clear message. Filling it requires a dedicated task after Mode D is scoped — not a drive-by. |

## 7. Alternatives not taken

- Owning the runtime in .NET (Option 2): rejected; Supervisor is Python
  by design.
- A single provider that branches internally on `BackendKind`: rejected;
  three explicit implementations are clearer and each can carry its own
  dependencies / tests.
- Exposing raw `HttpClient` with helper methods: rejected; would force
  every consumer to re-derive the URL shape and undermine the
  abstraction's reason for existing.

## 8. Validation

- Spec alignment: `SandboxCreateOptions` JSON payload (camelCase,
  `cpuCount`/`memoryMB`/`timeoutMs`/`envs`/`metadata`/`neuroagent.*`)
  matches the request body in Spec v1.1 §4.3 byte-for-byte.
- AOT: CI AOT-publish matrix adds `Kun.Sandbox` and runs
  `dotnet publish -p:PublishAot=true /warnaserror` with zero warnings.
- Tests: `tests/Kun.Sandbox.Tests/` includes ≥ 15 tests (in-memory
  lifecycle, Supervisor request-shape via WireMock.Net, E2B-Cloud stub
  surface, DI options round-trip, camelCase serialisation, parallel
  sandbox isolation).

## 9. References

- ADR-S01-E2B-compatible-API.md (parent, Supervisor REST shape)
- NeuroAgent_Sandbox_Spec_v1.1.md §§1.3, 2, 4, 12, 14, 17
- ADR-009-Kun.Configuration-module.md (sibling example of an
  Abstraction-layer module with pluggable backends)
- [E2B Cloud API docs](https://e2b.dev/docs/api/v2) — tracked external
  contract this module mirrors

# Kun Framework 架构设计与产品白皮书

:::info 镜像页
本页镜像自 kun 仓库 [`docs/whitepaper.md`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/blob/v2026.10.25/docs/whitepaper.md)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。改动请提到 kun 仓库。
:::

> **"北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也；化而为鸟，其名为鹏。"** ——《庄子·逍遥游》

**Slogan**: _From the deep, to the sky._ (出于深渊，翱翔云端)
**作者**: Manus AI
**日期**: 2026年4月18日

***

## 1. 框架愿景与定位

**Kun Framework** 是一款专为 .NET 10 打造的现代化云原生微服务开发框架。名字源自《庄子·逍遥游》，寓意框架的演进能力：从轻量级单体（深渊之鲲），无缝演化为支撑海量并发的分布式微服务架构（云端之鹏）。

### 1.1 核心设计理念

1. **AOT-Ready 分层策略**：网关层、gRPC 无状态服务、CQRS 调度器、JSON 序列化层严格遵循 AOT 兼容（无反射、源生成优先）；数据访问层以 trimming-safe 为目标。定位诚实、落地可行。
2. **严格的领域驱动设计（DDD）**：领域层零基础设施依赖。内置聚合根、实体、值对象、规约模式（Specification）、领域事件基类，强制保护业务不变量。
3. **双引擎数据访问**：写侧（Command）使用 **EF Core 10** 以获得变更追踪、工作单元、丰富的 DDD 映射能力；读侧（Query）使用 **Dapper AOT** 以获得极致性能和 AOT 友好性。与 CQRS 天然契合。
4. **多协议 RPC**：对外 HTTP/JSON（Minimal API），内部 gRPC（HTTP/2 + Protobuf），网关层支持 gRPC-Web 协议转换。
5. **可靠的事件驱动（EDA）**：原生集成 Outbox Pattern，业务数据与事件在同一本地事务中原子落库；稳定事件标识符支持版本演进；跨进程边界自动传播 W3C Trace Context。
6. **内置分布式事务编排**：原生提供 Saga Orchestration，将跨服务的长事务（补偿、超时、幂等）下沉至框架，业务方只写正向步骤与补偿逻辑。
7. **零信任服务间通信**：网关签发短生命周期内部 S2S JWT，下游服务独立校验；配合 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 形成纵深防御。
8. **多租户 First-Class**：v1 即内置 `ITenantContext` 抽象、EF Core 全局查询过滤器、缓存 Key 租户隔离、消息路由租户标签。
9. **面向 Serverless 与微服务**：无缝集成 .NET Aspire 进行编排与可观测性（OpenTelemetry）。

***

## 2. 完整技术栈

### 2.1 核心技术选型总览

| 分类 | 技术 / 组件 | 版本 | 用途说明 |
| :----------- | :--------------------------- | :--------: | :------------------------------------- |
| **运行时** | .NET | 10 LTS | 基础运行时，部分服务走 Native AOT |
| **服务编排** | .NET Aspire | 9.x | 本地一键编排、服务发现、可观测性 |
| **ORM（写侧）** | EF Core 10 | 10.x | 聚合根变更追踪、UoW、Migrations、Fluent 映射 |
| **ORM（读侧）** | Dapper AOT | 9.x | 只读查询高性能数据访问，完整 AOT 兼容 |
| **主数据库** | PostgreSQL | 16+ | 默认选型；JSONB、分区、逻辑复制能力完善 |
| **备选数据库** | MySQL | 8.x | 可替换方案，EF Core Provider 支持良好 |
| **API 网关** | YARP | 2.x | 反向代理、gRPC 透传、S2S JWT 签发 |
| **RPC 协议** | gRPC（Grpc.AspNetCore） | .NET 10 内置 | 微服务内部高性能强类型通信 |
| **HTTP API** | Minimal APIs | .NET 10 内置 | 对外 REST 接口，AOT 友好 |
| **CQRS 调度** | Kun.Mediator（自研） | — | `FrozenDictionary` 无反射调度，AOT 原生兼容 |
| **分布式事务** | Kun.Saga（自研） | — | Saga Orchestration 编排器 |
| **消息队列** | RabbitMQ | 3.x | 集成事件跨服务异步传递 |
| **缓存** | HybridCache | .NET 10 内置 | L1 内存 + L2 Redis 两级缓存 |
| **分布式缓存** | Redis | 7.x | HybridCache L2、幂等键存储、分布式限流 |
| **外部认证** | ASP.NET Core JWT Bearer | .NET 10 内置 | 网关层校验外部 IdP 颁发的访问令牌 |
| **内部认证** | Kun.Security（自研） | — | 网关签发、下游校验的短生命周期 S2S JWT |
| **限流** | ASP.NET Core Rate Limiting | .NET 10 内置 | 网关层固定/滑动窗口限流 |
| **可观测性** | OpenTelemetry | 1.x | 追踪、指标、结构化日志；事件消息跨边界自动传播 |
| **验证** | Kun.Validation（SourceGen） | — | 编译时生成验证代码，AOT 友好 |
| **序列化** | System.Text.Json + SourceGen | .NET 10 内置 | 所有事件注册到 `JsonSerializerContext` |
| **集成测试** | Testcontainers for .NET | 3.x | PostgreSQL / RabbitMQ / Redis 真实容器集成测试 |
| **容器化** | Docker / Kubernetes | — | 微服务部署与编排 |
| **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions | — | 自动化构建、AOT 发布、NuGet 包分发 |

### 2.2 为什么选择 EF Core 10 + Dapper AOT 双引擎？

| 维度 | EF Core 10（写侧） | Dapper AOT（读侧） |
| :------------ | :----------------------------- | :-------------------- |
| **适用场景** | Command、聚合根持久化、复杂事务 | Query、报表、列表页、DTO 投影 |
| **核心能力** | 变更追踪、导航属性、Fluent 映射、Migrations | 原生 SQL、零开销对象映射、编译时源生成 |
| **AOT 兼容性** | .NET 10 中持续完善，trimming-safe | 完整 AOT 原生支持 |
| **DDD 契合度** | 天然支持聚合根 + 子实体持久化 | 无状态、无追踪，适合读模型 |
| **与 CQRS 契合** | Command Handler 中使用 | Query Handler 中使用 |

这个组合让**写侧可以放心使用 ORM 的表达能力**来保护领域不变量，**读侧则把性能和 AOT 兼容性拉满**——正是 CQRS 分治思想在技术栈上的自然落地。

### 2.3 通信协议选型原则

| 通信场景 | 推荐协议 | 核心原因 |
| :--------------- | :------------------------ | :--------------------- |
| 对外开放 API（前端、第三方） | HTTP/JSON（Minimal API） | 通用性强，易于调试与集成 |
| 微服务内部同步调用 | gRPC（HTTP/2 + Protobuf） | 强类型契约、二进制序列化、性能高 |
| 浏览器直连后端 gRPC | gRPC-Web（网关协议转换） | 浏览器不支持原生 HTTP/2 gRPC 帧 |
| 跨服务异步通知与解耦 | RabbitMQ + Outbox Pattern | 服务解耦、可靠投递、最终一致性 |
| 跨服务长事务 | Saga Orchestration | 补偿、超时、幂等一体化编排 |

***

***

## 4. 核心构建块（Building Blocks）设计

### 4.1 纯净的领域模型

领域基类零基础设施依赖，所有持久化映射下沉至 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 的 `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`。

```csharp
// Kun.Core - 零基础设施依赖
public abstract class AggregateRoot<TKey, TUserKey> : IAggregateRoot<TKey>, ISoftDelete, IAuditedObject<TUserKey>
{
    public TKey Id { get; protected set; } = default!;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; protected set; }
    public TUserKey? CreatedBy { get; protected set; }

    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; protected set; }
    public TUserKey? UpdatedBy { get; protected set; }

    public bool IsDeleted { get; protected set; }
    public DateTime? DeletedAt { get; protected set; }

    private readonly List<IDomainEvent> _domainEvents = new();

    public IReadOnlyCollection<IDomainEvent> DomainEvents => _domainEvents.AsReadOnly();
    public void AddDomainEvent(IDomainEvent domainEvent) => _domainEvents.Add(domainEvent);
    public void ClearDomainEvents() => _domainEvents.Clear();

    public virtual void Delete()
    {
        IsDeleted = true;
        DeletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

// 便捷重载：用户 ID 默认为 Guid
public abstract class AggregateRoot<TKey> : AggregateRoot<TKey, Guid> { }
```

审计用户 ID 泛型化，兼容 `Guid`（本地用户）、`string`（外部 IdP 的 `sub`）、`long`（数据库自增）等不同场景。

### 4.2 持久化映射（下沉到基础设施层）

```csharp
// Kun.EntityFrameworkCore - 持久化细节隔离在此层
public class ProductConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Product>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Product> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("products");
        builder.HasKey(p => p.Id);

        builder.Property(p => p.Name).HasMaxLength(200).IsRequired();
        builder.Property(p => p.Price).HasPrecision(18, 2);

        // 软删除全局过滤器
        builder.HasQueryFilter(p => !p.IsDeleted);

        // 值对象使用 Owned Type 映射
        builder.OwnsOne(p => p.Dimensions);

        // 领域事件不持久化
        builder.Ignore(p => p.DomainEvents);
    }
}
```

### 4.3 高性能 CQRS 调度器（Kun.Mediator）

`Kun.Mediator` 专为 .NET 10 Native AOT 设计，填补 MediatR v12 之后商业授权带来的空位。

```csharp
public sealed class KunMediator : ISender, IPublisher
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly FrozenDictionary<Type, RequestHandlerBase> _handlers;

    public KunMediator(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, FrozenDictionary<Type, RequestHandlerBase> handlers)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _handlers = handlers;
    }

    public ValueTask<TResponse> Send<TResponse>(IRequest<TResponse> request, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (!_handlers.TryGetValue(request.GetType(), out var handlerBase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"未找到 {request.GetType().Name} 的处理器");

        var handler = (RequestHandlerWrapper<TResponse>)handlerBase;
        return handler.Handle(request, _serviceProvider, ct);
    }
}
```

Handler 注册由配套的源生成器在编译期完成，`FrozenDictionary` 查找 O(1)，零反射。

### 4.4 租户上下文抽象

```csharp
// Kun.Core
public interface ITenantContext
{
    string? TenantId { get; }
    bool IsMultiTenant { get; }
}

// Kun.EntityFrameworkCore - 自动挂载全局过滤器
public abstract class KunDbContext : DbContext
{
    private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        foreach (var entityType in modelBuilder.Model.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            if (typeof(IMultiTenant).IsAssignableFrom(entityType.ClrType))
            {
                // 对实现了 IMultiTenant 的实体自动附加 TenantId 过滤
                modelBuilder.Entity(entityType.ClrType).AddTenantQueryFilter(_tenantContext);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

v1 即约定清楚"租户 ID 从哪来、怎么传、怎么过滤"，业务开发者后续接入 SaaS 场景时零改动。

***

## 5. 数据访问层：写读分离双引擎

### 5.1 写侧 —— EF Core 10 仓储与规约

```csharp
// 规约示例
public class ActiveProductsSpec : Specification<Product>
{
    public ActiveProductsSpec(int pageIndex, int pageSize)
    {
        AddCriteria(p => p.StockQuantity > 0);   // IsDeleted 由全局过滤器处理
        ApplyOrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt);
        ApplyPaging(pageIndex * pageSize, pageSize);
    }
}

// 基于 EF Core 的仓储实现
public class EfRepository<T> : IRepository<T> where T : class, IAggregateRoot
{
    private readonly KunDbContext _db;

    public async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(object id, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => await _db.Set<T>().FindAsync(new[] { id }, ct);

    public async Task<List<T>> ListAsync(ISpecification<T> spec, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => await SpecificationEvaluator.Default.GetQuery(_db.Set<T>(), spec).ToListAsync(ct);

    public async Task AddAsync(T entity, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => await _db.Set<T>().AddAsync(entity, ct);
}
```

### 5.2 读侧 —— Dapper AOT 查询服务

```csharp
// 用于 Query Handler 的高性能只读投影
public interface IProductReadService
{
    Task<ProductListDto?> GetListAsync(Guid tenantId, int page, int size, CancellationToken ct);
}

public class ProductReadService : IProductReadService
{
    private readonly IReadDbConnectionFactory _factory;

    [DapperAot] // Dapper AOT 源生成器在编译期生成映射代码
    public async Task<ProductListDto?> GetListAsync(Guid tenantId, int page, int size, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var conn = await _factory.CreateAsync(ct);

        var sql = """
            SELECT id, name, price, stock_quantity
            FROM products
            WHERE tenant_id = @TenantId AND is_deleted = false
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT @Size OFFSET @Offset
            """;

        var items = await conn.QueryAsync<ProductItemDto>(sql,
            new { TenantId = tenantId, Size = size, Offset = page * size });

        return new ProductListDto(items.ToList(), page, size);
    }
}
```

Dapper AOT 通过 `[DapperAot]` 特性触发源生成器，在编译期生成 `DbDataReader → DTO` 的映射代码，**完全不走运行时反射**，Native AOT 发布无任何警告。

### 5.3 工作单元与 Outbox 原子化落库

当前入口为 `EfUnitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync`：在提交前、同 scope 派发领域通知，通知将集成事件暂存到 Buffer，再把业务变更与 Outbox 一并保存；不要以 `DbContext.SaveChangesAsync` 直接替代 UoW。完整实现与装配见 [消息指南](/sdk/kun/guides/outbox-and-integration-events.md)。

**设计要点**：

1. **一个事务写入所有变更**：EF Core 的 `SaveChanges` 本身就是一个事务边界，聚合根的 Insert/Update 与 Outbox 的 Insert 在同一次提交中原子完成。
2. **稳定事件标识符**：用 `"order.created.v1"` 这样的字符串 ID 代替 `AssemblyQualifiedName`，消除程序集版本、强名称、命名空间重构带来的反序列化失败风险，并天然支持事件版本演进。
3. **AOT 安全的 JSON 序列化**：通过 `KunJsonContext` 源生成的 `JsonTypeInfo` 进行序列化，避免运行时反射。
4. **追踪上下文落库**：`TraceParent`/`TraceState` 随 Outbox 消息持久化，发布到 RabbitMQ 时写入 Header，消费端恢复 `Activity.Current`，分布式追踪不断链。

***

## 6. 事件驱动：Outbox 发布器与消费端幂等

### 6.1 Outbox 发布器

```csharp
public class OutboxPublisher : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            await using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateAsyncScope();
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<KunDbContext>();
            var bus = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IIntegrationEventBus>();

            var pending = await db.Set<OutboxMessage>()
                .Where(m => m.Status == OutboxStatus.Pending)
                .OrderBy(m => m.OccurredAt)
                .Take(100)
                .ToListAsync(stoppingToken);

            foreach (var msg in pending)
            {
                // 恢复追踪上下文，链路不断
                using var activity = _activitySource.StartActivity(
                    "outbox.publish", ActivityKind.Producer,
                    parentId: msg.TraceParent);

                await bus.PublishAsync(msg, stoppingToken);
                msg.Status = OutboxStatus.Published;
                msg.PublishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }

            await db.SaveChangesAsync(stoppingToken);
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), stoppingToken);
        }
    }
}
```

### 6.2 消费端幂等中间件

Outbox 保证"至少一次"投递，消费者必须幂等。`Kun.EventBus` 内置 `IProcessedMessageStore`，消费 Handler 被自动包装一层去重检查：

默认存储为 `Kun.EventBus.Idempotency.RedisProcessedMessageStore`。装饰器先调用 `IsProcessedAsync` 检查成功记录，handler 成功后再调用 `TryMarkProcessedAsync` 并 ack；失败不留下成功标记。原先先标记后处理会使失败消息在重投时被误认为成功，S1-KUN-002 已修复。

框架提供至少一次投递和成功记录去重；并发重复、业务成功但标记未持久化等窗口仍可能再次调用 handler，业务写入必须用幂等键或同事务消费记录保护。详见 [可靠性边界与迁移](/sdk/kun/guides/outbox-and-integration-events.md#可靠性边界与迁移s1-kun-002)。

***

## 7. 分布式事务：Saga 编排器（Kun.Saga）

在微服务架构下，跨服务的长事务无法用单库事务完成。Kun.Saga 采用 **Orchestration（编排）模式**：由一个中央协调器按顺序驱动各步骤，失败时按相反顺序执行补偿。

### 7.1 为什么选择 Orchestration 而非 Choreography

| 维度 | Orchestration（Kun 选用） | Choreography |
| :----------- | :-------------------------- | :------------------ |
| 流程可见性 | 中央协调器代码即流程定义，清晰 | 事件散落各服务，需拼图 |
| 补偿编写 | 集中在 Saga 定义里，显式 | 需要每个服务订阅失败事件 |
| 超时 / 状态持久化 | 协调器直接维护 | 难以统一 |
| 与 Outbox 契合度 | 协调器通过 Outbox 发 Command，天然可靠 | 多服务各自发事件，幂等 / 顺序难保证 |
| 耦合度 | 协调器知道所有步骤 | 各服务解耦但流程隐式 |
| 可测试性 | Saga 可作为单元测试对象 | 需跨服务集成测试 |

对于 **需要明确补偿逻辑** 的业务（下单、付款、发货、订阅变更），Orchestration 的工程收益显著大于耦合成本。

### 7.2 核心抽象

```csharp
// Kun.Saga
public interface ISagaContext
{
    Guid SagaId { get; }
    string TenantId { get; }
}

public interface ISaga<TContext> where TContext : ISagaContext
{
    string Name { get; }                                    // 稳定 Saga 标识，如 "order.create"
    IReadOnlyList<ISagaStep<TContext>> Steps { get; }
    TimeSpan DefaultStepTimeout { get; }
}

public interface ISagaStep<TContext> where TContext : ISagaContext
{
    string Name { get; }                                    // 稳定步骤标识
    Task ExecuteAsync(TContext ctx, CancellationToken ct);
    Task CompensateAsync(TContext ctx, CancellationToken ct);
    TimeSpan? Timeout { get; }                              // 步骤超时
}
```

### 7.3 业务示例：订单创建 Saga

```csharp
// 上下文（贯穿整个 Saga 的数据载体）
public class OrderSagaContext : ISagaContext
{
    public Guid SagaId { get; init; }
    public string TenantId { get; init; } = default!;
    public Guid OrderId { get; init; }
    public decimal TotalAmount { get; init; }
    public List<OrderLine> Items { get; init; } = new();

    // 各步骤产出的状态（用于补偿时知道要回滚什么）
    public Guid? ReservationId { get; set; }
    public Guid? PaymentId { get; set; }
    public Guid? ShipmentId { get; set; }
}

// Saga 定义
public class OrderSaga : ISaga<OrderSagaContext>
{
    public string Name => "order.create";
    public TimeSpan DefaultStepTimeout => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    public IReadOnlyList<ISagaStep<OrderSagaContext>> Steps { get; } = new ISagaStep<OrderSagaContext>[]
    {
        new ReserveInventoryStep(),
        new ProcessPaymentStep(),
        new CreateShipmentStep(),
        new NotifyCustomerStep()
    };
}

// 单个步骤：预留库存 + 补偿释放库存
public class ReserveInventoryStep : ISagaStep<OrderSagaContext>
{
    public string Name => "reserve-inventory";
    public TimeSpan? Timeout => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);

    private readonly ISender _mediator;

    public async Task ExecuteAsync(OrderSagaContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var result = await _mediator.Send(
            new ReserveInventoryCommand(ctx.OrderId, ctx.Items), ct);

        if (!result.IsSuccess)
            throw new SagaStepFailedException(Name, result.Error!);

        ctx.ReservationId = result.Value!.ReservationId;
    }

    public async Task CompensateAsync(OrderSagaContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // 补偿必须幂等：即使 ReservationId 为空（执行时就失败了）也不能抛错
        if (ctx.ReservationId is null) return;
        await _mediator.Send(new ReleaseInventoryCommand(ctx.ReservationId.Value), ct);
    }
}
```

### 7.4 编排器实现要点

```csharp
public interface ISagaOrchestrator
{
    Task<Guid> StartAsync<TContext>(TContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
        where TContext : ISagaContext;
}

public class SagaOrchestrator<TSaga, TContext> : ISagaOrchestrator
    where TSaga : ISaga<TContext>
    where TContext : ISagaContext
{
    private readonly TSaga _saga;
    private readonly ISagaInstanceStore _store;     // 基于 EF Core 的状态持久化
    private readonly KunDbContext _db;

    public async Task<Guid> StartAsync(TContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // 1) 持久化 Saga 实例（与业务命令同事务）
        var instance = new SagaInstance
        {
            Id = ctx.SagaId,
            SagaName = _saga.Name,
            TenantId = ctx.TenantId,
            ContextPayload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(ctx, KunJsonContext.Default.GetTypeInfo(typeof(TContext))!),
            CurrentStepIndex = 0,
            State = SagaState.Running,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            TimeoutAt = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(_saga.DefaultStepTimeout)
        };
        await _store.AddAsync(instance, ct);

        // 2) 投递首步执行消息到 Outbox（保证与业务事务原子）
        await _store.EnqueueStepAsync(instance.Id, stepIndex: 0, ct);

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
        return instance.Id;
    }

    // 由 SagaStepExecutor 后台服务驱动，而非同步调用
    internal async Task ExecuteStepAsync(Guid sagaId, int stepIndex, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var instance = await _store.GetAsync(sagaId, ct);
        var ctx = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TContext>(
            instance.ContextPayload, KunJsonContext.Default.GetTypeInfo(typeof(TContext))!)!;
        var step = _saga.Steps[stepIndex];

        try
        {
            await step.ExecuteAsync(ctx, ct);
            instance.ContextPayload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(ctx, ...);
            instance.CurrentStepIndex = stepIndex + 1;

            if (instance.CurrentStepIndex >= _saga.Steps.Count)
            {
                instance.State = SagaState.Completed;
                instance.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }
            else
            {
                await _store.EnqueueStepAsync(sagaId, instance.CurrentStepIndex, ct);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Saga {SagaId} 步骤 {Step} 失败，进入补偿", sagaId, step.Name);
            instance.State = SagaState.Compensating;
            instance.FailureReason = ex.Message;
            await _store.EnqueueCompensationAsync(sagaId, stepIndex, ct);
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
    }

    internal async Task CompensateAsync(Guid sagaId, int fromStepIndex, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var instance = await _store.GetAsync(sagaId, ct);
        var ctx = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TContext>(instance.ContextPayload, ...)!;

        // 从失败步骤开始，反向执行已完成步骤的补偿
        for (var i = fromStepIndex; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            await _saga.Steps[i].CompensateAsync(ctx, ct);
        }

        instance.State = SagaState.Compensated;
        instance.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
    }
}
```

### 7.5 超时检测（后台服务）

```csharp
public class SagaTimeoutDetector : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            await using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateAsyncScope();
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<KunDbContext>();

            var timedOut = await db.Set<SagaInstance>()
                .Where(s => s.State == SagaState.Running && s.TimeoutAt < DateTime.UtcNow)
                .Take(50)
                .ToListAsync(stoppingToken);

            foreach (var instance in timedOut)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Saga {SagaId} 超时，触发补偿", instance.Id);
                instance.State = SagaState.Compensating;
                instance.FailureReason = "Timeout";
                // 入队补偿任务
                await _store.EnqueueCompensationAsync(instance.Id, instance.CurrentStepIndex - 1, stoppingToken);
            }

            await db.SaveChangesAsync(stoppingToken);
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), stoppingToken);
        }
    }
}
```

### 7.6 设计保证

| 保证项 | 实现方式 |
| :--------- | :--------------------------------------------- |
| **启动原子性** | SagaInstance 持久化 + 首步入队与业务 Command 同一 EF 事务 |
| **步骤幂等** | 每次执行前通过 `IProcessedMessageStore` 去重 |
| **补偿反向顺序** | 编排器从失败步骤开始，`i-- CompensateAsync` |
| **补偿自身幂等** | 约定：补偿实现必须允许在"未执行/部分执行"的上下文上安全调用 |
| **超时处理** | `SagaTimeoutDetector` 后台服务检测 `TimeoutAt < Now` |
| **状态可查询** | `SagaInstance` 表即是运行时快照，运维可直接查询状态 |
| **追踪串联** | Saga 启动时的 TraceId 写入 `SagaInstance`，所有步骤继承 |

## 8. 微服务通信：Minimal API 与 gRPC 双引擎

对外 HTTP/JSON（Minimal API），内部 gRPC，两者共享底层 CQRS Handler。

### 8.1 gRPC 服务端 —— Result 模式无缝映射

```csharp
public class CatalogGrpcEndpoint : CatalogGrpcService.CatalogGrpcServiceBase
{
    private readonly ISender _mediator;

    public override async Task<ProductResponse> GetProductById(
        GetProductRequest request, ServerCallContext context)
    {
        var query = new GetProductByIdQuery(Guid.Parse(request.Id));
        var result = await _mediator.Send(query, context.CancellationToken);

        // Result 模式 → gRPC 状态映射交由 Kun.Grpc 拦截器统一处理
        // Handler 代码保持干净，只返回 Result<T>
        return result.EnsureSuccess().ToProto();
    }
}
```

### 8.2 gRPC 全局拦截器：Result → RpcException 自动映射

```csharp
public class KunResultToRpcInterceptor : Interceptor
{
    public override async Task<TResponse> UnaryServerHandler<TRequest, TResponse>(
        TRequest request, ServerCallContext context,
        UnaryServerMethod<TRequest, TResponse> continuation)
    {
        try
        {
            return await continuation(request, context);
        }
        catch (ResultFailureException ex)  // Kun 框架约定的失败异常
        {
            var status = ex.Error.Type switch
            {
                ErrorType.NotFound       => StatusCode.NotFound,
                ErrorType.Validation     => StatusCode.InvalidArgument,
                ErrorType.Conflict       => StatusCode.FailedPrecondition,
                ErrorType.Unauthorized   => StatusCode.Unauthenticated,
                ErrorType.Forbidden      => StatusCode.PermissionDenied,
                _                        => StatusCode.Internal
            };
            throw new RpcException(new Status(status, ex.Error.Message));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "gRPC 未处理异常: {Method}", context.Method);
            throw new RpcException(new Status(StatusCode.Internal, "服务器内部错误"));
        }
    }
}
```

### 8.3 客户端调用（结合 .NET Aspire 服务发现）

```csharp
builder.Services.AddGrpcClient<CatalogGrpcService.CatalogGrpcServiceClient>(o =>
{
    o.Address = new Uri("https+http://catalog-api");
})
.AddKunServiceAuth();  // 自动在请求中注入 S2S JWT（见下一章）
```

## 9. 安全架构：零信任服务间通信

Kun Framework 采用 **内部 S2S JWT + 网络策略** 的纵深防御方案：任何能直连 Pod 的流量都不被默认信任，必须持有网关签发的有效 S2S 令牌。

### 9.1 信任边界与整体流程

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as 外部客户端
    participant Gateway as Kun.Gateway
    participant ServiceA as 下游服务 A
    participant ServiceB as 下游服务 B

    Client->>Gateway: 请求 + 外部 JWT（IdP 签发）
    Gateway->>Gateway: 校验外部 JWT
    Gateway->>Gateway: 签发内部 S2S JWT<br/>(Kun 私钥, 60s TTL)<br/>包含 sub/tenant_id/roles
    Gateway->>ServiceA: 请求 + Authorization: Bearer {S2S-JWT}
    ServiceA->>ServiceA: 校验 S2S JWT 签名/受众/过期
    ServiceA->>ServiceA: 提取 sub/tenant_id 注入 ITenantContext
    ServiceA->>ServiceB: gRPC 调用 + 转发/重签 S2S JWT
    ServiceB->>ServiceB: 同样校验 S2S JWT
```

关键设计点：

1. **两套 JWT 分离**：外部 JWT（用户身份）由 IdP 签发、网关校验；内部 S2S JWT（服务间令牌）由网关用**独立私钥**签发，下游用**独立公钥**校验。两套密钥互不相干。
2. **S2S JWT 短生命周期**：TTL 控制在 60 秒到 5 分钟，即使泄露风险窗口也极小。
3. **内部签名密钥不暴露**：S2S 公钥只在内部网络 JWKS 端点暴露，永不对外发布。
4. **特定 Audience**：S2S JWT 的 `aud` 声明为 `kun-internal`，下游只接受该 audience 的令牌，防止外部 JWT 被误用为内部令牌。
5. **网络层兜底**：配合 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy，下游服务**仅接受来自网关命名空间**的入站流量，形成纵深防御。

### 9.2 S2S JWT Claim 结构

```json
{
  "iss": "kun-gateway",
  "aud": "kun-internal",
  "exp": 1713456789,
  "iat": 1713456729,
  "jti": "a1b2c3d4-...",
  "sub": "user-42",
  "tenant_id": "tenant-contoso",
  "roles": ["customer"],
  "original_token_jti": "external-jti-xyz",
  "trace_id": "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-..."
}
```

### 9.3 网关签发实现（Kun.Gateway）

```csharp
public class S2sTokenIssuer
{
    private readonly SigningCredentials _signingCredentials;
    private readonly KunGatewayOptions _options;

    public string Issue(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal, string? traceId)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new("sub",       externalPrincipal.FindFirstValue("sub")!),
            new("tenant_id", externalPrincipal.FindFirstValue("tenant_id") ?? ""),
            new("jti",       Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new("trace_id",  traceId ?? "")
        };

        foreach (var role in externalPrincipal.FindAll(ClaimTypes.Role))
            claims.Add(new Claim("roles", role.Value));

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: "kun-gateway",
            audience: "kun-internal",
            claims: claims,
            notBefore: now,
            expires: now.AddSeconds(_options.S2sTtlSeconds),  // 默认 60s
            signingCredentials: _signingCredentials);         // RS256 / ES256

        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
    }
}

// YARP Transform：在转发前替换 Authorization 头为 S2S JWT
public class S2sAuthTransform : RequestTransform
{
    public override ValueTask ApplyAsync(RequestTransformContext ctx)
    {
        var principal = ctx.HttpContext.User;
        var traceId = Activity.Current?.TraceId.ToString();
        var s2sToken = _issuer.Issue(principal, traceId);

        ctx.ProxyRequest.Headers.Authorization =
            new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", s2sToken);

        return default;
    }
}
```

### 9.4 下游服务校验（Kun.Security）

```csharp
// 下游服务 Program.cs
builder.Services.AddKunServiceAuthentication(options =>
{
    options.JwksUri = "http://kun-gateway/internal/.well-known/jwks.json";
    options.ValidAudience = "kun-internal";
    options.ValidIssuer = "kun-gateway";
    options.ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
});

// 自动把 JWT claim 映射到 ITenantContext / ICurrentUser
builder.Services.AddScoped<ITenantContext, JwtTenantContext>();
```

### 9.5 服务间调用的令牌传递

```csharp
// Kun.Security.Http - 自动把当前请求的 S2S JWT 附加到出站 HTTP/gRPC 请求
public static IHttpClientBuilder AddKunServiceAuth(this IHttpClientBuilder builder)
    => builder.AddHttpMessageHandler<PropagateS2sTokenHandler>();

// 对于服务发起的后台任务（无入站请求），从配置拉取机器身份，调用网关 /s2s/issue 端点换取令牌
```

### 9.6 安全实践清单

| 检查项 | 实现 |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------------- |
| 外部 JWT 与内部 S2S JWT 密钥分离 | ✅ 两套密钥对，不同 JWKS 端点 |
| S2S JWT 短生命周期 | ✅ 默认 60 秒 |
| 受众校验防误用 | ✅ `aud = kun-internal` |
| 追踪 ID 随令牌传递 | ✅ `trace_id` claim |
| 网络层隔离 | ✅ K8s NetworkPolicy 限制仅网关入站 |
| 密钥轮换 | ✅ JWKS 多 `kid` 支持无缝轮换 |
| 后台任务身份 | ✅ 机器身份 → 网关 `/s2s/issue` |

## 10. API 网关与服务编排

### 10.1 智能网关（Kun.Gateway）

基于 YARP 构建，职责包括：

1. **协议转发**：HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2、gRPC 透明转发，gRPC-Web 自动转换。
2. **外部认证**：校验 IdP 颁发的 OIDC/OAuth 访问令牌。
3. **S2S JWT 签发**：见第 9 章。
4. **分布式限流**：ASP.NET Core Rate Limiting 配合 Redis 后端，支持 IP、租户、用户多维度策略。
5. **请求追踪**：OpenTelemetry 自动为每个入站请求创建根 Span。

### 10.2 .NET Aspire 服务编排

```csharp
var builder = DistributedApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// 基础设施
var postgres = builder.AddPostgres("postgres").WithDataVolume();
var catalogDb = postgres.AddDatabase("catalogdb");
var orderDb = postgres.AddDatabase("orderdb");

var rabbitmq = builder.AddRabbitMQ("rabbitmq");
var redis = builder.AddRedis("redis");

// 微服务
var catalogApi = builder.AddProject<Projects.Catalog_API>("catalog-api")
    .WithReference(catalogDb)
    .WithReference(rabbitmq)
    .WithReference(redis);

var orderApi = builder.AddProject<Projects.Order_API>("order-api")
    .WithReference(orderDb)
    .WithReference(rabbitmq)
    .WithReference(redis)
    .WithReference(catalogApi);  // 内部 gRPC 调用

// 网关
builder.AddProject<Projects.Kun_Gateway>("gateway")
    .WithReference(catalogApi)
    .WithReference(orderApi);

builder.Build().Run();
```
