## 📦 本次交付的模块与入口 API

| 能力 | 模块 | 入口 API |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 沙箱执行（E2B v2 协议兼容） | `Kun.Sandbox` | `AddKunSandbox(opts => opts.UseSupervisor(...) / .UseE2BCloud(...) / .UseInMemory())` |
| 操作审计 | `Kun.Audit` / `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore` | `AddKunAudit().UseEventBus()` |
| 零信任认证（S2S JWT） | `Kun.Security` | `AddKunServiceAuthentication(...)` + `AddKunSecurity()` |
| 外部 IdP 客户端 | `Kun.Identity` | `AddKunIdentity(...)` |
| 多租户隔离 | `Kun.MultiTenancy` / `Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore` | `AddKunMultiTenancy()` + `UseKunMultiTenancy()` |
| 按租户 / IP 分区限流 | `Kun.RateLimit` | `AddKunRateLimit(...)` |
| 统一缓存（Memory / Redis） | `Kun.Caching` | `AddKunCaching(c => c.UseMemory() / .UseRedis(...))` |
| 工件存储（Local / S3） | `Kun.Storage` | `AddKunStorage().UseLocal(...) / .UseS3(...)` |
| 统一可观测性（OTel） | `Kun.Observability` | `AddKunObservability("service-name")` |
| 强类型配置 | `Kun.Configuration` | `AddKunOptions<T>()` |

***

## 🔄 Breaking Changes

本次 tag 属于 pre-release，对已有 API 的契约变更如下：

- **`Kun.Saga`: `IsAotCandidate` 从 `true` 降为 `false`**。原因：`Persistence/Ef/*.cs`
  透传 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` → ILC 暴露 IL2091 / IL2060 / IL2026 / IL3050。
  - **消费方影响**：如果你的服务之前依赖 `Kun.Saga` 作为 AOT 候选并开启了
    `<PublishTrimmed>true</PublishTrimmed>`，现在 `Kun.Saga.dll` 不再被 trim，
    你的 publish 产物会变大若干 MB。
  - **迁移**：无需改代码；等 Phase 2 的 `Kun.Saga.EntityFrameworkCore` 子模块拆出后
    （跟踪编号 `P2-KN-Saga-EF-Split`），`Kun.Saga` 核心会恢复 AOT 候选状态。
- **`Kun.Dapper`: 显式 `IsAotCandidate=false`**（此前字段缺失）。
  - **消费方影响**：语义化修复，实际构建行为无变化（字段缺失时默认即为 false）。
  - **迁移**：无需操作。
- **`Directory.Build.props`**：csproj 侧重复声明的 `<IsTrimmable>` / `<IsAotCompatible>` /
  `<EnableTrimAnalyzer>` / `<EnableAotAnalyzer>` / `<EnableSingleFileAnalyzer>` /
  `<EnableDynamicLoading>` 不再被允许；现只保留 `<IsAotCandidate>true|false</IsAotCandidate>`
  这一单一开关。
  - **消费方影响**：如果你基于 Kun 模板复制过这些字段到下游 csproj，可以删除。
  - **迁移**：检查下游 csproj，保留 `<IsAotCandidate>`，删除其余 AOT 相关属性。

***

## 🗺️ Migration Guide — 从 `main` 切到 `develop` 消费 Kun 的用户

对于已经在消费 Kun `main` 分支（`1.0.0` M6 系列）且打算迁到 `0.1.0-phase1` 的下游：

1. **包版本对齐**：
   ```xml
   <!-- Directory.Packages.props in consumer repo -->
   <PackageVersion Include="Kun.Core"   Version="0.1.0-phase1" />
   <PackageVersion Include="Kun.Mediator" Version="0.1.0-phase1" />
   <!-- … 所有 Kun.* 都锁到同一版本，不要混用 -->
   ```
2. **新增 Phase 1 模块的 csproj 引用**（按需）：
   ```xml
   <ProjectReference Include="...Kun.Sandbox..." />
   <ProjectReference Include="...Kun.Audit..." />
   <ProjectReference Include="...Kun.Identity..." />
   ```
   NuGet 消费者改用 `<PackageReference>` 即可。
3. **组合根更新**：按 [README 最小集成示例](/sdk/kun/index.md) 的顺序装配
   `AddKunObservability` → `AddKunServiceAuthentication` + `AddKunSecurity`
   → `AddKunAudit().UseEventBus()` → `AddKunSandbox(...)`。
4. **Saga 消费方**：如之前开启了 `PublishTrimmed`，注意 `Kun.Saga.dll` 不再 trim；
   如果非 AOT 路径，无需操作。
5. **CI AOT 矩阵对齐**（可选）：如果消费方也跑 AOT 矩阵，把新的 10 个 AOT 候选模块
   列入本地矩阵以保持一致性。

***

## 🚧 Known Limitations

- **`E2BCloudSandboxProvider` 为 Phase 2+ 占位**：构造成功，调用
  `CreateAsync` 抛 `NotImplementedException`。生产路径请使用 `UseSupervisor`。
- **`Kun.Saga` 暂非 AOT 候选**（见上 Breaking Changes）。`P2-KN-Saga-EF-Split`
  解决。
- **NuGet.org 正式发版未执行**：本 tag 通过 GitHub Release prerelease 通道分发；
  NuGet.org `push` 走人工节奏（主控审核 + 手工 `dotnet nuget push`），不在本 tag 的自动化链路里。
- **.NET Aspire Dashboard 的 service-discovery env vars** 未在 CI 中装配，
  因此 `Kun.Sample.Tests` 在 CI 里被过滤；本地 `dotnet run --project samples/Kun.Sample.AppHost` 可跑。
- **`Kun.Sample.Catalog` 为 `IsAotCandidate=false`**（使用了 `MapCommand<T,R>` + `WriteAsJsonAsync<T>`）；AOT canary 是 `Kun.Sample.Minimal`，由
  `tests/Kun.Integration.AotTests` 在 CI 中做 native publish + run 冒烟。
- **`release.yml` 对 `-phase1` 后缀的 prerelease 识别**目前仅匹配 `-(alpha|beta|rc)`；
  主控在 Release 页面需手动勾选 "Set as a pre-release"（或后续 PR 放宽正则）。

***

## 🧪 Known-Good 组合

本 tag 在下列组件版本上验证通过：

| 组件 | 版本 | 备注 |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| .NET SDK | `10.0.100` 或更高（CI 实测 `10.0.104`） | `global.json` `rollForward: latestFeature` |
| `TargetFramework` | `net10.0` | Directory.Build.props 集中 |
| .NET Aspire | `9.0.0`（`Aspire.Hosting.*`） | 样例 AppHost |
| EF Core | `10.0.0`（PostgreSQL via `Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 10.0.0`） | 写侧 |
| Dapper | `2.1.35` + `Dapper.AOT 1.0.31` | 读侧 source generator |
| RabbitMQ.Client | `7.0.0` | 集成事件 broker |
| StackExchange.Redis | `2.8.16` | 缓存 / 幂等存储 |
| Yarp.ReverseProxy | `2.2.0` | Gateway |
| Grpc.AspNetCore | `2.67.0` | 服务间 RPC |
| OpenTelemetry | `1.11.2`（EF instrumentation `1.12.0-beta.1`） | `Kun.Observability` |
| 操作系统 | Linux x64（CI）/ macOS 13+ / Windows 11 | clang + zlib1g-dev 用于 native AOT linker |
| Docker | 24+（`Kun.IntegrationTests` 走 Testcontainers） | 本地集成测试 |

# 后端 SDK（.NET）

`Qian.Runtime` 极小、无业务语义：共享上下文 `ctx`、服务注册、类型化事件、可逆副作用、装载器，是组件库唯一必需的 Qian 依赖。平台能力都是向 `ctx` 贡献服务键的插件。

## 安装

`Qian.*` 包族以同一 SemVer 版本发布在 GitHub Packages 的 NuGet 源（ADR-019 D19.7），包随公开仓库 `idadawn/qian` 公开可见；Kun 正式包在 nuget.org。项目的 `nuget.config` 用 `packageSourceMapping` 把 `Qian.*` 指向该源，从 GitHub Packages 安装需要带 `read:packages` 权限的 GitHub 令牌：

```xml
<packageSources>
  <clear />
  <add key="qian" value="https://nuget.pkg.github.com/idadawn/index.json" />
  <add key="nuget.org" value="https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json" />
</packageSources>
<packageSourceMapping>
  <packageSource key="qian"><package pattern="Qian.*" /></packageSource>
  <packageSource key="nuget.org"><package pattern="*" /></packageSource>
</packageSourceMapping>
```

组件项目引用同一版本的 `Qian.Plugin.Sdk` 与 `Qian.Plugin.Sdk.Generators`；源生成器是开发依赖，写 `PrivateAssets="all"`：

```xml
<PackageReference Include="Qian.Plugin.Sdk" Version="0.1.0" />
<PackageReference Include="Qian.Plugin.Sdk.Generators" Version="0.1.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
```

## 编程模型

- **插件**：实现 `IQianPlugin` / `IQianPlugin<TConfig>`，在 `ApplyAsync` 里向上下文贡献内容；运行时先按清单的 `configSchema` 校验配置再反序列化。
- **服务**：`Provide(key, instance)` 填充服务键，`Inject<T>(key)` 取用；`ctx.Files()` 这类扩展方法由 Definition 包提供，等价于 `Inject`。装载器按 `inject → provides` 决定挂载顺序，依赖未就绪的插件保持 `Pending`。
- **事件**：事件在 Definition 包里定义并标注分发模式，见[事件与中间件](/sdk/dotnet/events.md)。
- **副作用皆可逆**：`Provide`、`On` 等注册都返回释放函数并压入插件的效果栈，`Effect(...)` 把第三方资源也纳入同一栈；卸载时按注册逆序释放。
- **scope**：`Scoped(scope)` 返回子上下文，之后的注册归属该 scope；见 [scope](/start/concepts/scope.md)。

## API 草图

节选自[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.2 的 API 草图（以规格为准）：

```csharp
public interface IQianPlugin
{
    IReadOnlyList<ServiceKey> Inject { get; }
    ValueTask ApplyAsync(IPluginContext ctx, JsonElement config, CancellationToken ct);
}

public interface IPluginContext
{
    ScopeKey Scope { get; }
    IDisposable Provide<TService>(ServiceKey key, TService instance) where TService : class;
    TService Inject<TService>(ServiceKey key) where TService : class;
    void Effect(Func<ValueTask> disposeAsync);
    IDisposable On<TPayload, TResult>(QianEvent<TPayload, TResult> evt, DispatchMode mode, Delegate handler, int priority = 0);
    ValueTask<TResult> DispatchAsync<TPayload, TResult>(QianEvent<TPayload, TResult> evt, TPayload payload, CancellationToken ct);
    IPluginContext Scoped(ScopeKey scope);
}
```

组件入口用 `[QianPlugin("<component-id>")]` 标注，源生成器派生 `runtime.entry`、`inject[]`、`provides[]` 以及配置、权限、事件和工具表面。同程序集支持多个不同组件 ID，每个组件保持唯一清单；工具按清单 ID 选择对应元数据。已派生、手写字段和 S2 边界见[能力与唯一清单](/sdk/dotnet/capabilities.md)。`Provide` 的登记归属当前插件的 scope 与可撤销生命周期；跨进程集成事件由 [qian.events](/components/platform/qian.events.md) 桥接到 Kun 的 Mediator + Outbox。

把 `Kun.Storage` 包装为 `ctx.Files` Provider 的完整示例见规格 §5.7。API 参考（DocFX 生成）随 S1-DOCS-002 上线。

# 能力与函数

## 能力目录

组件把自己的能力登记进**能力目录**（[qian.capabilities](/components/platform/qian.capabilities.md)），分四类：命令、查询、事件、实体。

- 组件在 `Apply` 中用 `ctx.ProvideCapability<TRequest, TResponse>()` 登记能力，绑定携带源生成的契约，请求与响应的 JSON Schema 由类型信息派生；目录只列这些绑定里、当前 scope 已挂载且 Ready 的能力。
- platform profile 宿主必须调用 `services.AddQianCapabilities()`，登记时就生成目录条目并预编译输入校验器（漏掉时退化为首次读目录或调用时才编译）。不合格的契约（输入含 `tenantId` 等租户字段、Schema 无法可靠校验）抛 `CapabilityContractException`，带组件 ID、能力短名与 JSON Pointer（如 `qian.sample.crm/customer.export#/inputSchema/properties/tenantId`），组件挂载失败；问题在登记时暴露，不会留到第一次调用。
- `GET /api/capabilities?kind=command|query|event|entity&q=` 按调用者权限与当前 scope 的 restrict 过滤，被过滤的项不出现；响应信封 `{ items, ttlMs, cacheScope: "private" }` 的冻结 Schema 是 `contracts/v0/capability-catalog.schema.json`。
- `POST /api/capabilities/{plugin}/{name}/invoke` 是通用执行入口，规则见下节。
- `GET /api/capabilities/openapi.json` 聚合全部已挂载组件的 OpenAPI 3.1（需认证，不等于公开 OpenAPI）；写类能力的路径列出 `Idempotency-Key` 参数、`Idempotent-Replayed` 响应头与两种 409（`CONFLICT`、`CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`）。
- Agent 用的工具**定义**由能力目录机械生成，保证 schema 不漂移；**暴露**哪些、怎么描述，经 `agent.expose` 单独策划（[ADR-016 D16.10](/design/adr/adr-016-iclaw-boundary.md)）。

## 代码与唯一清单

每个 `[QianPlugin]` 组件对应一份 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 和一个入口。同一程序集可包含多个不同组件 ID；`qian-plugin check|sync` 按目标清单 ID 选择，不合并不同组件的依赖。多组件程序集的 `[Capability]` 必须填写 `ComponentId`。契约包装器、动态表面适配器及宿主子插件通过仓库分类门记录归属，不各造一份清单。

| 已派生 | 代码来源与落点 |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 服务与具名贡献 | Inject / Provide、CommandPolicies 与按真实注册表符号绑定的 Contributes → inject / provides |
| 形态与入口 | QianPlugin → runtime.form / runtime.entry |
| 工具 | Capability 与源生成 JsonTypeInfo，或与实际绑定共用的静态 CapabilitySource → tools/\*.json |
| 配置契约 | QianConfigSchema 的完整代码声明 → runtime.configSchema 与对应 Schema 文件 |
| 权限与事件 | Permission / QianEvent → metadata/permissions.json、metadata/events.json；带清单侧的来源与派生指针，不放进 plugin.json |

id、版本、展示、策略、scope、包/镜像信息及表面路径仍手写；没有代码声明的权限文件与角色模板继续手写。动态 Inject、动态贡献名和未知上下文逃逸会报编译诊断，不生成空结果。需要不同构造模式的实现由固定薄入口明确依赖、委托目标与服务输出，真实装载负责验证提供项。

同程序集的多个 Provider 使用同一事件 Definition 时，由一个组件通过 MetadataTypes 拥有声明，其它组件以 SharedEvents 显式引用；生成的事件记录带 definitionComponent，保持名称、模式、载荷类型与来源同源。此机制只共享事件契约，不能共享权限，也不放宽未知上下文逃逸的诊断。

`sync` 沿既有表面目录写入，`check` 只读并报告文件与 JSON Pointer。清单保存权限、事件与配置文件的所属组件和内容哈希；手改这些文件后保留并报冲突，工具文件通过所属标记区分手写与派生。无组件注解、ID 不匹配、第二清单、手写覆盖、路径越界都有各自的 SDK 错误码及 `errors[]`。CI 自动发现所有代码入口并检查清单，同时拒绝漏分类的新实现。

R94 将 IQianPlugin 基类、客户端门面、生命周期钩子基类与 DI 注册代码生成推迟到 S2；S1 继续使用接口和 ctx.Inject。`[QianJob]` 属于 S1-SCH-001 的调度器交付，不在本次生成器补齐范围内。UI/低代码及 Wasm 表面按各自 S2 规划，代码热装卸尚未承诺。清单已经派生不代表真实安装验收完成，`x-skeleton` 仍按每个组件的安装门维护。

## 通用执行入口

`POST /api/capabilities/{plugin}/{name}/invoke` 先重做与目录相同的过滤（不可见与不存在一样 404），再按条目 `inputSchema` 校验请求体（不符返回 400 `INPUT_INVALID`，`errors[]` 带 JSON Pointer；请求体读不成确定的 JSON 值，如成员重名或有绝对值超过 decimal 范围约 7.9e28 的数，返回 400 `BAD_REQUEST`），然后走组件自己的命令管道，租户、授权与审计照常生效。

写类能力可以带幂等键，只读能力（`sideEffect: read`）忽略它、每次都执行：

| 头 | 方向 | 含义 |
| --------------------------- | -- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | 请求 | UUID 文本，可带引号；多值、空值、全零或非 UUID 返回 400 `BAD_REQUEST` |
| `Idempotent-Replayed: true` | 响应 | 这次是回放：响应体与首次成功响应逐字节相同，没有再执行 |

同一租户、同一主体、同一能力、同一键在 24 小时内的重复请求都不会再执行。409 分两种：

- `CONFLICT`：同键而输入不同，或同键请求仍在执行。改用新的键，或等前一个请求结束再重试。
- `CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`：同键请求已经执行成功，但回执没有保存响应体，无法回放。只有 `dataClassification` 为 `public` 或 `internal` 的能力保存响应体：`pii`、`finance`、`secret` 不保存，未知分级也不保存；响应超过组件配置 `receiptMaxBytes`（默认 64 KiB）时同样不保存。应通过查询确认结果，不要换新键重试，换键会再执行一次。

`[Capability]` 的 `DataClassification` 默认 `internal`，也就是默认把响应体明文存进回执表，24 小时内同键请求原样回放。响应含个人信息、财务或机密数据的能力要显式标注，如 `DataClassification = "pii"`（`finance`、`secret` 同理）；参考应用响应含客户名称的 `customer.*` 能力都标为 `pii`。

执行失败不留回执，同一个键可以带正确的输入重试。服务端在执行后、写回执前崩溃时，5 分钟租约到期后的重试会再执行一次，所以写类能力仍要在 `inputSchema` 里带业务幂等键（`idempotencyKey`）。

## 函数

`function` 表面（Wasm 沙箱内运行的函数）是 S2 可选能力；Agent 生成的代码只落在 `function` 沙箱里（ADR-016 D16.11）。

详见 [PRD §7.2](/design/prd/07-s1-foundation.md)。

# 事件与中间件

事件在 Definition 包的**定义处**标注分发模式，`ctx.On` 调用点必须写同一模式：重复一次是为了让调用点可读，也让 CI 能做一致性校验。

| 模式 | 调用顺序 | 返回值 | 异常 | 典型用途 |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------- |
| `emit` 观察 | 按 priority 降序逐个 await | 无 | 记录日志、不传播，其余监听器继续 | 通知、审计、索引 |
| `waterfall` 环绕 | 按 priority 组成洋葱，调用 `next()` 才进入下一层 | 最外层的返回值 | 传播给发起方 | 鉴权、租户校验、输入改写、阻断 |
| `parallel` 扇出 | 全部并发 | 结果列表，顺序同监听器顺序 | 全部完成后抛聚合异常 | 多渠道通知、并行校验 |
| `serial` 按序 | 逐个 await | 结果列表 | 首个异常处中断 | 逐步迁移、有序收尾 |
| `bail` 首值 | 逐个 await | 首个非空返回值 | 传播给发起方 | 否决、解析器链、首个匹配的 Provider |

## waterfall 即中间件

运行时本身没有业务语义：租户、鉴权、审计等强制执行点都是 base 组合包里的 `waterfall` 监听器。下面的示意按规格 §5.2 的 API 写成，类型名为举例：

```csharp
// Definition 包：定义事件并标注分发模式
public static class FileEvents
{
    public static readonly QianEvent<UploadRequest, UploadResult> Uploading =
        QianEvent.Define<UploadRequest, UploadResult>("files.uploading", DispatchMode.Waterfall);
}

// 某个插件的 ApplyAsync 里：挂一层环绕监听器，调用 next() 才进入下一层
ctx.On(FileEvents.Uploading, DispatchMode.Waterfall,
    new Func<UploadRequest, Func<ValueTask<UploadResult>>, ValueTask<UploadResult>>(async (request, next) =>
    {
        if (request.Size > MaxUploadBytes)
            throw new UploadRejectedException("超过单文件上限");
        return await next();
    }),
    priority: 100);
```

- 分发的 scope 等于发起方的 `ctx.Scope`；全局监听器对所有 scope 可见，scope 内的监听器只对该 scope 可见。
- 事件名全局唯一，两个 Definition 定义同名事件即挂载失败。
- 组件 `hooks.json` 里的 command / http 监听器由 [qian.hooks](/components/platform/qian.hooks.md) 转成同模式的进程内监听器，priority 默认 `-100`。
- 跨进程的集成事件走 [qian.events](/components/platform/qian.events.md) 的 Outbox。

详见[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.4。

# 前端 SDK

前端外壳自身也是一棵由 `@qian/runtime` 装载的插件树，与后端同一套语义：上下文、服务注册、类型化事件、可逆副作用、scope。

| 包 | 内容 |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `@qian/runtime` | 运行时：上下文 `ctx`、`provide` / `inject`、事件、副作用、装载器 |
| `@qian/plugin-sdk` | 插件开发包的前端部分：与外壳交互的桥接 API（随 qian.shell 提供，PRD §7.15） |
| `@yue/sdk` | 注册表 API、`PlatformClient`、请求拦截器链（鉴权刷新、租户头）、i18n |

- **服务键**：TS 侧小驼峰（`files`），.NET 侧大驼峰（`Files`），两侧各自声明常量，文档生成器把它们对应到同一 seam。`ctx.files` 是代理属性，等价于 `ctx.inject("files")`。
- **远程模块**：外壳 [qian.shell](/components/platform/qian.shell.md) 是 MF2 宿主，按需加载插件的远程模块；`react`、`react-dom`、`@yue/*`、`@qian/plugin-sdk` 作为共享单例。
- **插槽**：导航、设置、用户菜单、命令、预览等插槽都带版本号与输入数据 Schema。

## API 草图

节选自[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.3（以规格为准）：

```ts
export type ScopeKey = "global" | `${"tenant" | "app" | "agent-session"}:${string}`;
export type DispatchMode = "emit" | "waterfall" | "parallel" | "serial" | "bail";

export interface QianPlugin<C = unknown> {
  readonly name: string; // 组件 id
  readonly inject?: readonly ServiceKey[];
  apply(ctx: Context, config: C): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface Context {
  readonly scope: ScopeKey;
  provide<T>(key: ServiceKey<T>, value: T): Disposer;
  inject<T>(key: ServiceKey<T>): T;
  on<P, R>(evt: QianEvent<P, R>, mode: DispatchMode, handler: HandlerFor<P, R>, priority?: number): Disposer;
  dispatch<P, R>(evt: QianEvent<P, R>, payload: P): Promise<R>;
  scoped(scope: ScopeKey): Context;
}
```

组件的界面怎么写、组件怎么演示，见 [yue 组件库](/components/yue/index.md)；API 参考（TypeDoc 生成）随 S1-DOCS-002 上线。

# AI SDK

「AI SDK」是对外统一的名称，覆盖三件事：调模型、让 Agent 用上你的组件、与 Agent 运行时对接。Qian **不写 Agent loop**、沙箱、记忆与技能引擎，这些由 iClaw 提供（[ADR-016](/design/adr/adr-016-iclaw-boundary.md)）。

## 调模型与 Embedding

经[模型网关](/sdk/ai/gateway.md)的 OpenAI 兼容端点调用，用逻辑模型名（如 `chat-default`）而不是供应商的模型名；按租户的配额、限流与计量在平台侧完成，调用方不自己记账。S1 先接 LLM 与 Embedding。

## 让 Agent 用上你的组件

- **声明式表面**：skills、agents、commands、hooks、tools 写在组件文件夹里，装组件即生效，S1 就是一等公民（见[表面](/start/concepts/surface.md)、[文件格式](/cli/surfaces.md)）。
- **工具元数据**：每个工具声明 `sideEffect`、`policyHint`、`requiredScopes`、`requiredSecrets`（只写名字）、`schemaSha256` 与 `contractVersion`，与 iClaw 契约对齐；写类工具必须幂等。
- **能力目录**：工具定义由[能力目录](/sdk/dotnet/capabilities.md)机械生成，暴露哪些、怎么描述单独策划。
- **MCP**：组件可以附带 `.mcp.json`；每租户的 MCP 能力门面在 S4，见 [MCP](/sdk/ai/mcp.md)。

## 与 Agent 运行时对接

见 [Agent 运行时对接](/sdk/ai/agent-runtime.md)；隔离执行 Agent 生成的代码见[沙箱](/sdk/ai/sandbox.md)（S4）。



---
url: /sdk/ai/gateway.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /llms-full.txt.

# 模型网关

**阶段**：S1 可选（P1），由 [qian.model-gateway](/components/platform/qian.model-gateway.md) 交付；接线与运维见[模型网关接线](/ops/model-gateway.md)。

## 是什么

- 一个 OpenAI 兼容端点调所有模型：推理层 GPUStack 作为本地上游注册进 Higress，外部供应商同样注册为上游；Qian 不自写模型代理层，也不绕过 Higress 直连推理层（[ADR-015](/design/adr/adr-015-model-gateway.md)）。
- 调用方用**逻辑模型名**（如 `chat-default`），映射到具体供应商与模型的配置放在 Git 里。
- 按租户的限流与计量经 Higress 的 consumer 与统计插件完成；计量表从第一天带 `tenant_id + project_id` 双键。
- 租户级模型路由是「产品默认 + 租户覆盖」，租户的坏配置回退到默认（fail-open）；自带模型端点只能注册为 Higress 上游，应用不能直连。

## 发一条请求

```bash
curl "$MODEL_GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MODEL_GATEWAY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "chat-default", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "用一句话介绍 Qian"}]}'
```

`MODEL_GATEWAY` 与 `MODEL_GATEWAY_KEY` 由运维提供（见[模型网关接线](/ops/model-gateway.md)）。应用经租户 API Key 调用、计量进统一用量账本的方案待 S3 定（ADR-015 D15.9）；S1–S2 只保证契约形状与双键约定一致。

## 分阶段

| 阶段 | 内容 |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| S1（可选） | 上游注册、Provider Adapter、逻辑模型目录 |
| S2 | 模型目录与按用途路由 |
| S3 | 租户可见的模型门户、成本与配额预算告警 |
| S4 | Higress 托管每租户 MCP 逻辑门面 |



---
url: /sdk/ai/agent-runtime.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /llms-full.txt.

# Agent 运行时对接

Qian 不是 Agent 框架。分工（[ADR-016](/design/adr/adr-016-iclaw-boundary.md)）：

| 角色 | 负责 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Qian | 能力提供方 + 业务主数据权威：组件、能力目录、权限、审计 |
| iClaw | Agent 运行时 + AI 资产控制面：Agent loop、沙箱、记忆、技能引擎 |
| Higress | 共用数据面：模型与 MCP 流量 |
| Kun | 共用的身份、审计、Outbox 基座 |

## 接入要点

- **身份**：服务间调用用 S2S JWT，claim 形状与 iClaw 对齐（`iss / aud[] / sub / tenant_id / project_id? / roles[] / scope / session_id`，有效期不超过 300 秒，「加 scope 不加 claim」）。
- **调用路径**（S4）：Agent 不直连 Qian 服务的裸地址，一律经 Higress 的 MCP 路由；令牌绑定受众、禁止透传、最小 scope + 逐步提权；「知道 ID 不构成权限」。
- **工具**：写类工具必须幂等；工具元数据（副作用、策略提示、所需 scope 与密钥名）见 [AI SDK](/sdk/ai/index.md)。
- **生成**：Agent 生成应用 = 生成组件包，经 schema 校验、TCK、差异审阅与人工确认；生成的代码只落沙箱，并记录生成来源与审核人。

对接以 iClaw 冻结的契约与代码为准，不依赖其设计态能力。



---
url: /sdk/ai/mcp.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /llms-full.txt.

# MCP

| 能力 | 阶段 | 说明 |
| ------------------ | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 组件的 `.mcp.json` 表面 | S1 | 组件附带的 MCP 服务器随组件安装，进 `ctx.McpServers` 并受 scope 过滤；`headers` / `env` 里的密钥写成 `secretRef://`，明文密钥校验报错 |
| 文档检索 MCP | S1（可选） | 让编码代理检索本站内容 |
| 每租户 MCP 能力门面 | S4 | MCP 服务器按租户的逻辑门面托管在 Higress，而不是每个插件一个进程；工具定义由能力目录生成 |

- 协议以 MCP 2026-07-28 版为目标（无状态、`server/discover`、头部路由、可缓存列表），经 `server/discover` 兼容旧客户端（[ADR-016 D16.4](/design/adr/adr-016-iclaw-boundary.md)）。
- 网关按 `Mcp-Method` / `Mcp-Name` 头路由，敏感参数不进头部（[ADR-010](/design/adr/adr-010-gateway-layers.md)）。
- `.mcp.json` 的文件格式见[声明式表面的文件格式](/cli/surfaces.md)。

# 沙箱

**阶段**：S4，尚未开始。

- Qian 不写沙箱。S4 对接 CubeSandbox（E2B 兼容 API）隔离执行不可信或 Agent 生成的代码（[ADR-016 D16.2](/design/adr/adr-016-iclaw-boundary.md)）。
- 在此之前，第三方代码不进共享进程：按信任等级限定运行形态，函数类代码走 Wasm 沙箱（`function` 表面，S2 起），界面走浏览器隔离（[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §11）。
- Agent 生成的代码只落在 `function` 沙箱里（ADR-016 D16.11）。

### Classes

[KunExceptionHandler](/sdk/api/kun/kun-aspnetcore-exceptionhandling/kunexceptionhandler.md)

Global exception handler that translates Kun-specific exceptions into
RFC 7807 ProblemDetails responses.

- [ValidationException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation/validationexception.md) → 400 Bad Request with validation errors.
- [ResultFailureException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/resultfailureexception.md) → mapped via [ErrorToProblemDetailsExtensions.ToProblemDetails](/sdk/api/kun/kun-aspnetcore-mapping/errortoproblemdetailsextensions.md#Kun_AspNetCore_Mapping_ErrorToProblemDetailsExtensions_ToProblemDetails_Kun_Core_Results_Error_).
- [DomainException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/domainexception.md) → 400 Bad Request with the domain error code.
- All other exceptions → rethrown for the default handler to produce 500.

# Class AuditableAttribute

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Audit.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Declarative marker for Command / Query / endpoint types that should be
audited regardless of whether their execution touched any tracked
aggregate. Interceptor-driven audits handle entity CRUD automatically;
this attribute covers the other category — business actions whose
significance isn't visible in the change-tracker (e.g. login,
download, export, permission grant).

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class|AttributeTargets.Method, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class AuditableAttribute : Attribute
```

The attribute is consumed by consumer-side Mediator pipeline behaviors
/ endpoint filters. Kun.Audit itself does not ship an interceptor for
this attribute so that applications stay free to choose their
dispatch framework. A sample wiring lives in the framework docs.

Does not alter serialization or persistence — only metadata.

# Interface IAuditWriter

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Audit` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Audit`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Audit)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Audit.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Persists or publishes an [AuditLog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md) entry.

```csharp
public interface IAuditWriter
```

## Remarks

The default implementation in this assembly is
[NullAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/nullauditwriter.md) (drops entries), so interceptor wiring
is safe even when no audit backend has been configured. Production
deployments register one of:

- `EfAuditWriter` (from `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore`) — synchronous DB insert inside the business transaction.
- [EventBusAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/eventbusauditwriter.md) — stages the entry on the Outbox as a `kun.audit.record.v1` integration event.
- Custom implementations (SIEM forwarder, file-append, …).

Implementations should be idempotent with respect to [AuditLog.Id](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md#Kun_Audit_AuditLog_Id):
interceptor re-entry (EF Core retries, transient failures followed by
Outbox replay) must not duplicate audit rows.

## Methods

# Class AuditLogPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Audit` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Audit`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Audit)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Audit.Behaviors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-behaviors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Mediator pipeline behaviour that records one [AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md) per handler
invocation and appends it to the per-tenant hash chain. Chain-state mutation and
the [IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditsink.md) write are serialised inside
[IAuditChainState.AppendAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditchainstate.md#Kun_Audit_IAuditChainState_AppendAsync_System_String_System_Func_System_String_System_Threading_Tasks_ValueTask_System_String___System_Threading_CancellationToken_) so concurrent commands on the same
tenant cannot fork the chain.

```csharp
public sealed class AuditLogPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
```

#### Type Parameters

`TRequest`

`TResponse`

#### Inheritance

[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Failure handling: if the handler throws, the original exception is preserved and
rethrown _after_ the audit write so the audit row exists and records
[AuditOutcome.Exception](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditoutcome.md#Kun_Audit_AuditOutcome_Exception). If the audit write itself fails (sink error,
chain-state lock abandoned), the failure is logged at warning level and swallowed
— audit must never convert a successful business outcome into an error nor replace
the handler's own exception with an audit-pipeline one.

Registered explicitly per command type via
[KunAuditServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAuditBehavior](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-dependencyinjection/kunauditservicecollectionextensions.md#Kun_Audit_DependencyInjection_KunAuditServiceCollectionExtensions_AddAuditBehavior__2_Kun_Mediator_KunMediatorBuilder_)
so queries are not audited by default.

## Remarks

Change metadata is captured in [AuditSaveChangesInterceptor.SavingChangesAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-entityframeworkcore/auditsavechangesinterceptor.md#Kun_Audit_EntityFrameworkCore_AuditSaveChangesInterceptor_SavingChangesAsync_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_DbContextEventData_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_InterceptionResult_System_Int32__System_Threading_CancellationToken_)
(before EF finalises keys, so we have the original / current values)
and replayed into [IAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditwriter.md) after
`SaveChangesAsync` succeeds. This ordering avoids two hazards:

- An audit-writer exception no longer rolls back the business transaction (unless the consumer sets [KunAuditOptions.SwallowWriterExceptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-dependencyinjection/kunauditoptions.md#Kun_Audit_DependencyInjection_KunAuditOptions_SwallowWriterExceptions) to [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool)).
- Server-generated primary keys (PostgreSQL `IDENTITY`, DB-side GUIDs) are populated on the entity by the time we read them, so [AuditLog.ResourceId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md#Kun_Audit_AuditLog_ResourceId) is never blank.

No reflection is used: the interceptor only inspects
[`ChangeTracker`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.changetracking.changetracker) entries and Kun.Core marker interfaces.
Payload JSON is built with [`Utf8JsonWriter`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.utf8jsonwriter) so the
interceptor stays portable to a future AOT-candidate module.

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

The result that EF will use.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

#### Remarks

This method is still called if an interceptor suppressed creation of a command in [`SavingChangesAsync`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.isavechangesinterceptor.savingchangesasync).
In this case, `result` is the result returned by [`SavingChangesAsync`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.isavechangesinterceptor.savingchangesasync).

## Remarks

Does **not** call [`SaveChangesAsync`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext.savechangesasync).
When invoked from inside [AuditSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-entityframeworkcore/auditsavechangesinterceptor.md),
the outer EF `SaveChanges` commits the audit rows atomically
with the business change. When invoked standalone (e.g. from a
Mediator pipeline behavior) the caller is responsible for flushing.

### AppendAsync(string?, Func\<string?, ValueTask\<string>>, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Audit_EntityFrameworkCore_PostgresAuditChain_AppendAsync_System_String_System_Func_System_String_System_Threading_Tasks_ValueTask_System_String___System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Appends one entry to the tenant's chain. Within `computeNewHash`
the caller should build the [AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md), call
[AuditContentHasher.Compute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditcontenthasher.md#Kun_Audit_AuditContentHasher_Compute_Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_) with the supplied previous hash, and
return the freshly computed hash. The implementation guarantees the
read-compute-write sequence is serialised per `tenantKey`
so concurrent commands on the same tenant do not fork the chain.

```csharp
public ValueTask<string> AppendAsync(string? tenantKey, Func<string?, ValueTask<string>> computeNewHash, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`tenantKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Tenant identifier, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) for the shared/global chain.

`computeNewHash` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?, [ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>>

Factory that, given the previous hash (or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the chain is empty),
produces the new [AuditEntry.ContentHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_ContentHash). May perform the sink write.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

The new content hash, now stored as the chain tip.

Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Canonicalises audit-entry fields and chains them with SHA-256:
`hash = sha256(prevHash || canonical(entryFields))`.
The output is lower-case hex so it is safe to embed in DB columns, URLs,
and Markdown tables without re-encoding.

```csharp
public static class AuditContentHasher
```

# Class AuditEntry

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Audit](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Immutable record describing one audited command execution. Each entry is
part of a per-tenant hash chain: [AuditEntry.ContentHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_ContentHash) covers this entry
plus the [AuditEntry.PrevHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_PrevHash) of the previous entry in the same chain,
so retroactive tampering with any row invalidates every following row.

```csharp
public sealed record AuditEntry : IEquatable<AuditEntry>
```

Namespace: [Kun.Audit](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Canonical audit-log record emitted by the framework on business-relevant
state changes (aggregate create / update / delete, explicit
[AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/auditableattribute.md) invocations, login events, …).

```csharp
public sealed class AuditLog : IMultiTenant
```

## Remarks

[AuditLog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md) is a persistence-agnostic POCO. ORM mapping (table
name, column types, indexes, immutability triggers) lives in
`Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore/AuditLogConfiguration.cs` — no EF /
JSON attributes are placed here so the type stays Core-layer friendly.

Implements [IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) so that when consumers store audit
rows inside a `KunDbContext`-derived context, the automatic tenant
global query filter isolates tenant A's audits from tenant B's without
extra configuration. Consumers that run audits on a dedicated database
can ignore this interface.

# Class EventBusAuditWriter

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Audit` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Audit`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Audit)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.Audit](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

[IAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditwriter.md) that fans audit entries out as
`kun.audit.record.v1` integration events via
[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md), riding the consumer's Outbox for
atomicity with the business transaction.

```csharp
[Obsolete("kun.audit.record.v1 已废弃；实体审计请迁移到 Kun.Auditing.AddKunAuditing<TContext>()。", DiagnosticId = "KUNAUDIT001")]
public sealed class EventBusAuditWriter : IAuditWriter
```

## Remarks

Consumers must register [AuditLog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md) in their event type
registry under the stable id `kun.audit.record.v1` and register
the corresponding `JsonTypeInfo` in their
`JsonSerializerContext` — Kun does not own the consumer's JSON
context and therefore cannot register the type itself.

Because this writer stages an Outbox message, audit fan-out joins the
business unit-of-work: if the business transaction rolls back, the
audit integration event is rolled back as well. This is the intended
atomicity guarantee. Consumers who want fire-and-forget semantics
should implement a custom [IAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditwriter.md).

# Interface IAuditChainState

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Audit` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Audit`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Audit)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Audit](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Maintains the rolling tip of the per-tenant audit hash chain. The interface
exposes a single atomic "acquire-previous, compute-new, commit-new" operation
so implementations are free to centralise the lock, the durable read, and the
write in one transaction.

```csharp
public interface IAuditChainState
```

## Methods

### AppendAsync(string?, Func\<string?, ValueTask\<string>>, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Audit_IAuditChainState_AppendAsync_System_String_System_Func_System_String_System_Threading_Tasks_ValueTask_System_String___System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Appends one entry to the tenant's chain. Within `computeNewHash`
the caller should build the [AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md), call
[AuditContentHasher.Compute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditcontenthasher.md#Kun_Audit_AuditContentHasher_Compute_Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_) with the supplied previous hash, and
return the freshly computed hash. The implementation guarantees the
read-compute-write sequence is serialised per `tenantKey`
so concurrent commands on the same tenant do not fork the chain.

```csharp
ValueTask<string> AppendAsync(string? tenantKey, Func<string?, ValueTask<string>> computeNewHash, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`tenantKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Tenant identifier, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) for the shared/global chain.

`computeNewHash` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?, [ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>>

Factory that, given the previous hash (or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the chain is empty),
produces the new [AuditEntry.ContentHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_ContentHash). May perform the sink write.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

The new content hash, now stored as the chain tip.

# Interface IAuditSink

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Audit` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Audit`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Audit)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Audit](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Audit.dll

Pluggable write target for audit entries. Implementations decide where
entries land (DB table, append-only log file, remote audit service) and
how durable the write is. The pipeline behaviour surrounds calls to this
interface with the per-tenant chain-state lock, so implementations may
treat writes as already serialised within a tenant.

```csharp
public interface IAuditSink
```

### Classes

[AuditActorType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditactortype.md)

Well-known values for [AuditLog.ActorType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md#Kun_Audit_AuditLog_ActorType). These are
free-form strings by schema — the constants here are the vocabulary
the framework emits, but consumers may introduce additional actor
types (e.g. `"agent"`) without coordinating with Kun.

[AuditContentHasher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditcontenthasher.md)

Canonicalises audit-entry fields and chains them with SHA-256:
`hash = sha256(prevHash || canonical(entryFields))`.
The output is lower-case hex so it is safe to embed in DB columns, URLs,
and Markdown tables without re-encoding.

[AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md)

Immutable record describing one audited command execution. Each entry is
part of a per-tenant hash chain: [AuditEntry.ContentHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_ContentHash) covers this entry
plus the [AuditEntry.PrevHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_PrevHash) of the previous entry in the same chain,
so retroactive tampering with any row invalidates every following row.

[AuditLog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditlog.md)

Canonical audit-log record emitted by the framework on business-relevant
state changes (aggregate create / update / delete, explicit
[AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/auditableattribute.md) invocations, login events, …).

[AuditQuery](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditquery.md)

Filter + pagination parameters for [IAuditReader.QueryAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditreader.md#Kun_Audit_Abstractions_IAuditReader_QueryAsync_Kun_Audit_AuditQuery_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).
Filters combine with `AND`; unset filters match anything.

[EventBusAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/eventbusauditwriter.md)

[IAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditwriter.md) that fans audit entries out as
`kun.audit.record.v1` integration events via
[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md), riding the consumer's Outbox for
atomicity with the business transaction.

[InMemoryAuditChainState](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/inmemoryauditchainstate.md)

Process-local [IAuditChainState](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditchainstate.md). Serialises read-compute-write
per tenant with a [`SemaphoreSlim`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.semaphoreslim). Suitable for tests and
single-instance deployments; multi-instance deployments should back the
chain state with a durable store and DB-level uniqueness so two replicas
cannot fork the chain.

[InMemoryAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/inmemoryauditsink.md)

Process-local [IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditsink.md) that keeps all written entries in
memory. Intended for unit tests and non-durable development; do not use in
production because entries are lost on process restart and there is no
durability guarantee if the process crashes mid-write.

[NullAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/nullauditwriter.md)

[IAuditWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit-abstractions/iauditwriter.md) that silently drops every entry. Registered as
the fallback when no concrete writer has been configured so that
interceptor / pipeline wiring stays safe in tests and samples.

[IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditsink.md)

Pluggable write target for audit entries. Implementations decide where
entries land (DB table, append-only log file, remote audit service) and
how durable the write is. The pipeline behaviour surrounds calls to this
interface with the per-tenant chain-state lock, so implementations may
treat writes as already serialised within a tenant.

### Enums

[AuditOutcome](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditoutcome.md)

Outcome of a command execution captured in an [AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md).

Process-local [IAuditChainState](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/iauditchainstate.md). Serialises read-compute-write
per tenant with a [`SemaphoreSlim`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.semaphoreslim). Suitable for tests and
single-instance deployments; multi-instance deployments should back the
chain state with a durable store and DB-level uniqueness so two replicas
cannot fork the chain.

### AppendAsync(string?, Func\<string?, ValueTask\<string>>, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Audit_InMemoryAuditChainState_AppendAsync_System_String_System_Func_System_String_System_Threading_Tasks_ValueTask_System_String___System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Appends one entry to the tenant's chain. Within `computeNewHash`
the caller should build the [AuditEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md), call
[AuditContentHasher.Compute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditcontenthasher.md#Kun_Audit_AuditContentHasher_Compute_Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_) with the supplied previous hash, and
return the freshly computed hash. The implementation guarantees the
read-compute-write sequence is serialised per `tenantKey`
so concurrent commands on the same tenant do not fork the chain.

```csharp
public ValueTask<string> AppendAsync(string? tenantKey, Func<string?, ValueTask<string>> computeNewHash, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`tenantKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Tenant identifier, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) for the shared/global chain.

`computeNewHash` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?, [ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>>

Factory that, given the previous hash (or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the chain is empty),
produces the new [AuditEntry.ContentHash](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditentry.md#Kun_Audit_AuditEntry_ContentHash). May perform the sink write.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

The new content hash, now stored as the chain tip.

memory. Intended for unit tests and non-durable development; do not use in
production because entries are lost on process restart and there is no

## Remarks

**Explicit registration (plan A3 path c)**. Auditable entity types must be declared
up front via [AuditingServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAuditable](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-dependencyinjection/auditingservicecollectionextensions.md#Kun_Auditing_DependencyInjection_AuditingServiceCollectionExtensions_AddAuditable__1_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_); the
[AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditableattribute.md) marker on the entity class is not sufficient — it is
docs-only and never scanned at runtime. This design eliminates reflection and keeps
the module AOT-publish-clean.

```csharp
           .UseKunSchema("catalog")

```

### AddKunAuditing(IServiceCollection) \{#Kun_Auditing_DependencyInjection_AuditingServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunAuditing_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection\_}

Registers audit infrastructure into `services`: the registry, the
default outbox-backed [IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditsink.md), the EF interceptor, the request-scoped
[AuditContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md), and the [AuditContextMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-middleware/auditcontextmiddleware.md).

#### Returns

#### Remarks

Consumers must also:

- Call `AddAuditable<TEntity>()` for each auditable entity type.
- Register the stable event id with `AddKunEventBus(b => b.RegisterAuditing())`.
- Attach the interceptor to the relevant DbContext via `options.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor>())` or use [AuditingServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAuditingInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-dependencyinjection/auditingservicecollectionextensions.md#Kun_Auditing_DependencyInjection_AuditingServiceCollectionExtensions_AddAuditingInterceptor_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_DbContextOptionsBuilder_System_IServiceProvider_) on the [`DbContextOptionsBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder).
- Mount [AuditContextMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-middleware/auditcontextmiddleware.md) into the ASP.NET Core pipeline.

Integration event emitted by [AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md) for every
tracked mutation of an entity registered via `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`.

# Class AuditContextMiddleware

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Auditing` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Auditing`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Auditing)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.Auditing.Middleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-middleware/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Auditing.dll

ASP.NET Core middleware that populates the request-scoped [AuditContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md)
with data captured from the incoming [`HttpContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.httpcontext): remote IP,
User-Agent header, and the current W3C trace id.

```csharp
public sealed class AuditContextMiddleware : IMiddleware
```

[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Registered via `services.AddKunAuditing()` as scoped, then mounted into the
pipeline with `app.UseMiddleware<AuditContextMiddleware>()` before any
command / unit-of-work that must emit audit events.

The middleware only captures transport-level metadata. Actor identity
([AuditContext.ActorId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md#Kun_Auditing_AuditContext_ActorId) / [AuditContext.ActorType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md#Kun_Auditing_AuditContext_ActorType)) is populated
downstream — e.g. by a `JwtCurrentUser` bridge — because those values depend on
the service-to-service auth pipeline which runs after request routing.

## Remarks

This attribute is **not** read at runtime. The audit interceptor consults the
DI-populated [IAuditableEntityRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditableentityregistry.md) to decide whether a tracked
entity participates in auditing. Registration is explicit via
`services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()` — the only runtime source of truth.

The attribute exists so that the intent is visible on the type itself (helpful for
code review and docs), but adding or removing it has no effect on the running
system. This design (plan A3 path c) eliminates reflection-based entity discovery
and keeps `Kun.Auditing` AOT-publish-clean.

## Remarks

All fields are nullable and default to [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null); the middleware (or any
caller) populates them before the command handler opens its unit of work. The
interceptor does not fill in defaults — missing fields surface as [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null)
on the emitted [AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md), which is the expected
behaviour for background jobs and other hosts without an HTTP context.

# Class AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Auditing` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Auditing`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Auditing)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Auditing](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Auditing.dll

EF Core [`ISaveChangesInterceptor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.isavechangesinterceptor) that emits one
[AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md) per tracked change of an entity type registered
via `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`. The event is forwarded to
[IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditsink.md) (default: outbox writer) so it commits atomically with the
ambient `SaveChangesAsync` transaction.

```csharp
public sealed class AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor : ISaveChangesInterceptor, IInterceptor
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md)

#### Implements

[ISaveChangesInterceptor](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.isavechangesinterceptor),
[IInterceptor](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.iinterceptor)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),

[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

**AOT guarantee**: membership is decided purely by [IAuditableEntityRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditableentityregistry.md)
— `entry.Entity.GetType()` is matched against a [`FrozenSet`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.frozen.frozenset-1)
of types. No runtime reflection over [AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditableattribute.md) is performed.

Scoped lifetime — the interceptor resolves the scoped [AuditContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md) and
writes to a scoped [IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditsink.md).

### SavingChanges(DbContextEventData, InterceptionResult\<int>) \{#Kun_Auditing_AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor_SavingChanges_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_DbContextEventData_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_InterceptionResult_System_Int32\_\_}

`result` [InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

Represents the current result if one exists.
This value will have [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if some previous
interceptor suppressed execution by calling [`SuppressWithResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.suppresswithresult).
This value is typically used as the return value for the implementation of this method.

#### Returns

[InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is false, the EF will continue as normal.
If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

# Interface IAuditableEntityRegistry

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Auditing` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Auditing`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Auditing)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Auditing](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Auditing.dll

Immutable, DI-populated lookup of entity CLR types that participate in audit logging.
Populated at [`IServiceCollection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)
build time by calls to `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`.

```csharp
public interface IAuditableEntityRegistry
```

## Remarks

The registry is the single runtime source of truth for auditable entities —
[AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditableattribute.md) is never read at runtime. Backing storage is a
[`FrozenSet`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.frozen.frozenset-1) so membership checks inside the
EF interceptor are O(1).

## Properties

### RegisteredTypes \{#Kun_Auditing_IAuditableEntityRegistry_RegisteredTypes}

`services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`. Frozen, case-sensitive type identity.

```csharp
IReadOnlySet<Type> RegisteredTypes { get; }
```

# Interface IAuditSink

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Auditing` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Auditing`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Auditing)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Auditing](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Auditing.dll

Terminal destination for [AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md) records produced by
[AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md). The default implementation forwards to
[IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) so audit events flow atomically with
the current `SaveChangesAsync` transaction.

```csharp
public interface IAuditSink
```

## Remarks

Custom sinks (e.g. a direct-write ClickHouse adapter) must preserve the atomicity
contract: anything that can fail outside the ambient transaction defeats the audit
reliability guarantee. Prefer layering a decorator over the outbox sink instead of
replacing it.

## Methods

### WriteAsync(AuditEventIntegrationEvent, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Auditing_IAuditSink_WriteAsync_Kun_Auditing_Events_AuditEventIntegrationEvent_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Enqueues `event` for durable delivery. Implementations must be
safe to call from within EF Core's `SavingChangesAsync` interceptor phase —
no I/O, no blocking waits.

```csharp
ValueTask WriteAsync(AuditEventIntegrationEvent @event, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

#### Parameters

`event` [AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md)

The audit event to persist.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token forwarded from EF Core.

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask)

### Classes

[AuditContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditcontext.md)

Request-scoped DTO that carries ambient audit context from the outer host
([AuditContextMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-middleware/auditcontextmiddleware.md)) into the EF Core
[AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md).

[AuditableAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditableattribute.md)

Documentation-only marker for entity types that should emit
[AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md) rows on every
`SaveChangesAsync`.

[AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md)

EF Core [`ISaveChangesInterceptor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.isavechangesinterceptor) that emits one
[AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md) per tracked change of an entity type registered
via `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`. The event is forwarded to
[IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditsink.md) (default: outbox writer) so it commits atomically with the
ambient `SaveChangesAsync` transaction.

[TransactionalAuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/transactionalauditingsavechangesinterceptor.md)

在业务上下文中同时暂存 AuditLog 与 Outbox，任何一方失败均使整个保存失败。

### Interfaces

[IAuditSink](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/iauditsink.md)

Terminal destination for [AuditEventIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing-events/auditeventintegrationevent.md) records produced by
[AuditingSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-auditing/auditingsavechangesinterceptor.md). The default implementation forwards to
[IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) so audit events flow atomically with
the current `SaveChangesAsync` transaction.

build time by calls to `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()`.

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

### Classes

[AuthorizationSubject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/authorizationsubject.md)

统一授权主体；权限集合不从令牌直接推导。

[DataPermissionPredicate](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/datapermissionpredicate.md)

可序列化的字段谓词 AST，SQL 编译与参数绑定由 Provider 实现。

[FieldDecision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/fielddecision.md)

字段可读、可写与需要脱敏的集合。

[PermissionDecision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/permissiondecision.md)

可解释判定；Allow=false 是缺省语义。

[PermissionRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/permissionrequest.md)

权限点与可选资源实例；Permission 使用稳定的资源动作编码。

[RequiresPermissionAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/requirespermissionattribute.md)

HTTP/gRPC 端点的静态权限元数据。

本地数据过滤端口，不依赖 EF 包或具体数据库。

# Interface IKunCache

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Caching` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Caching`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Caching)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Caching.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Caching.dll

Unified cache abstraction for Kun Framework consumers. Implementations
back to an in-process [`IMemoryCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.memory.imemorycache)
or to a distributed [`IDistributedCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.distributed.idistributedcache)
(Redis via StackExchange) — see
`Kun.Caching.Implementations.MemoryKunCache` and
`Kun.Caching.Implementations.RedisKunCache`.

```csharp
public interface IKunCache
```

## Remarks

The generic methods are annotated with
[`RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.codeanalysis.requiresunreferencedcodeattribute) and
[`RequiresDynamicCodeAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.codeanalysis.requiresdynamiccodeattribute) because the default
`System.Text.Json`-backed serializer walks the type argument
by reflection. AOT-strict consumers can replace the default
serializer with a source-generated implementation; see
[IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md).

## Methods

### GetOrSetAsync\<T>(string, Func\<CancellationToken, Task\<T>>, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Caching_Abstractions_IKunCache_GetOrSetAsync__1_System_String_System_Func_System_Threading_CancellationToken_System_Threading_Tasks_Task___0___System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Returns the cached value, invoking `factory` exactly
once under concurrent access on the same process when the key is
absent. The produced value is written to the cache under
`key` before being returned.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Default serializer uses reflection. Pass a source-generated IKunCacheSerializer for AOT safety.")]
[RequiresDynamicCode("Default serializer uses reflection. Pass a source-generated IKunCacheSerializer for AOT safety.")]
Task<T> GetOrSetAsync<T>(string key, Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> factory, TimeSpan? ttl = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`key` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

`factory` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken), [Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<T>>

`ttl` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<T>

#### Type Parameters

`T`

#### Remarks

Single-flight protection is local to the process — cross-process
stampedes can still occur. Use an external distributed lock for
that scenario.

# Interface IKunCacheSerializer

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Caching.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Caching.dll

Pluggable serializer used by the Redis-backed cache to convert
cache entries to and from byte arrays. The default registration is
`Kun.Caching.Implementations.SystemTextJsonCacheSerializer`,
which is reflection-based; AOT-strict consumers provide a
source-generated implementation.

```csharp
public interface IKunCacheSerializer
```

### DefaultTtl \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_DefaultTtl}

TTL applied to `SetAsync` / `GetOrSetAsync` calls that
omit an explicit `ttl`. [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) (default)
means entries never expire when no explicit TTL is given.

```csharp
public TimeSpan? DefaultTtl { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

### FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), the Redis backend swallows
connection / socket exceptions and routes reads and writes to a
sidecar in-memory cache for the duration of the outage. The
exception is logged at `Warning` and never propagated.
Default is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool); callers see the exception
and decide.

```csharp
public bool FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### KeyPrefix \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_KeyPrefix}

Prefix prepended to every key passed to the cache. Ideal for
namespacing per-service caches on a shared Redis. Empty / null
means no prefix (default).

```csharp
public string? KeyPrefix { get; set; }
```

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

# Namespace Kun.Caching.Implementations

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Caching` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Caching`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Caching)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

### Classes

[MemoryKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/memorykuncache.md)

In-process [IKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncache.md) backed by
[`IMemoryCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.memory.imemorycache). Stores values directly — no
serialization round-trip — so mutations on cached reference
types are visible to other consumers. Callers that care about
isolation should cache immutable records or value types.

[RedisKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/rediskuncache.md)

Distributed [IKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncache.md) backed by an
[`IDistributedCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.distributed.idistributedcache) instance (typically
`Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.StackExchangeRedis`). Values are
serialized via the registered [IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md).

[SystemTextJsonCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/systemtextjsoncacheserializer.md)

Default [IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md) backed by
[`JsonSerializer`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonserializer). Uses web-style options (camelCase,
case-insensitive reads) and respects the caller's
[`JsonSerializerOptions`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonserializeroptions) when supplied.

### GetOrSetAsync\<T>(string, Func\<CancellationToken, Task\<T>>, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Caching_Implementations_MemoryKunCache_GetOrSetAsync__1_System_String_System_Func_System_Threading_CancellationToken_System_Threading_Tasks_Task___0___System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Returns the cached value, invoking `factory` exactly
once under concurrent access on the same process when the key is
absent. The produced value is written to the cache under
`key` before being returned.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("IKunCache.GetOrSetAsync contract.")]
[RequiresDynamicCode("IKunCache.GetOrSetAsync contract.")]

```

#### Returns

#### Type Parameters

`T`

#### Remarks

Single-flight protection is local to the process — cross-process
stampedes can still occur. Use an external distributed lock for
that scenario.

## Remarks

When `KunCachingOptions.FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure = true`,
connection / socket failures are swallowed and the operation is
routed to an in-memory sidecar cache for the duration of the
outage. The fallback is per-process; other replicas will not see
writes made while Redis is unreachable.

Validates that the string value is non-null and non-whitespace.
Combine with [RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key
must also be present in the configuration tree — by itself this
attribute accepts [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

[RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md)

[`RequiredAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.dataannotations.requiredattribute) tuned for configuration errors —
rejects [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) values and produces an error
message that names the missing key rather than the generic
"field is required" text.

[UrlConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/urlconfigattribute.md)

Validates that the string value parses as an absolute URI via
[`TryCreate`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uri.trycreate). Accepts
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) — pair with
[RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key is mandatory.

# Class RequiredConfigAttribute

:::info 生成页

Assembly: Kun.Configuration.dll

[`RequiredAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.dataannotations.requiredattribute) tuned for configuration errors —
rejects [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) values and produces an error
message that names the missing key rather than the generic
"field is required" text.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false)]
public sealed class RequiredConfigAttribute : RequiredAttribute
```

# Class AggregateRoot\<TKey, TUserKey>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Domain](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

DDD 聚合根基类。

聚合根是领域一致性边界的持有者，所有外部修改必须通过聚合根的公开方法进行。
持久化细节（ORM 属性、表映射）一律不在此类出现——它们属于基础设施层的职责。

```csharp

```

# Class DomainException

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Domain](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Base exception for systemic domain-level failures that are not expressible via `Result<T>`.

Kun handler code should prefer [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md) for business failures.
`DomainException` is reserved for exceptional states the framework itself surfaces
(concurrency conflicts, repository contract violations, infrastructure-level faults).

```csharp
public abstract class DomainException : Exception, ISerializable
```

# Interface IDomainEventDispatcher

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Domain](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Dispatches domain events to their in-process handlers.

Called by the Unit of Work immediately before persistence commits, so handlers run inside
the same EF Core transaction that produced the aggregate changes. For cross-service events,
handlers translate the domain event into an [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md) and enqueue it
via the Outbox.

```csharp
public interface IDomainEventDispatcher
```

# Namespace Kun.Core.Domain

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[AggregateRoot\<TKey, TUserKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/aggregateroot-2.md)

DDD 聚合根基类。

聚合根是领域一致性边界的持有者，所有外部修改必须通过聚合根的公开方法进行。
持久化细节（ORM 属性、表映射）一律不在此类出现——它们属于基础设施层的职责。

[AggregateRoot\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/aggregateroot-1.md)

便捷重载：审计用户 ID 默认为 [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)。

[DomainException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/domainexception.md)

Base exception for systemic domain-level failures that are not expressible via `Result<T>`.

Kun handler code should prefer [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md) for business failures.
`DomainException` is reserved for exceptional states the framework itself surfaces
(concurrency conflicts, repository contract violations, infrastructure-level faults).

[Entity\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/entity-1.md)

DDD 实体基类。实体的相等性由 [Entity\<TKey>.Id](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/entity-1.md#Kun_Core_Domain_Entity_1_Id) 决定，而非属性集合（这是实体与值对象的核心区别）。

[ValueObject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/valueobject.md)

DDD 值对象基类。值对象没有独立标识，相等性由其所有组成属性决定。
值对象应当是不可变的——修改应返回新实例，而非改变现有实例。

### Interfaces

[IAggregateRoot\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iaggregateroot-1.md)

带强类型 Key 的聚合根标记接口。

[IAggregateRoot](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iaggregateroot.md)

聚合根标记接口（非泛型）。用于框架内部通过 `ChangeTracker` 按类型筛选。

[IAuditedObject\<TUserKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iauditedobject-1.md)

带用户标识的审计接口。
`TUserKey` 可以是 [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)、[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/reference-types)、[long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/integral-numeric-types) 等，
以兼容本地用户、外部 IdP 的 `sub`、数据库自增等不同场景。

[IAuditedObject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iauditedobject.md)

通用审计接口，记录创建/修改时间。

[IDomainEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomainevent.md)

标记领域事件。领域事件由聚合根内部产生，表示业务上发生的重要事实。
领域事件仅在聚合根边界内同步分发；若需跨服务传递，请在事件处理器中
转换为 [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md)。

[IDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomaineventdispatcher.md)

Dispatches domain events to their in-process handlers.

Called by the Unit of Work immediately before persistence commits, so handlers run inside
the same EF Core transaction that produced the aggregate changes. For cross-service events,
handlers translate the domain event into an [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md) and enqueue it
via the Outbox.

[IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md)

集成事件标记接口。集成事件用于跨服务、跨进程的异步通知，
与领域事件不同，集成事件通过 Outbox + 消息总线传递，具备版本演进能力。

[IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md)

标记实体支持多租户隔离。由 `KunDbContext` 自动附加 `TenantId` 全局过滤器。

[ISoftDelete](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/isoftdelete.md)

标记实体支持软删除。由基础设施层在持久化时挂载全局查询过滤器。

# Interface ITenantProvisioner

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Core.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

租户生命周期钩子：开户（[ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)）与注销（[ITenantProvisioner.DeprovisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_DeprovisionAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)）。

```csharp
public interface ITenantProvisioner
```

## Remarks

Shared 策略不需要具体实现 —— 新租户只是多一行 `TenantId` 的业务记录。消费者只需要注册
[NullTenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/nulltenantprovisioner.md)（或依赖框架提供的 Singleton 默认值）。

SchemaPerTenant 与 DatabasePerTenant 策略依赖本接口的非空实现：在租户开户时分别创建 schema
或独立数据库，并在该隔离容器内运行 EF Core migrations。实现必须是**幂等的** ——
使用 `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS` / `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS` 语义；
重复调用不得产生副作用。

调用时机由业务方控制；框架不做自动编排。典型场景：租户 signup API 成功创建租户记录后，
同事务（或补偿事务）里调用 [ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)；租户注销走反向流程。

# Enum TenantIsolationStrategy

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

SaaS 多租户数据隔离策略。由 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy` 层在运行时解析成
具体的 DbContext 构造、迁移调度与连接解析行为。

```csharp
public enum TenantIsolationStrategy
```

## Fields

`DatabasePerTenant = 2`

每租户独立数据库实例（通常也是独立连接字符串、独立备份、独立 RPO/RTO）。
适用：合规要求强（医疗/金融 GDPR 数据主权）、租户数量 \<= 数百但单租户数据量大。

`SchemaPerTenant = 1`

同库不同 schema，每个租户有独立 schema。逻辑隔离更强、备份粒度到租户；需要运行时
按 `ITenantContext.TenantId` 切 `DefaultSchema` 与 `MigrationsHistoryTable`。
适用：合规要求中等（如数据可"单租户导出"）、租户数量 \<= 数千。

`Shared = 0`

所有租户同库同 schema，用 `IMultiTenant` 实体的 `TenantId` 列 + 全局查询
过滤器做应用层隔离，叠加 PostgreSQL RLS（`AddKunTenantRls()`）做 defence-in-depth。
适用：租户数量大但单租户数据量小、合规要求普通的 B2B SaaS。

## Remarks

Part 1（2026-04-23）只落地枚举本身 + 配套契约类型；[TenantIsolationStrategy.SchemaPerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_SchemaPerTenant) 与
[TenantIsolationStrategy.DatabasePerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_DatabasePerTenant) 的运行时实现分别延后到 P2-D Part 2 / Part 3。
详细取舍见 `docs/architecture/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md`。

错误分类，用于映射到 HTTP/gRPC 状态码。

```csharp
public enum ErrorType
```

## Fields

`Conflict = 3`

State conflict (e.g. duplicate, optimistic concurrency).

`Failure = 0`

Generic unclassified failure.

`Forbidden = 5`

Caller is authenticated but not permitted.

`NotFound = 2`

Requested resource was not found.

`Unauthorized = 4`

Caller is not authenticated.

`Unavailable = 6`

A dependency is temporarily unavailable.

`Validation = 1`

Input validation failure.
