# Namespace Kun.Core.Results

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/error.md)

强类型错误。相比抛异常，[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/error.md) 是显式的、可测试的失败信号，
也更符合 CQRS Handler 的函数式风格。

[ResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/resultextensions.md)

Synchronous railway-oriented extensions for [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) and
[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

[ResultFailureException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/resultfailureexception.md)

由 gRPC 拦截器识别并翻译为 `RpcException`。

[TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md)

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)
receivers whose result type is [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or
[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

[ValueTaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/valuetaskresultextensions.md)

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) receivers whose result type is
[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011;
mirror of [TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) for hot paths that
avoid [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task) allocation (Mediator pipeline, Saga step
executors).

### Structs

[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)

带返回值的 Result。Handler 成功时携带 `T`，失败时携带 [Result\<T>.Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md#Kun_Core_Results_Result_1_Error)。

[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md)

无返回值的 Result。Handler 在不需要返回数据时使用。

### Enums

[ErrorType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/errortype.md)

错误分类，用于映射到 HTTP/gRPC 状态码。

[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

## Remarks

Every method short-circuits on failure inputs: the supplied delegate is
**not** invoked and the original [Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/error.md) is carried through
unchanged. See `docs/architecture/ADR-011-Result-async-extensions.md`
for normative semantics, naming rationale, and async counterparts on
`Task<Result>` / `ValueTask<Result>` sources.

# Class TaskResultExtensions

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Results](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)
receivers whose result type is [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or
[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

```csharp
public static class TaskResultExtensions
```

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Each operation provides two delegate-shape overloads:

- a _sync-delegate_ variant (no [`CancellationToken`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken))
- an _async-delegate_ variant that accepts a [`CancellationToken`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken) and forwards it to the delegate.

Failure inputs short-circuit without invoking the delegate. Faulted or
cancelled source tasks surface through `await` per normal
.NET semantics — neither a [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) failure nor a wrapped
exception.

本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Results](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) receivers whose result type is
[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011;
mirror of [TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) for hot paths that
avoid [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task) allocation (Mediator pipeline, Saga step
executors).

```csharp
public static class ValueTaskResultExtensions
```

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Return types and async-delegate return types are
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask) / [`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) to keep
the fluent chain on the ValueTask rail without
`.AsTask()` boundary friction. Callers holding
[`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1) sources should use
[TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) instead.

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

These helpers compose count + page queries into a single [PagedResult\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-dapper/pagedresult-1.md).
Callers are expected to annotate their query methods with `[DapperAot]` so that
Dapper.AOT generates the reader code at build time. The helpers themselves only call
the standard Dapper `SqlMapper` extensions and introduce no runtime reflection.

## Methods

### QueryPageAsync\<T>(IDbConnection, string, string, PageRequest, object?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Dapper_Extensions_DapperAotExtensions_QueryPageAsync__1_System_Data_IDbConnection_System_String_System_String_Kun_Dapper_PageRequest_System_Object_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Executes a count query and a page query in sequence and wraps the results in a
[PagedResult\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-dapper/pagedresult-1.md).

```csharp
public static Task<PagedResult<T>> QueryPageAsync<T>(this IDbConnection connection, string countSql, string pageSql, PageRequest request, object? param = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`countSql` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

SQL that returns a single `int` total-row count.

`pageSql` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

SQL that returns the page of rows. May reference `@Offset` and `@PageSize`

`request` [PageRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-dapper/pagerequest.md)

`param` [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)?

`@Offset` and `@PageSize` are added automatically.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

A [PagedResult\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-dapper/pagedresult-1.md) with the total count and current page of items.

#### Type Parameters

`T`

The item type returned by the page query.

## Properties

### GeneratesTemporaryValues \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Conventions_KunGuidV7ValueGenerator_GeneratesTemporaryValues}

Gets a value indicating whether the values generated are temporary (i.e they should be replaced
by database generated values when the entity is saved) or are permanent (i.e. the generated values
should be saved to the database).

```csharp
public override bool GeneratesTemporaryValues { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

#### Remarks

```
An example of temporary value generation is generating negative numbers for an integer primary key
that are then replaced by positive numbers generated by the database when the entity is saved. An
example of permanent value generation are client-generated values for a [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid) primary
key which are saved to the database.

See [EF Core value generation](https://aka.ms/efcore-docs-value-generation) for more information and examples.
```

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunDataConventions<TContext>(this IServiceCollection services) where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Remarks

### AddKunEntityFrameworkCore(IServiceCollection) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_DependencyInjection_KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunEntityFrameworkCore_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection\_}

Registers the unit-of-work, integration-event outbox bridge, and default domain-event
dispatcher. Callers must separately register their [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md) subclass
via `AddDbContext`.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunEntityFrameworkCore(this IServiceCollection services)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection to configure.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same `services` for chaining.

#### Remarks

Also registers [TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlsconnectioninterceptor.md) as Scoped; it does not
activate unless the caller adds it to their `DbContextOptionsBuilder` via
`opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor>())`.

### AddKunTenantRls(IServiceCollection) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_DependencyInjection_KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunTenantRls_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection\_}

兼容入口：注册 RLS 双拦截器；推荐使用泛型重载自动装配。Consumers must
also wire the interceptor into their DbContext options via DI resolution, e.g.

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, options) =>
    options.UseNpgsql(cs)
           .UseKunSchema("catalog")
           .AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>()));
```

Scoped lifetime — each request's [ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md)
is resolved per transaction. Not added automatically because the interceptor fires a
`set_config` round-trip on every transaction; services without RLS should not pay
that cost.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunTenantRls(this IServiceCollection services)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection to configure.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same `services` for chaining.

### UseKunSchema(DbContextOptionsBuilder, string) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Extensions_KunDbContextOptionsBuilderExtensions_UseKunSchema_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_DbContextOptionsBuilder_System_String\_}

Wires a service-scoped default schema through EF Core's migrations history table so
`__ef_migrations_history` co-locates with business tables under
`schema`. Use in tandem with `KunDbContext.DefaultSchema`
overriding the same value — the [SchemaConsistencyInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/schemaconsistencyinterceptor.md)
registered automatically by [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md) raises a clear exception at the
first `SaveChangesAsync` if the two diverge.

```csharp
public static DbContextOptionsBuilder UseKunSchema(this DbContextOptionsBuilder builder, string schema)
```

#### Parameters

`builder` [DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

The options builder to configure. A relational provider
(e.g. `.UseNpgsql(...)`) must already be applied.

`schema` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Service-scoped schema name (e.g. `"catalog"`).

#### Returns

[DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

The same `builder` for chaining.

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception)

`builder` is null.

[ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception)

`schema` is null/empty.

[InvalidOperationException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception)

No relational provider has been configured
on `builder`.

### SavingChanges(DbContextEventData, InterceptionResult\<int>) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Interceptors_AuditFieldsSaveChangesInterceptor_SavingChanges_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_DbContextEventData_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_InterceptionResult_System_Int32\_\_}

```csharp
public override InterceptionResult<int> SavingChanges(DbContextEventData eventData, InterceptionResult<int> result)
```

#### Parameters

`eventData` [DbContextEventData](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.dbcontexteventdata)

Contextual information about the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) being used.

`result` [InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

Represents the current result if one exists.
This value will have [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if some previous
interceptor suppressed execution by calling [`SuppressWithResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.suppresswithresult).
This value is typically used as the return value for the implementation of this method.

#### Returns

[InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is false, the EF will continue as normal.
If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

### Classes

[AuditFieldsSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/auditfieldssavechangesinterceptor.md)

在业务保存前填充审计字段，保留创建字段，拒绝无法转换的已认证主体。

[SchemaConsistencyInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/schemaconsistencyinterceptor.md)

Fails fast when a [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)'s `DefaultSchema` diverges from the EF Core
`MigrationsHistoryTable` schema. Throws at the first `SaveChangesAsync` so developers
catch mis-wired `UseKunSchema` calls before any business write lands in the wrong schema.

[TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlsconnectioninterceptor.md)

Defence-in-depth interceptor that pushes the current [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId)
into the PostgreSQL session variable `app.current_tenant_id` on every
connection open, and clears it on connection close. Used in combination with
Row-Level Security policies on the database side — EF Core's global query
filter remains the first line of defence; this interceptor is the second.

[TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlstransactioninterceptor.md)

Emits `set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @tenant, true)` at the start of every
EF Core transaction so PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies can use
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')` to enforce tenant isolation even when a
caller bypasses the global query filter (e.g. `IgnoreQueryFilters()`, admin scenarios).

# Class SchemaConsistencyInterceptor

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Fails fast when a [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)'s `DefaultSchema` diverges from the EF Core
`MigrationsHistoryTable` schema. Throws at the first `SaveChangesAsync` so developers
catch mis-wired `UseKunSchema` calls before any business write lands in the wrong schema.

```csharp
public sealed class SchemaConsistencyInterceptor : ISaveChangesInterceptor, IInterceptor
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←

#### Implements

[IInterceptor](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.iinterceptor)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),

[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

The check runs at most once per interceptor instance (gated by
[`CompareExchange`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.interlocked.compareexchange)). Per `kun-gap-closure-v1.md`
M5, the comparison cannot run at `OnModelCreating` time because the relational model is
not yet finalized — `SavingChangesAsync` is the earliest correct hook point.

was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

# Class TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Defence-in-depth interceptor that pushes the current [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId)
into the PostgreSQL session variable `app.current_tenant_id` on every
connection open, and clears it on connection close. Used in combination with
Row-Level Security policies on the database side — EF Core's global query
filter remains the first line of defence; this interceptor is the second.

```csharp
public sealed class TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor : DbConnectionInterceptor, IDbConnectionInterceptor, IInterceptor
```

## Remarks

Only activates when the underlying [`DbConnection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.data.common.dbconnection) is an Npgsql
connection; for other providers (MySQL, SQL Server) the interceptor is a
no-op, because the `SET app.current_tenant_id = ...` syntax is
PostgreSQL-specific. The check is nominal (namespace-prefix on the connection
type) so this module can remain free of a direct Npgsql package dependency.

SQL injection guard: `SET` statements in PostgreSQL cannot be parameterised,
so the tenant id is inlined into the command text. We therefore refuse to emit
the command unless the value matches the strict whitelist
[TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor.SafeTenantIdPattern](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlsconnectioninterceptor.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Interceptors_TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor_SafeTenantIdPattern). A business tenant id that does not match
(spaces, quotes, semicolons, etc.) will throw instead of being silently coerced
— fail loudly rather than hand a crafted value to `SET`.

Registered as Scoped by [KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions.AddKunEntityFrameworkCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-dependencyinjection/kunentityframeworkcoreservicecollectionextensions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_DependencyInjection_KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunEntityFrameworkCore_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_);
callers opt in by adding the interceptor to their `DbContextOptionsBuilder`:

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<MyDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
{
    opts.UseNpgsql(connectionString);
    opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor>());
});
```

## Fields

### SafeTenantIdPattern \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Interceptors_TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor_SafeTenantIdPattern}

Whitelist for tenant-id values allowed inside `SET app.current_tenant_id = '...'`.
ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, dot; 1..128 chars. Covers GUIDs,
slugs, and short numeric ids while rejecting any value that could escape
the single-quoted literal.

```csharp
public const string SafeTenantIdPattern = "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"
```

#### Field Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

# Class TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Emits `set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @tenant, true)` at the start of every
EF Core transaction so PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies can use
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')` to enforce tenant isolation even when a
caller bypasses the global query filter (e.g. `IgnoreQueryFilters()`, admin scenarios).

```csharp
public sealed class TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor : DbTransactionInterceptor, IDbTransactionInterceptor, IInterceptor
```

[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Hooks `TransactionStartedAsync` / `TransactionStarted` rather than
`ConnectionOpenedAsync`: PgBouncer in transaction-pooling mode recycles the backend
connection at transaction boundaries, so setting a GUC outside an explicit transaction
would leak across tenants. Scoping to `SET LOCAL` (equivalently
`set_config(..., is_local=true)`) ties the setting to the current transaction.

Uses `set_config(...)` instead of `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = '...'` because
Postgres's `SET` utility statement does not accept parameter binding; the function form
does, keeping the tenant id out of the SQL text (defence against log leakage / injection).

No-op when [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId) is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) or empty
(background jobs / setup scripts). RLS policies must be written to accept
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true) IS NULL` as the unscoped path if those
flows need to read cross-tenant data; otherwise they must set the GUC manually.

## Remarks

Assumes the tenant's database has already been **created** at the server
level by an operations workflow (Terraform, K8s Operator, cloud provider API). This
provisioner's job is to bring the schema up-to-date via
`Database.MigrateAsync()`. Databases cannot be reliably created in a portable way
across Postgres / MySQL / SQL Server from EF Core itself, so that step is delegated.

For scenarios where the app owns database creation, subclass this provisioner and
override [DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_DatabasePerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) to run your vendor-specific `CREATE DATABASE`
before calling `base.ProvisionAsync`.

# Interface IDbConnectionResolver

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Resolves the connection string for a given tenant. Used by the
[TenantIsolationStrategy.DatabasePerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_DatabasePerTenant) strategy
to dispatch DbContext construction to the tenant's dedicated database.

```csharp
public interface IDbConnectionResolver
```

## Remarks

Implementations must be thread-safe (called concurrently from scoped request handlers)
and idempotent. The default [OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md) reads
a static tenant→connection-string map from [TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md).
Larger deployments typically swap in a custom implementation backed by a secrets store
or a tenant-metadata service.

# Interface ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Builds a `TContext` instance bound to a specific tenant's schema
or database. Used by [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md) at tenant
provisioning time, when the ambient [ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md)
may not yet reference the new tenant.

```csharp
public interface ITenantDbContextFactory<TContext> where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Type Parameters

`TContext`

The concrete [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) subclass.

## Remarks

Consumers implement this interface once per DbContext type. A minimal implementation
wraps `DbContextOptionsBuilder.UseNpgsql(...).UseKunSchema(tenantId)` and returns
a freshly-constructed `TContext`.

For **runtime query access** (inside a request), prefer the standard
DI-injected `TContext` registered via
`AddDbContext<TContext>((sp, opts) => opts.UseKunSchema(sp.GetRequiredService<ITenantContext>().TenantId!))`
combined with [TenantAwareModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantawaremodelcachekeyfactory.md). The factory is the explicit
escape hatch for administrative / provisioning flows that must target a specific tenant
regardless of the ambient context.

## Properties

### AllowDestructiveDeprovision \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_AllowDestructiveDeprovision}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), `SchemaPerTenantProvisioner.DeprovisionAsync` is
permitted to run `DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS "{tenantId}" CASCADE`. Default is
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) — deprovisioning is a data-loss operation and must be an
explicit opt-in. When left at the default, `DeprovisionAsync` throws
[`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) with a remediation message.

```csharp
public bool AllowDestructiveDeprovision { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

## Methods

### AddKunMultiTenancy\<TContext>(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunMultiTenancyOptions>) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunMultiTenancy__1_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions\_\_}

Registers the multi-tenancy services for a specific DbContext type. Must be called
BEFORE the matching `AddDbContext<TContext>`, and the consumer is
responsible for registering their own [ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/itenantdbcontextfactory-1.md)
when [KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy) is
[TenantIsolationStrategy.SchemaPerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_SchemaPerTenant).

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunMultiTenancy<TContext>(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunMultiTenancyOptions> configure) where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunMultiTenancyOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md)>

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

#### Type Parameters

`TContext`

#### Remarks

**Shared**: delegates to `AddKunTenantRls()` — no additional services
beyond the RLS interceptor and [NullTenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/nulltenantprovisioner.md) default.

**SchemaPerTenant**: registers [TenantAwareModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantawaremodelcachekeyfactory.md),
the [TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlstransactioninterceptor.md) (defence-in-depth), a
Singleton [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md) as the
[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) implementation, and binds
[KunMultiTenancyOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md). Consumers must also add the schema selection
and the model-cache factory to their DbContext options, e.g.:

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
    opts.UseNpgsql(cs)
        .UseKunSchema(sp.GetRequiredService<ITenantContext>().TenantId ?? "public")
        .ReplaceService<IModelCacheKeyFactory, TenantAwareModelCacheKeyFactory>()
        .AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>()));
```

**DatabasePerTenant**: registers a default
[OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md) reading from
[TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md) plus a Singleton
[DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md). Consumers are still responsible
for registering their own [ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/itenantdbcontextfactory-1.md) that
resolves the tenant's connection string via [IDbConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/idbconnectionresolver.md) and
constructs a DbContext bound to that connection.

**Strategy snapshotting**: the [KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy)
value set by `configure` is captured at registration time to decide
which services to register. A subsequent
`services.Configure<KunMultiTenancyOptions>` that mutates
[KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy) will NOT retro-actively change the DI
wiring — the options-read path would disagree with the registered graph. Set the
strategy exactly once, inside this call's `configure` delegate.

# Class SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) implementation for the
[TenantIsolationStrategy.SchemaPerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_SchemaPerTenant) strategy. On
[SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_SchemaPerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) executes `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "{tenantId}"`
and runs EF Core migrations under that schema; on [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.DeprovisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_SchemaPerTenantProvisioner_1_DeprovisionAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)
drops the schema when [KunMultiTenancyOptions.AllowDestructiveDeprovision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_AllowDestructiveDeprovision)
is enabled, else throws.

```csharp
public sealed class SchemaPerTenantProvisioner<TContext> : ITenantProvisioner where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Type Parameters

`TContext`

The KunDbContext-derived context whose migrations to apply.

## Remarks

Idempotent by construction: both `IF NOT EXISTS` (provision) and `IF EXISTS`
(deprovision) are baked into the SQL. Tenant IDs are validated for safe schema-name
characters (letters, digits, underscore, hyphen) before being interpolated — invalid
IDs throw [`ArgumentException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception) with a remediation message rather than
reaching the database.

# Class TenantAwareModelCacheKeyFactory

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

[`IModelCacheKeyFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory) that partitions EF Core's compiled-model cache by
tenant ID in addition to context type and design-time flag. Required for the
[TenantIsolationStrategy.SchemaPerTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolationstrategy.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolationStrategy_SchemaPerTenant) strategy so
that tenant A's schema-specific model is not reused for tenant B.

```csharp
public sealed class TenantAwareModelCacheKeyFactory : IModelCacheKeyFactory
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←

#### Implements

[IModelCacheKeyFactory](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Reads the tenant ID from [KunDbContext.TenantIdForModelCacheKey](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_TenantIdForModelCacheKey). Contexts
that do not derive from [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md) fall back to the default type-only
cache key, so registering this factory is safe for mixed contexts in one host.

When `TenantIdForModelCacheKey` is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) (e.g. background task
with no scoped tenant), the key uses the placeholder `"__kun_no_tenant__"` so a
single shared "no tenant" model gets cached rather than rebuilding on every call.

[InProcessDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/inprocessdomaineventdispatcher.md)

Dispatches domain events to in-process Mediator notification handlers.
Domain events that also implement [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md) are routed to all
registered [INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md)s via [IPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md).
Events that do not implement [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md) are silently skipped.

[IntegrationEventOutboxAccumulator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/integrationeventoutboxaccumulator.md)

[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md) implementation that serializes integration events and
appends them to the [IntegrationEventBuffer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/integrationeventbuffer.md) with current trace and tenant context.
The buffer is flushed atomically by [EfUnitOfWork](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/efunitofwork.md) during `SaveChangesAsync`.

[KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)

Base EF Core DbContext for Kun Framework services.

[NoOpDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/noopdomaineventdispatcher.md)

Default no-op domain event dispatcher. Users replace this with a real implementation
(e.g. one backed by `Kun.Mediator.IPublisher`) by registering their own
[IDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomaineventdispatcher.md) before calling `AddKunEntityFrameworkCore`.

[OutboxMessageConfiguration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/outboxmessageconfiguration.md)

EF Core mapping for [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md).

[SpecificationEvaluator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/specificationevaluator.md)

Applies an [ISpecification\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-infrastructure-abstractions/ispecification-1.md) to an [`IQueryable`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.linq.iqueryable-1),
translating criteria, ordering, includes, and paging into EF Core LINQ operators.

Dispatches domain events to in-process Mediator notification handlers.
Domain events that also implement [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md) are routed to all

## Remarks

[IPublisher.Publish](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md#Kun_Mediator_IPublisher_Publish__1___0_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) is a generic method keyed on the
concrete notification type at runtime. Because `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` is not
an AOT candidate (`IsAotCandidate=false`), reflection is permitted here to
invoke `Publish` with the exact concrete type so the Mediator dispatcher can
resolve the correct [INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md) registrations.

## Remarks

Applies automatic global query filters for [IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entities
(filters out rows whose `TenantId` does not match the current tenant scope)
and for [ISoftDelete](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/isoftdelete.md) entities (excludes soft-deleted rows).
Ensures the Outbox is registered for atomic enqueue.

## Properties

### DefaultSchema \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_DefaultSchema}

Default database schema for this context. When non-[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null), applied via
[`HasDefaultSchema`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.relationalmodelbuilderextensions.hasdefaultschema)
before entity configurations run — tables, Outbox, and Saga storage all land under this
schema by default. Callers should also configure `MigrationsHistoryTable` to the
same schema on the Npgsql options so migrations + business tables co-locate.

```csharp
protected virtual string? DefaultSchema { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

#### Remarks

Overriding services' DbContexts (e.g. `CatalogDbContext`) should return a service-scoped
schema like `"catalog"` to enable single-database, multi-schema isolation
(SAD §5.1). Leaving this [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) preserves legacy `public`-schema
behavior.

### TenantIdForModelCacheKey \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_TenantIdForModelCacheKey}

Exposes the current tenant ID for use by a custom `IModelCacheKeyFactory`
so EF Core builds a distinct compiled model per tenant rather than sharing the
first-built model across all instances of the same DbContext type. Query filters also
read this member through the executing DbContext, rather than retaining another host's accessor.

### OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_OnConfiguring_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_DbContextOptionsBuilder\_}

Override this method to configure the database (and other options) to be used for this context.

#### Parameters

`optionsBuilder` [DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

#### Remarks

```
In situations where an instance of [`DbContextOptions`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptions) may or may not have been passed
to the constructor, you can use [`IsConfigured`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder.isconfigured) to determine if
the options have already been set, and skip some or all of the logic in
[`OnConfiguring`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext.onconfiguring).

for more information and examples.
```

# Namespace Kun.EventBus.Background

### Classes

[NullOutboxLockProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/nulloutboxlockprovider.md)

No-op [IOutboxLockProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/ioutboxlockprovider.md) for single-instance deployments.
Always succeeds and returns a disposable that does nothing.
This is the default provider registered by `AddKunOutboxPublisher`.

[OutboxPublisherBackgroundService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/outboxpublisherbackgroundservice.md)

Hosted background service that polls the outbox store for pending messages and
publishes them via [IIntegrationEventPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventpublisher.md).

[OutboxPublisherOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/outboxpublisheroptions.md)

Configures the outbox publisher background service.

[RedisOutboxLockProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/redisoutboxlockprovider.md)

Redis-backed [IOutboxLockProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/ioutboxlockprovider.md) using `SET key value NX EX` semantics.
Safe for multi-pod deployments: only one pod holds the lock per TTL window.

### Interfaces

[IOutboxBatchStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/ioutboxbatchstore.md)

事务内领取并持有消息行锁的 Outbox 存储；释放作用域前必须完成批次。

[IOutboxLockProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/ioutboxlockprovider.md)

Provides a distributed lease that prevents multiple pods from publishing
the same outbox batch simultaneously.

[IOutboxMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-background/ioutboxmessagestore.md)

Abstracts access to the outbox persistence layer. The concrete implementation
lives in Kun.EntityFrameworkCore (or any other persistence module).

### Register\<TEvent>() \{#Kun_EventBus_DependencyInjection_KunEventBusBuilder_Register__1}

Registers `TEvent` using the token declared on its
[IntegrationEventIdAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventidattribute.md). Throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) when the attribute is absent.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Reads [IntegrationEventId] via reflection on typeof(TEvent). Under trimming, IntegrationEventIdAttribute instances must be preserved. Use Register<TEvent>(string) to avoid reflection entirely.")]
public IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>() where TEvent : class
```

#### Returns

IEventTypeRegistrar

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Reads the attribute reflectively once at DI-registration time; the resulting
registry is the same O(1) [IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md) used at steady state.
AOT-strict callers can stick with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_) or
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) to avoid the reflection entirely.

## Remarks

The DI container resolves [IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) to the same scoped instance as
[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md) — both interfaces name the same accumulator. Prefer
[IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) when the caller is an infrastructure collaborator (interceptor,
adapter) rather than a domain aggregate or command handler; the narrower contract
communicates intent and decouples from the full bus surface.

## Methods

### Enqueue\<TEvent>(TEvent) \{#Kun_EventBus_Outbox_IOutboxWriter_Enqueue__1___0\_}

Enqueues an integration event for atomic commit with the pending DbContext change set.
Produces the same [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md) shape as
[IIntegrationEventBus.Publish](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md#Kun_EventBus_IIntegrationEventBus_Publish__1___0_): stable event id via
[IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md), current tenant and trace context captured.

```csharp
void Enqueue<TEvent>(TEvent @event) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`event` TEvent

The event instance to enqueue. Must not be [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

The integration event type. Must be registered via [IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md).

## Methods

### AddRabbitMq(IServiceCollection, Action\<RabbitMqOptions>, Action\<KunRabbitMqBuilder>?) \{#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_DependencyInjection_KunRabbitMqServiceCollectionExtensions_AddRabbitMq_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_Options_RabbitMqOptions__System_Action_Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_DependencyInjection_KunRabbitMqBuilder\_\_}

starts the consumer background service for any subscriptions configured via `configure`.

Serialization falls back to reflection-based `System.Text.Json` defaults. AOT-targeting
consumers should prefer the
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) overload instead to thread a
source-generated [`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) through the outbox.

### Register\<TEvent>(string, JsonTypeInfo\<TEvent>) \{#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0\_\_}

Registers a mapping between `eventType` token and
`TEvent`, plus the source-generated
[`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) used to serialize outbox payloads without runtime reflection.

```csharp
IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>(string eventType, JsonTypeInfo<TEvent> typeInfo) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`eventType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Stable event-id token (e.g. `order.placed.v1`).

`typeInfo` [JsonTypeInfo](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1)\<TEvent>

JsonTypeInfo for `TEvent`, typically obtained from a
`[JsonSerializable(typeof(TEvent))]`-decorated [`JsonSerializerContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.jsonserializercontext).

#### Returns

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

### Register\<TEvent>() \{#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1}

Registers `TEvent` using the token declared on its
[IntegrationEventIdAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventidattribute.md). Throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) when the attribute is absent.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Reads [IntegrationEventId] via reflection on typeof(TEvent). Under trimming, IntegrationEventIdAttribute instances must be preserved. Use Register<TEvent>(string) to avoid reflection entirely.")]
IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>() where TEvent : class
```

#### Returns

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Reads the attribute reflectively once at DI-registration time; the resulting
registry is the same O(1) [IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md) used at steady state.
AOT-strict callers can stick with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_) or
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) to avoid the reflection entirely.

## Remarks

The token shape follows the framework convention
`{bounded-context}.{event-name}.v{version}`, e.g. `order.placed.v1`.
Applying this attribute does _not_ auto-register the type — registration
is still explicit via [IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md). AOT-strict consumers that
must avoid reflection at startup can keep using
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_).

### ExposeInternalJwks \{#Kun_Gateway_Configuration_KunGatewayOptions_ExposeInternalJwks}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), the gateway exposes the internal JWKS endpoint
`/internal/.well-known/jwks.json` in non-Development environments. Defaults to
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) so the internal endpoint returns 404 in production unless the
operator deliberately opts in. The public endpoint `/.well-known/jwks.json`
remains always-on; this option only gates the internal-network variant.

```csharp
public bool ExposeInternalJwks { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

#### Remarks

Keep [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) in internet-facing Kubernetes deployments and rely on
NetworkPolicy / service-mesh egress rules to isolate the internal route. Flip to
[true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) only when JWKS fetching from internal pods must bypass the
public path (e.g. rate-limiting sidecars that reshape external traffic).

## Methods

### AddKunGateway(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunGatewayOptions>, IConfiguration?) \{#Kun_Gateway_DependencyInjection_KunGatewayServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunGateway_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_Gateway_Configuration_KunGatewayOptions__Microsoft_Extensions_Configuration_IConfiguration\_}

Registers core Kun Gateway services:

- [KunGatewayOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-configuration/kungatewayoptions.md) bound from the provided delegate.
- [S2sTokenIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md) as a singleton.
- Default [TenantRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting-resolvers/tenantratelimitpartitionresolver.md) (override by registering your own before calling this).
- YARP reverse proxy with the [Kun.Gateway.Transforms.S2sAuthTransform](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/index.md#Kun_Gateway_Transforms_S2sAuthTransform) applied to all routes.

When `reverseProxyConfig` is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null), a startup validation
service checks that an `IProxyConfigProvider` has been registered and throws a
descriptive [`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) on host start if one is missing.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunGateway(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunGatewayOptions> configure, IConfiguration? reverseProxyConfig = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunGatewayOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-configuration/kungatewayoptions.md)>

Delegate to configure [KunGatewayOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-configuration/kungatewayoptions.md).

`reverseProxyConfig` [IConfiguration](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.configuration.iconfiguration)?

Optional YARP configuration section (e.g. `Configuration.GetSection("ReverseProxy")`)
to bind Routes/Clusters. When null, callers must register their own
`IProxyConfigProvider`.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same [`IServiceCollection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection) for chaining.

### MapKunJwks(IEndpointRouteBuilder, Func\<HttpContext, bool>?) \{#Kun_Gateway_Endpoints_JwksEndpoint_MapKunJwks_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Routing_IEndpointRouteBuilder_System_Func_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_Boolean\_\_}

Maps `/.well-known/jwks.json` — returns the gateway's RSA public key as a JSON Web Key Set.
The `kid` is derived from the SHA-256 hash of the RSA modulus for stable key identification.
Response is cached by [JwksResponseBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-jwks/jwksresponsebuilder.md) and only rebuilt when the
underlying public-key file is modified.

```csharp
public static IEndpointConventionBuilder MapKunJwks(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints, Func<HttpContext, bool>? additionalGate = null)
```

#### Parameters

`endpoints` [IEndpointRouteBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.routing.iendpointroutebuilder)

The endpoint route builder.

`additionalGate` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[HttpContext](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.httpcontext), [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)>?

Optional predicate evaluated on each request. Return [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) to respond 404.
Typical use is a production-only allow-list (e.g. loopback only when this route is
supposed to be reachable only via mesh-internal hops). When [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null),
no additional gating is applied.

# Interface IS2sPrincipalResolver

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Gateway` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Gateway`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Gateway)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Gateway.Identity](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Gateway.dll

Optional enrichment hook invoked by [S2sTokenIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md) after the external IdP
principal authenticates and before the internal S2S token is minted. Lets consumers add,
remove, or rewrite claims — typically for tenant lookup, role projection, or attaching
service-scoped metadata that the IdP does not own.

```csharp
public interface IS2sPrincipalResolver
```

## Remarks

The resolver runs on the Gateway's request path, so its implementation should be cheap:
prefer cache-backed lookups over per-request database calls. Failures should surface as
exceptions rather than empty principals. The issuer rejects unauthenticated/empty principals
and missing canonical identity fields; session and authorization revisions must come from an authoritative source.

## Methods

### ResolveAsync(ClaimsPrincipal, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_Identity_IS2sPrincipalResolver_ResolveAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Returns the principal that [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueFor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_) should
translate into the internal S2S token. Implementations may return
`externalPrincipal` unchanged (no-op) or a new
[`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal) with enriched claims.

```csharp

```

## Remarks

Registered as a DI singleton by `AddKunGateway`. The cache is shared between
the public `MapKunJwks` route and the gated `MapKunInternalJwks` route
so both serve the same byte-identical document and both pay the key-rebuild
cost at most once per key-rotation event.

Thread-safe via a single lock around the cached tuple. The lock scope is tiny
(read the mtime, compare, maybe rebuild) and the rebuild path only fires when
an operator rotates the key — expected to be infrequent relative to request
volume, so lock contention is a non-issue in practice.

Extension methods for mapping the **internal-network** JWKS endpoint, separate from the


#### Inheritance

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.MemberwiseClone()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.memberwiseclone),

[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

The public endpoint (see `JwksEndpoint.MapKunJwks`) is required for any consumer — inside
or outside the cluster — to validate S2S tokens, and stays unconditionally enabled. The internal
endpoint at `/internal/.well-known/jwks.json` is an opt-in convenience for downstream
services that talk to the gateway through a NetworkPolicy-isolated interface and want a stable
well-known path that does NOT share lifecycle with the public route (e.g. for separate
rate-limiting or egress controls).

Gating policy: the internal route is reachable only when either (a) the host runs in the
`Development` environment, or (b) [KunGatewayOptions.ExposeInternalJwks](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-configuration/kungatewayoptions.md#Kun_Gateway_Configuration_KunGatewayOptions_ExposeInternalJwks) is
explicitly set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool). Any other environment returns 404, so forgetting to
set the flag in production fails closed.

# Namespace Kun.Gateway.RateLimiting

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Gateway` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Gateway`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Gateway)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Namespaces

[Kun.Gateway.RateLimiting.Resolvers](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting-resolvers/index.md)

### Classes

[KunRateLimiterExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/kunratelimiterextensions.md)

Extension methods for registering Kun rate limiting services.

[KunSlidingWindowOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/kunslidingwindowoptions.md)

Tunable parameters for `AddKunSlidingWindowRateLimiter`. Sliding-window divides
each window into segments and shifts one segment at a time, yielding smoother behavior
than a fixed window at the cost of proportionally higher CPU/memory.

[KunTokenBucketOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/kuntokenbucketoptions.md)

Tunable parameters for `AddKunTokenBucketRateLimiter`. Token-bucket smooths bursty
traffic by accumulating tokens at a steady rate up to a cap; each request consumes one
token and is rejected (or queued) when the bucket is empty.

[RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/redisfixedwindowratelimitstore.md)

Fixed-window distributed rate-limit counter backed by Redis. Uses an atomic
`INCR` with `NX EX`-style TTL-on-first-write semantics so the counter
self-expires once the window elapses — no cleanup job required.

[RedisRateLimitStoreOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/redisratelimitstoreoptions.md)

Configuration for [RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/redisfixedwindowratelimitstore.md).

### Structs

[RateLimitHitResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/ratelimithitresult.md)

Result of [IRedisRateLimitStore.HitAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iredisratelimitstore.md#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_IRedisRateLimitStore_HitAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

### Interfaces

[IRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iratelimitpartitionresolver.md)

Resolves the rate-limit partition key for an incoming HTTP request.
Implement this interface to plug in a custom partitioning strategy (by tenant, IP, API key, etc.).

[IRedisRateLimitStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iredisratelimitstore.md)

Low-level Redis-backed counter used for distributed rate limiting across multiple
Gateway pods. Primitive surface for a future `PartitionedRateLimiter<HttpContext>`
integration; directly usable today as a building block for custom rate-limit middleware.

## Methods

### HitAsync(string, TimeSpan, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_IRedisRateLimitStore_HitAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Atomically increments the count for `partitionKey` within a
rolling window of `window`, applying TTL on the first write so
stale partitions self-expire. Returns the post-increment count and the time until
the window resets.

```csharp
Task<RateLimitHitResult> HitAsync(string partitionKey, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`partitionKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Caller's partition key (tenant, IP, sub, etc.).

`window` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

Window length; controls Redis EXPIRE TTL on first hit.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[RateLimitHitResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/ratelimithitresult.md)>

`Count`: current number of hits within the active window (>= 1).
`ResetsIn`: time until the window resets. Never negative.

### AddKunRateLimiter(IServiceCollection, Action\<RateLimiterOptions>?) \{#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_KunRateLimiterExtensions_AddKunRateLimiter_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Microsoft_AspNetCore_RateLimiting_RateLimiterOptions\_\_}

Registers Kun rate limiting with a tenant-partitioned fixed-window policy (100 req/min by default).
Requires an [IRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iratelimitpartitionresolver.md) to be registered; if none is present,
defaults to [TenantRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting-resolvers/tenantratelimitpartitionresolver.md).

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunRateLimiter(this IServiceCollection services, Action<RateLimiterOptions>? configure = null)
```

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[RateLimiterOptions](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.ratelimiting.ratelimiteroptions)>?

Optional delegate to further configure rate limiter options.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

# Class RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Gateway` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Gateway`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Gateway)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Gateway.RateLimiting](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Gateway.dll

Fixed-window distributed rate-limit counter backed by Redis. Uses an atomic
`INCR` with `NX EX`-style TTL-on-first-write semantics so the counter
self-expires once the window elapses — no cleanup job required.

```csharp
public sealed class RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore : IRedisRateLimitStore
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/redisfixedwindowratelimitstore.md)

#### Implements

[IRedisRateLimitStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iredisratelimitstore.md)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

The implementation executes a two-command pipeline (INCR + TTL read) to obtain both
the post-increment count and the remaining TTL in one round-trip. On the first hit
(INCR returns 1), it follows up with EXPIRE to set the window TTL; subsequent hits
in the same window leave the TTL untouched.

Not a full [`RateLimiter`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.ratelimiting.ratelimiter) subclass — this is
the low-level primitive. Full `PartitionedRateLimiter<HttpContext>`
integration with ASP.NET's rate-limit middleware is tracked as future work.

## Methods

### HitAsync(string, TimeSpan, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore_HitAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Atomically increments the count for `partitionKey` within a
rolling window of `window`, applying TTL on the first write so
stale partitions self-expire. Returns the post-increment count and the time until
the window resets.

```csharp
public Task<RateLimitHitResult> HitAsync(string partitionKey, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`partitionKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Caller's partition key (tenant, IP, sub, etc.).

`window` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

Window length; controls Redis EXPIRE TTL on first hit.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[RateLimitHitResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/ratelimithitresult.md)>

`Count`: current number of hits within the active window (>= 1).
`ResetsIn`: time until the window resets. Never negative.

### IssueFor(ClaimsPrincipal) \{#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal\_}

Issues an internal S2S JWT for the given external `externalPrincipal`.
The configured [IS2sPrincipalResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/is2sprincipalresolver.md) runs first to produce the effective
principal, then the canonical identity/scope/session fields are validated and projected.
Missing required identity fields fail closed; arbitrary claims are not forwarded.

```csharp
public string IssueFor(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal)
```

#### Parameters

`externalPrincipal` [ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)

The authenticated principal from the external IdP JWT.

#### Returns

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

A signed RS256 JWT string.

#### Remarks

Synchronous convenience wrapper over [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueForAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueForAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).
Prefer the async form on the Gateway request path — it avoids the
`GetAwaiter().GetResult()` hop and lets resolvers that perform real I/O work
without starving the thread pool.

### IssueForAsync(ClaimsPrincipal, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueForAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Async variant of [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueFor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_). Awaits the configured
[IS2sPrincipalResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/is2sprincipalresolver.md) without blocking, then mints the token.

```csharp
public Task<string> IssueForAsync(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`externalPrincipal` [ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)

The authenticated principal from the external IdP JWT.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token passed to the resolver.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

A signed RS256 JWT string.

### AddKunGrpc(IServiceCollection, Action\<GrpcServiceOptions>?) \{#Kun_Grpc_DependencyInjection_KunGrpcServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunGrpc_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Grpc_AspNetCore_Server_GrpcServiceOptions\_\_}

Registers Kun gRPC services and interceptors:

- `KunTracingInterceptor` — starts an `Activity` per RPC call.
- `KunServerAuthInterceptor` — enforces authenticated `tenant_id` claim.
- `KunResultToRpcInterceptor` — maps `ResultFailureException` to `RpcException`.

Optionally call `AddKunSecurity()` separately to wire up `JwtTenantContext`/`JwtCurrentUser`.

#### Parameters

`UserId` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Stable user identifier. Mirrors the `sub` claim from the OIDC
id-token / access-token. Required — sessions without a user are not
authenticated.

`TenantId` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Active tenant identifier resolved from the `tenant_id` claim, or
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the consumer is single-tenant.

Email claim, when present on the id-token.

`Roles` [IReadOnlyList](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

Flattened role list from `roles` / `groups` claim. Empty
when no role claim was issued.

`AccessToken` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

OIDC access token. Persisted so downstream API calls made on the
user's behalf (e.g. userinfo refresh) can reuse it without
re-running the code-exchange flow.

`RefreshToken` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

OIDC refresh token when the IdP issued one. Stored server-side only
— never round-tripped through the cookie.

`ExpiresAt` [DateTimeOffset](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.datetimeoffset)

Absolute instant at which [SessionData.AccessToken](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/sessiondata.md#Kun_Identity_Abstractions_Session_SessionData_AccessToken) stops being
valid. When this is sooner than the session TTL, background refresh
is responsible for rotating the access token; session expiry itself
is driven by the cookie / store TTL set at sign-in.

# Interface IAuthenticatedUser

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

Browser-flow extension of [ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md). Adds the
multi-tenant identifier, profile claims, and direct access to the
ambient [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal) that the
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` cookie middleware populates.

```csharp
public interface IAuthenticatedUser : ICurrentUser
```

#### Implements

ICurrentUser

## Remarks

Services that resolve the user from an S2S JWT should keep
injecting [ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md). Endpoints that serve the
browser (cookie + OIDC code flow) can inject
[IAuthenticatedUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions/iauthenticateduser.md) to reach the cookie-only fields
without casting.

The DI registration provided by `Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`
binds both interfaces to the same request-scoped instance, so the
choice of injected interface is purely about the fields the caller
needs.

See `docs/architecture/when-to-use-currentuser.md` for the
full decision table across consumer scenarios and the anti-patterns
that should never show up in a PR (no `ICurrentUserEx`, no
per-service subinterface, no [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)
injection as a first-class service).

Validates a Bearer JWT against the configured issuer / audience /
signing keys and returns the resulting [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)
on success. Returns [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when validation fails —
callers decide whether to surface a 401 or fall through.

```csharp
public interface IJwtValidator
```

## Methods

### ValidateAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Identity_Abstractions_IJwtValidator_ValidateAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Validates `token`. Keys are resolved from the
configured JWKS URI with automatic rotation, or from statically
registered `IssuerSigningKeys` when set. Expiry, issuer,
audience, and lifetime are all checked; tokens failing any
check return [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

```csharp
Task<ClaimsPrincipal?> ValidateAsync(string token, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

`token` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

OpenID Connect client for discovery, PKCE code exchange, token refresh,
client credentials and signed back-channel logout validation.

```csharp
public interface IOidcClient
```

## Properties

### Name \{#Kun_Identity_Abstractions_IOidcClient_Name}

Name under which this client was registered. Useful when a
consumer registers multiple OIDC providers (e.g. both
`"authentik"` and `"google"`) and keyed-service
resolution picks one.

```csharp
string Name { get; }
```
