# Class ChallengeHelper

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.AspNetCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.AspNetCore.dll

Builds the `/authorize` redirect URL for an OIDC provider
registered via `AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddOidcClient(...))`.
Generates the one-shot PKCE `code_verifier` /
`code_challenge` pair, a `state`, and a `nonce`,
stashes the verifier + state + nonce + returnUrl in a short-lived
cookie so the callback handler can replay them, and returns the
URL the caller should redirect the user to.

```csharp
public sealed class ChallengeHelper
```

### BuildLoginUrlAsync(HttpContext, string, string, string, string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_BuildLoginUrlAsync_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Builds the login redirect URL. Side effect: writes the
[ChallengeHelper.ChallengeCookieName](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_ChallengeCookieName) cookie onto
`context` — the callback handler must read it
to recover the PKCE verifier + state to validate.

```csharp
public Task<string> BuildLoginUrlAsync(HttpContext context, string oidcClientName, string redirectUri, string returnUrl = "/", string scope = "openid profile email", CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`context` [HttpContext](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.httpcontext)

Current request context.

`oidcClientName` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Registered OIDC client name (e.g. `"authentik"`).

`redirectUri` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Absolute redirect URL the IdP will send the user back to after
consent. Must match one of the URLs configured on the OIDC
application.

`returnUrl` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Local URL to redirect to after sign-in completes; round-tripped
through the challenge cookie. Validation against open-redirect
is the caller's responsibility.

`scope` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

OIDC scope parameter (default `openid profile email`).

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

### Serialize() \{#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_Serialize}

Serializes the internal payload before authenticated encryption; never write this plaintext directly to a cookie.

```csharp
public string Serialize()
```

#### Returns

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

#### Remarks

Pipe-separated format keeps the encoding reflection-free and
auditable at a glance. Each field is assumed to be url-safe
(base64url for the random components, a local URL for
[ChallengePayload.ReturnUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_ReturnUrl)); consumers must validate
[ChallengePayload.ReturnUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_ReturnUrl) against their own open-redirect policy.

# Namespace Kun.Identity.AspNetCore

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[ChallengeHelper](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md)

Builds the `/authorize` redirect URL for an OIDC provider
registered via `AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddOidcClient(...))`.
Generates the one-shot PKCE `code_verifier` /
`code_challenge` pair, a `state`, and a `nonce`,
stashes the verifier + state + nonce + returnUrl in a short-lived
cookie so the callback handler can replay them, and returns the
URL the caller should redirect the user to.

[ChallengePayload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md)

Payload written to the one-shot challenge cookie by
[ChallengeHelper.BuildLoginUrlAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_BuildLoginUrlAsync_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_). Consumer
callback handlers read it via [ChallengeHelper.ConsumeAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_ConsumeAsync_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

[KunCookieAuthApplicationBuilderExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncookieauthapplicationbuilderextensions.md)

`IApplicationBuilder` extensions for the Kun cookie middleware.

[KunCookieAuthMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncookieauthmiddleware.md)

Middleware that hydrates `HttpContext.User` from a
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/isessionstore.md) entry keyed by the session cookie.
Requests without a valid session flow through anonymously; the
middleware never writes a 401 itself — downstream authorization
policies are responsible for that.

[KunCurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncurrentuser.md)

Request-scoped [IAuthenticatedUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions/iauthenticateduser.md) (and
[ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md)) resolver. Reads claims off
`HttpContext.User` — which `UseKunCookieAuth` populates
from `ISessionStore` earlier in the pipeline. Anonymous when
no [`IHttpContextAccessor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.ihttpcontextaccessor) is available or the
authentication middleware has not run.

[KunIdentityAspNetCoreServiceCollectionExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kunidentityaspnetcoreservicecollectionextensions.md)

Registers the browser identity helpers without replacing the host's authentication scheme.

[OidcLoginService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidcloginservice.md)

Completes the protected browser transaction before creating a local session.

[OidcLogoutEndpoint](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidclogoutendpoint.md)

Back-channel logout mapping; authentication comes from the signed provider token, not a browser cookie.

[OidcLogoutService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidclogoutservice.md)

Validates provider logout instructions before atomically revoking local sessions.

[SignInHelper](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/signinhelper.md)

Turns a successful OIDC code-exchange into a signed-in browser
session: writes the [SessionData](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/sessiondata.md) into the configured
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/isessionstore.md) and emits the opaque session cookie on
the current response.

#### Remarks

claim is trusted. An id-token that fails validation throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception); callers decide
whether to surface a 400 or a 401.

# Namespace Kun.Identity.Configuration

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

### Classes

[KunCookieAuthOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md)

Options for the cookie session layer wired by
`AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddCookieSession(...))`. The defaults
encode the zero-trust baseline `Kun.Gateway` already applies to
outbound cookies.

[KunCookieSessionBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md)

Configuration surface exposed by
`KunIdentityBuilder.AddCookieSession(opts => ...)`. Inherits
every [KunCookieAuthOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md) field (so callers write
`opts.CookieName = "kun.sid"; opts.SessionTtl = ...;` as
expected) and adds the backend-selection methods
[KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseInMemoryStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseInMemoryStore) and [KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseRedisStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseRedisStore).
Exactly one backend call should be made — multiple calls take
last-wins semantics because each call replaces the
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/isessionstore.md) registration on the underlying service
collection.

[KunIdentityBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md)

Fluent builder surfaced by `AddKunIdentity`.

[KunJwtBearerOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunjwtbeareroptions.md)

Validation parameters for external Bearer JWTs issued by an OIDC
provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure AD, …). Feeds
`KunJwtValidator`.

[KunJwtIssuerOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunjwtissueroptions.md)

Signing / claims configuration for `KunJwtIssuer`.

[KunOidcClientOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunoidcclientoptions.md)

Per-provider configuration for `KunOidcClient`.

### Enums

[KunCookieSecurePolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesecurepolicy.md)

Secure-policy for [KunCookieAuthOptions.Secure](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_Secure). Mirrors
ASP.NET Core's `CookieSecurePolicy` shape without taking a
dependency on that package from the core abstractions.

[KunSameSiteMode](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunsamesitemode.md)

`SameSite` policy for [KunCookieAuthOptions.SameSite](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_SameSite).
Mirrors ASP.NET Core's `SameSiteMode` shape without taking a
dependency on that package from the core abstractions.

## Remarks

This options type lives in `Kun.Identity` (not
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`) so non-ASP.NET-Core hosts — worker
services that replay a signed-in request, integration tests that
synthesize a session — can configure it without pulling the ASP.NET
Core dependency. [KunCookieAuthOptions.SameSite](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_SameSite) and [KunCookieAuthOptions.Secure](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_Secure)
use Kun-owned enums ([KunSameSiteMode](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunsamesitemode.md),
[KunCookieSecurePolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesecurepolicy.md)); the middleware in
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` maps them to the equivalent ASP.NET
Core values at registration time.

# Class KunCookieSessionBuilder

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.Configuration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

Configuration surface exposed by
`KunIdentityBuilder.AddCookieSession(opts => ...)`. Inherits
every [KunCookieAuthOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md) field (so callers write
`opts.CookieName = "kun.sid"; opts.SessionTtl = ...;` as
expected) and adds the backend-selection methods
[KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseInMemoryStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseInMemoryStore) and [KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseRedisStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseRedisStore).
Exactly one backend call should be made — multiple calls take
last-wins semantics because each call replaces the
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-abstractions-session/isessionstore.md) registration on the underlying service
collection.

```csharp
public sealed class KunCookieSessionBuilder : KunCookieAuthOptions
```

## Methods

### AddCookieSession(Action\<KunCookieSessionBuilder>) \{#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunIdentityBuilder_AddCookieSession_System_Action_Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder\_\_}

Registers the cookie-session pipeline described in
`ADR-010`: a `KunCookieAuthOptions` options entry, a
default [`TimeProvider`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timeprovider), and the
`ISessionStore` backend the caller selects via
`opts.UseInMemoryStore()` or `opts.UseRedisStore()`.

```csharp
public KunIdentityBuilder AddCookieSession(Action<KunCookieSessionBuilder> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunCookieSessionBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md)>

#### Returns

[KunIdentityBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md)

#### Remarks

The `UseKunCookieAuth()` middleware,
`SignInHelper`, `ChallengeHelper`, and
`KunCurrentUser` DI entries live in the companion package
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`; callers wiring a browser-flow
service must reference that package in addition to calling
[KunIdentityBuilder.AddCookieSession](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunIdentityBuilder_AddCookieSession_System_Action_Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder__).

If neither `UseInMemoryStore` nor `UseRedisStore` is
called within the lambda, resolving `ISessionStore` from
DI will throw — the registration is intentionally not defaulted
because an unintended in-memory store in production would be a
subtle data-loss / cross-replica-drift bug.

# Enum KunSameSiteMode

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.Configuration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

`SameSite` policy for [KunCookieAuthOptions.SameSite](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_SameSite).
Mirrors ASP.NET Core's `SameSiteMode` shape without taking a
dependency on that package from the core abstractions.

```csharp
public enum KunSameSiteMode
```

## Fields

`Lax = 1`

`SameSite=Lax`. Cookie is sent on top-level navigation but not
on cross-site subrequests. Recommended default for OIDC code flow.

`None = 0`

`SameSite=None`. Cookie is sent on cross-site requests; must
be paired with [KunCookieSecurePolicy.Always](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesecurepolicy.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSecurePolicy_Always).

`Strict = 2`

`SameSite=Strict`. Cookie is only sent on same-site requests —
blocks even top-level redirects from the IdP callback, so usually
only appropriate for post-login navigation cookies.

`Unspecified = -1`

No `SameSite` attribute emitted (browser default).

### Interfaces

[IProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-infrastructure-abstractions/iprocessedmessagestore.md)

消费端已处理消息记录存储。用于保证 Outbox 至少一次投递场景下的消费幂等。

默认实现基于 Redis 的 `SETNX + EX`（单命令原子操作）。
业务可替换为基于数据库唯一索引的实现以获得跨故障域的强一致性。

[IRepository\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-infrastructure-abstractions/irepository-1.md)

聚合根仓储抽象。业务层依赖本接口，不依赖具体 ORM。

[ISpecification\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-infrastructure-abstractions/ispecification-1.md)

规约模式（Specification Pattern）抽象。
把查询条件、排序、分页从仓储中剥离出来，以可组合的对象表达业务意图。

[IUnitOfWork](/sdk/api/kun/kun-infrastructure-abstractions/iunitofwork.md)

本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Mediator` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Mediator`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Mediator)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[LoggingBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/loggingbehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that logs the request name on entry and the elapsed time on exit.
Logs at [`Debug`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.logging.loglevel.debug) for normal completion and
[`Warning`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.logging.loglevel.warning) when the handler throws.

[PerformanceBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/performancebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that logs a warning when the handler pipeline exceeds a duration
threshold. The threshold is currently hardcoded to 500 ms; a configurable version
backed by `IOptions<PerformanceBehaviorOptions>` is a planned follow-up.

[PerformanceBehaviorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/performancebehavioroptions.md)

慢命令告警的可配置阈值。

[PermissionBehaviorExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/permissionbehaviorextensions.md)

为静态声明权限的命令装配判定行为，缺失引擎时拒绝执行。

[TracingBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/tracingbehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that starts an [`Activity`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activity) for each dispatched request
using the `"Kun.Mediator"` [`ActivitySource`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activitysource). Compatible with
OpenTelemetry — attach a listener via `AddSource("Kun.Mediator")` in the
OpenTelemetry builder.

# Namespace Kun.Mediator

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Mediator` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Mediator`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Mediator)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Namespaces

[Kun.Mediator.Behaviors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/index.md)

[Kun.Mediator.DependencyInjection](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-dependencyinjection/index.md)

### Classes

[CapabilityDescriptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/capabilitydescriptor.md)

命令或查询的稳定标识与 JSON 请求／响应契约。

[KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md)

Reflection-free CQRS dispatcher. Handler lookup is O(1) via a pre-built
[`FrozenDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.frozen.frozendictionary-2). All handler types are explicitly
registered at startup through [KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md), so no runtime
scanning or generic type construction is needed — this class is fully AOT-safe.

[KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md)

Fluent builder used to register request handlers, pipeline behaviors, and notification
handlers with [KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md). All registrations are performed via
compile-time-closed generics — no runtime reflection or `MakeGenericType` occurs.

### Interfaces

[ICapabilityRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/icapabilityregistry.md)

只读能力目录；调用权限与 scope 过滤由上层服务完成。

[INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md)

Marker interface for cross-cutting notifications broadcast to many handlers.

[INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md)

Handler for a specific [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md).

[IPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipipelinebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior wrapping a [IRequestHandler\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-cqrs/irequesthandler-2.md).
Behaviors form a nested "onion": outer behaviors see both the pre- and post-handler phases
of all inner behaviors.

[IPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md)

Publishes a notification to all registered handlers.

[IScopedPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/iscopedpublisher.md)

由事务宿主显式指定作用域，保证通知处理器复用同一 DbContext 与 Outbox 缓冲。

[ISender](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/isender.md)

Dispatches a single request to its registered handler.

### Delegates

[RequestHandlerDelegate\<TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/requesthandlerdelegate-1.md)

Delegate passed to a pipeline behavior representing the next step in the chain.

# Interface IKunMultiTenantDbContext

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Marker interface for `DbContext`s that want the
[KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md) to partition EF
Core's compiled-model cache per tenant. Implementers expose the
ambient tenant id so the factory can emit a distinct cache key for
each tenant, preventing EF from folding the query-filter constant
across tenants on the first model build.

```csharp
public interface IKunMultiTenantDbContext
```

## Remarks

`Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.KunDbContext` already exposes an
equivalent `TenantIdForModelCacheKey` property; custom
contexts that inherit from plain [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext)
should implement this interface to opt into per-tenant isolation.

## Properties

### TenantIdForModelCacheKey \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_EntityFrameworkCore_IKunMultiTenantDbContext_TenantIdForModelCacheKey}

Ambient tenant id used by the model-cache key and the DbContext-bound query-filter overload.

```csharp
string? TenantIdForModelCacheKey { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

### Classes

[KunMultiTenancyModelBuilderExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/kunmultitenancymodelbuilderextensions.md)

[`ModelBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.modelbuilder) extensions that attach the Kun multi-tenant
global query filter to every [IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entity.

[KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md)

[`IModelCacheKeyFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory) that emits a distinct compiled
model per tenant when the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) implements
[IKunMultiTenantDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/ikunmultitenantdbcontext.md). Falls back to EF Core's
default key shape (context type + design-time flag) otherwise, so
consumers who forget to opt in get the same behaviour they had
before.

[KunTenantSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/kuntenantsavechangesinterceptor.md)

EF Core [`SaveChangesInterceptor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.savechangesinterceptor) that walks newly added
[IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entities and, when their
[IMultiTenant.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md#Kun_Core_Domain_IMultiTenant_TenantId) is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) or
empty, injects the ambient [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId).
Existing non-empty values are preserved so administrative tooling
that explicitly sets a tenant id retains control.

### ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters(ModelBuilder, ITenantContext) \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_EntityFrameworkCore_KunMultiTenancyModelBuilderExtensions_ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_ModelBuilder_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext\_}

Retained binary entry point for the unsafe accessor-only overload; rejects model creation.

```csharp
[Obsolete("Use ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters(this) with a DbContext implementing IKunMultiTenantDbContext. Accessor-only filters cannot safely bind a shared model.", DiagnosticId = "KUNTENANT001")]
public static ModelBuilder ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters(this ModelBuilder modelBuilder, ITenantContext tenantContext)
```

#### Parameters

`modelBuilder` [ModelBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.modelbuilder)

`tenantContext` ITenantContext

#### Returns

[ModelBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.modelbuilder)

#### Remarks

An accessor alone cannot bind a reused model to the executing DbContext. Capturing its value
would also be unsafe when the host uses EF's default shared model cache. Migrate to the
DbContext overload; KunDbContext consumers already receive the safe filter automatically.

### ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters\<TContext>(ModelBuilder, TContext) \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_EntityFrameworkCore_KunMultiTenancyModelBuilderExtensions_ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters__1_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_ModelBuilder___0\_}

Attaches the tenant predicate to the executing DbContext so a shared model never reads

# Class KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

[`IModelCacheKeyFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory) that emits a distinct compiled
model per tenant when the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) implements
[IKunMultiTenantDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy-entityframeworkcore/ikunmultitenantdbcontext.md). Falls back to EF Core's
default key shape (context type + design-time flag) otherwise, so
consumers who forget to opt in get the same behaviour they had
before.

```csharp
public sealed class KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory : IModelCacheKeyFactory
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←

#### Implements

[IModelCacheKeyFactory](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory)

#### Inherited Members

[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Register on the [`DbContextOptionsBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder):
`.ReplaceService<IModelCacheKeyFactory, KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory>()`.

Without this factory, EF Core keys compiled models only on
[`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) type. The first tenant's query filter is
then baked into the shared model — subsequent tenants would read
against the first tenant's filter constant, silently leaking data
across tenant boundaries.

## Methods

### SavingChanges(DbContextEventData, InterceptionResult\<int>) \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_EntityFrameworkCore_KunTenantSaveChangesInterceptor_SavingChanges_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_DbContextEventData_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_InterceptionResult_System_Int32\_\_}

Called at the start of `DbContext.SaveChanges`.

```csharp
public override InterceptionResult<int> SavingChanges(DbContextEventData eventData, InterceptionResult<int> result)
```

#### Parameters

`eventData` [DbContextEventData](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.dbcontexteventdata)

Contextual information about the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) being used.

`result` [InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

Represents the current result if one exists.
This value will have [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if some previous
interceptor suppressed execution by calling [`SuppressWithResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.suppresswithresult).
This value is typically used as the return value for the implementation of this method.

#### Returns

[InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is false, the EF will continue as normal.
If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

## Properties

### EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage \{#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), installs a
`BaseProcessor<Activity>` that mirrors whitelisted
OpenTelemetry baggage entries (see
`Kun.Observability.Enrichment.KunBaggageKeys`) onto span
tags for activities emitted by Kun-owned
[`ActivitySource`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activitysource)s. Default
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) (opt-in per
`docs/architecture/ADR-013-Kun.Observability-enricher.md`
§Default posture). Has no effect when
[KunObservabilityOptions.TracingEnabled](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_TracingEnabled) is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp

```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### EnrichLogsFromBaggage \{#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichLogsFromBaggage}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), installs a
`BaseProcessor<LogRecord>` that mirrors whitelisted
OpenTelemetry baggage entries (from the ambient
[`Current`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activity.current)) onto log
record attributes. The log statement's own attributes win
on conflict — the enricher only adds missing keys. Default
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) (opt-in, mirrors
[KunObservabilityOptions.EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage) posture per
ADR-013 §F1 resolution). Has no effect when
[KunObservabilityOptions.LoggingEnabled](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_LoggingEnabled) is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp
public bool EnrichLogsFromBaggage { get; set; }
```

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### AddKunRateLimit(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunRateLimitOptions>) \{#Kun_RateLimit_Extensions_KunRateLimitServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunRateLimit_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions\_\_}

Registers [`RateLimiterOptions`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.ratelimiting.ratelimiteroptions) built from the supplied
[KunRateLimitOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md). Each named window becomes a
fixed-window partition policy buckets on the configured
[RateLimitPartitionKey](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/ratelimitpartitionkey.md). Rejected requests receive a
[`Status429TooManyRequests`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.statuscodes.status429toomanyrequests) response with a
`Retry-After` header; the optional
[KunRateLimitOptions.OnRejected](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md#Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions_OnRejected) hook runs after the
default response is written.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunRateLimit(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunRateLimitOptions> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunRateLimitOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md)>

Options callback; must register at least one window.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same `services` for chaining.

### Interfaces

[ISaga\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isaga-1.md)

Defines an orchestrated saga — an ordered sequence of compensatable [ISagaStep\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagastep-1.md)s.
The orchestrator executes steps in forward order and compensates in reverse order on failure.

[ISagaContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagacontext.md)

Marker interface for saga context objects. Every saga context carries a unique
[ISagaContext.SagaId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagacontext.md#Kun_Saga_Abstractions_ISagaContext_SagaId) and an optional [ISagaContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagacontext.md#Kun_Saga_Abstractions_ISagaContext_TenantId) for multi-tenant scenarios.
Implementations should be serializable to JSON (used for durable state storage).

[ISagaOrchestrator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagaorchestrator.md)

Starts new saga instances and persists the initial state atomically within the caller's
ambient unit-of-work transaction. The background `SagaStepExecutor` then drives
step execution and compensation asynchronously.

[ISagaStep\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagastep-1.md)

A single compensatable step in a saga. Each step must implement both a forward
[ISagaStep\<TContext>.ExecuteAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagastep-1.md#Kun_Saga_Abstractions_ISagaStep_1_ExecuteAsync__0_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) and a reverse
[ISagaStep\<TContext>.CompensateAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagastep-1.md#Kun_Saga_Abstractions_ISagaStep_1_CompensateAsync__0_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) path, both of which must be idempotent.

# Namespace Kun.Saga.Orchestration

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Saga` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Saga`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Saga)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[SagaOrchestrator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagaorchestrator.md)

Default implementation of [ISagaOrchestrator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-abstractions/isagaorchestrator.md).
Persists the initial [SagaInstance](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/sagainstance.md) and enqueues the first step entry within
the caller's ambient unit-of-work transaction. All generic dispatch is delegated to
AOT-safe typed delegates captured in the [SagaRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga/sagaregistry.md) at startup.

[SagaStepExecutor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagastepexecutor.md)

Background service that polls [ISagaInstanceStore.FetchPendingStepsAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/isagainstancestore.md#Kun_Saga_Persistence_ISagaInstanceStore_FetchPendingStepsAsync_System_Int32_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) and
drives saga step execution and compensation. Creates an [`ActivitySource`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activitysource) span
for each step to enable distributed tracing.

[SagaStepExecutorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagastepexecutoroptions.md)

Configuration options for [SagaStepExecutor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagastepexecutor.md).

[SagaTimeoutDetector](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagatimeoutdetector.md)

Background service that periodically scans for timed-out saga instances and triggers
compensation. An instance is considered timed-out when its `TimeoutAt` is in the past
and its state is [SagaState.Running](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/sagastate.md#Kun_Saga_Persistence_SagaState_Running).

[SagaTimeoutDetectorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagatimeoutdetectoroptions.md)

Configuration options for [SagaTimeoutDetector](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-orchestration/sagatimeoutdetector.md).

### StartAsync\<TSaga, TContext>(TContext, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Saga_Orchestration_SagaOrchestrator_StartAsync__2___1_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Begins a new saga instance for `TSaga`, persists its initial state,
and enqueues the first step for background execution — all within the caller's current
`IUnitOfWork` transaction.

```csharp
public Task<Guid> StartAsync<TSaga, TContext>(TContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TSaga : ISaga<TContext> where TContext : ISagaContext
```

#### Parameters

`context` TContext

instance primary key and must be unique across all running sagas.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Token to observe for cancellation.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[Guid](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)>

Assembly: Kun.Saga.dll

Background service that periodically scans for timed-out saga instances and triggers
compensation. An instance is considered timed-out when its `TimeoutAt` is in the past
and its state is [SagaState.Running](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/sagastate.md#Kun_Saga_Persistence_SagaState_Running).

### Classes

[EfSagaInstanceStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence-ef/efsagainstancestore.md)

EF Core-backed implementation of [ISagaInstanceStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/isagainstancestore.md).
Operates against `saga_instances` and `saga_step_queue` tables
via `DbContext.Set<T>`.

[KunSagaDbContextExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence-ef/kunsagadbcontextextensions.md)

Extension methods for [`ModelBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.modelbuilder) to apply Kun Saga entity configurations.
Call [KunSagaDbContextExtensions.ApplyKunSagaConfiguration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence-ef/kunsagadbcontextextensions.md#Kun_Saga_Persistence_Ef_KunSagaDbContextExtensions_ApplyKunSagaConfiguration_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_ModelBuilder_) from your `DbContext.OnModelCreating`
override to register `saga_instances` and `saga_step_queue` tables.

[SagaInstanceConfiguration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence-ef/sagainstanceconfiguration.md)

EF Core entity type configuration for [SagaInstance](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/sagainstance.md).

### Classes

[SagaStepQueueEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga-persistence/sagastepqueueentry.md)

A queued work item representing a single step execution or compensation for a saga.
The background `SagaStepExecutor` polls this table and processes entries in order.
ORM mapping lives in `SagaStepQueueEntryConfiguration` — no ORM attributes here.

Implementations are responsible for durable storage and querying of saga lifecycle data.

```csharp
public enum SagaState
```

## Fields

`Compensated = 3`

All compensation steps completed after a forward failure.

`Compensating = 1`

A step failed and the saga is executing compensation steps in reverse order.

`Completed = 2`

All forward steps completed successfully.

`Failed = 4`

The saga failed and compensation itself encountered an unrecoverable error.
Manual intervention is required.

`Running = 0`

The saga is executing its forward steps.

### StartAsync \{#Kun_Saga_SagaRegistration_StartAsync}

Starts a new saga instance. Captures `TSaga` and `TContext` at registration
time, so no reflection is required at call time.
Parameters: (contextJson, store, clock, serviceProvider, cancellationToken) → sagaId
The context is passed as the typed object (boxed as [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/reference-types)).
The [`IServiceProvider`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iserviceprovider) is used to resolve the saga's step-0 timeout via
[SagaRegistration.GetStepTimeout](/sdk/api/kun/kun-saga/sagaregistration.md#Kun_Saga_SagaRegistration_GetStepTimeout) so that `SagaInstance.TimeoutAt` reflects the actual
per-step timeout rather than an arbitrary default.

## Methods

### RunAsync(string\[], ProcessRunOptions?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_IProcesses_RunAsync_System_String___Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ProcessRunOptions_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Runs a command inside the sandbox synchronously and returns its
aggregated [ProcessResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/processresult.md) when it exits (or the
process is killed by timeout).

```csharp
Task<ProcessResult> RunAsync(string[] command, ProcessRunOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`command` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)\[]

The command to run. When supplied as a single string it is
interpreted by the sandbox shell; when supplied as an argv array
it is exec'd directly. The array form is preferred because it
does not require shell quoting.

`options` [ProcessRunOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/processrunoptions.md)?

Per-call options (cwd / envs / timeout / stdin).

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token for the run.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[ProcessResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/processresult.md)>

Exit code, stdout, stderr, duration, truncation flag.

### RunAsync(string, ProcessRunOptions?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_IProcesses_RunAsync_System_String_Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ProcessRunOptions_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Convenience overload accepting a single shell command string.
Equivalent to invoking [IProcesses.RunAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/iprocesses.md#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_IProcesses_RunAsync_System_String___Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ProcessRunOptions_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)
with `["/bin/sh", "-c", command]`; backends are free to
interpret the string natively for efficiency.

```csharp
Task<ProcessResult> RunAsync(string command, ProcessRunOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

`command` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

# Interface ISandboxHandle

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Sandbox` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Sandbox`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Sandbox)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Sandbox.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Sandbox.dll

Handle to a running sandbox. Exposes process and file sub-APIs that
map one-to-one to E2B v2's `processes` and `files`
endpoints, plus a [ISandboxHandle.KillAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxhandle.md#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ISandboxHandle_KillAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) operation that maps to
`DELETE /v2/sandboxes/{id}`.

```csharp
public interface ISandboxHandle
```

## Remarks

The handle is logically [`IAsyncDisposable`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iasyncdisposable)-shaped — but
we intentionally do **not** implement the interface because disposal
semantics are not equivalent across backends (e.g. in-memory does
nothing, Supervisor does a best-effort DELETE, E2B Cloud may bill
partial seconds). Callers explicitly call [ISandboxHandle.KillAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxhandle.md#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ISandboxHandle_KillAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

# Interface ISandboxProvider

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Sandbox` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Sandbox`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Sandbox)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Sandbox.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Sandbox.dll

Pluggable sandbox backend. Creates an [ISandboxHandle](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxhandle.md)
that represents a short-lived isolated execution environment.

```csharp
public interface ISandboxProvider
```

## Remarks

The contract is deliberately aligned with the E2B v2 `POST /v2/sandboxes`
API so that consumers can swap between the in-memory fake, the
configured supervisor, and the E2B Cloud backend (Mode D)
without changing the portable call surface.

## Methods

Creates a new sandbox with the supplied options and returns a
handle for process / file operations. The sandbox is `running`
when the task completes.


Namespace: [Kun.Sandbox.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Sandbox.dll

Lifecycle states exposed by [ISandboxHandle.State](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxhandle.md#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ISandboxHandle_State). Matches the E2B v2 shape.

```csharp
public enum SandboxState
```

## Fields

`Creating = 1`

Backend has accepted the create request; container is not yet ready.

`Failed = 4`

Backend reported a failure during the sandbox lifetime.

`Killed = 3`

Sandbox was torn down via [ISandboxHandle.KillAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxhandle.md#Kun_Sandbox_Abstractions_ISandboxHandle_KillAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) or because its timeout elapsed.

`Running = 2`

Container is ready; processes can run.

`TimedOut = 5`

Sandbox was terminated because it exceeded its `timeoutMs`.

`Unknown = 0`

Default value; should not appear on a returned handle.

## Remarks

This provider corresponds to the future cloud backend mode — "delegate sandbox execution to E2B Cloud, Supervisor acts as
an auth + extension-layer proxy". Mode D is explicitly **Phase 2+**
and is not scoped for the current milestone. Do not fill in the
implementation here as a drive-by; it requires workspace-sync design,
secret-injection policy, and a separate ADR update.

本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Sandbox` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Sandbox`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Sandbox)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[E2BCloudSandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-implementations/e2bcloudsandboxprovider.md)

Placeholder [ISandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxprovider.md) targeting E2B Cloud
(`https://api.e2b.dev`). The constructor signature is fixed so
DI wiring can be exercised in tests and reviewed in PRs, but every
method throws [`NotImplementedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notimplementedexception).

[InMemorySandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-implementations/inmemorysandboxprovider.md)

In-process fake [ISandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxprovider.md) for unit tests and
local dev loops. Does not run anything: `processes.run` returns
a scripted [ProcessResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/processresult.md) and file APIs operate on a
[`ConcurrentDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.concurrent.concurrentdictionary-2). Clearly labelled
"test only" so no-one accidentally wires it into production.

[SupervisorSandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-implementations/supervisorsandboxprovider.md)

Production [ISandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxprovider.md) that talks to the
configured supervisor's `/v2/sandboxes/*` endpoints.
The HTTP client is supplied by
the caller — typically via [`IHttpClientFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.ihttpclientfactory)
— so delegating handlers can attach S2S JWT, mTLS client cert, and
OpenTelemetry instrumentation without this class knowing about them.

# Class InMemorySandboxProvider

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Sandbox` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Sandbox`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Sandbox)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Sandbox.Implementations](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-implementations/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Sandbox.dll

In-process fake [ISandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxprovider.md) for unit tests and
local dev loops. Does not run anything: `processes.run` returns
a scripted [ProcessResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/processresult.md) and file APIs operate on a
[`ConcurrentDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.concurrent.concurrentdictionary-2). Clearly labelled
"test only" so no-one accidentally wires it into production.

```csharp
public sealed class InMemorySandboxProvider : ISandboxProvider
```

# Class SupervisorSandboxProvider

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Sandbox` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Sandbox`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Sandbox)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Assembly: Kun.Sandbox.dll

Production [ISandboxProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-sandbox-abstractions/isandboxprovider.md) that talks to the
configured supervisor's `/v2/sandboxes/*` endpoints.
The HTTP client is supplied by
the caller — typically via [`IHttpClientFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.ihttpclientfactory)
— so delegating handlers can attach S2S JWT, mTLS client cert, and
OpenTelemetry instrumentation without this class knowing about them.

## Methods

### AddKunSecurity(IServiceCollection) \{#Kun_Security_DependencyInjection_KunSecurityServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunSecurity_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection\_}

Registers Kun Security services:

- [`IHttpContextAccessor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.ihttpcontextaccessor) (if not already registered)
- Singleton [ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md) → [AsyncLocalTenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy/asynclocaltenantcontext.md)，JWT 仅作解析源
- Scoped [ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md) → [JwtCurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-security/jwtcurrentuser.md)

Call `AddAuthentication().AddKunServiceAuthentication(...)` separately to configure
JWT Bearer validation.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunSecurity(this IServiceCollection services)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same [`IServiceCollection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection) for chaining.

### AddKunServiceAuth(IHttpClientBuilder) \{#Kun_Security_Extensions_HttpClientBuilderExtensions_AddKunServiceAuth_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IHttpClientBuilder\_}

Chains [PropagateS2sTokenHandler](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-http/propagates2stokenhandler.md) onto the HTTP client pipeline,
so the S2S JWT from the current incoming request is forwarded to downstream services.

### Classes

[PropagateS2sTokenHandler](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-http/propagates2stokenhandler.md)

A [`DelegatingHandler`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.delegatinghandler) that copies the `Authorization` header
from the current incoming HTTP request to all outgoing requests made by the
[`HttpClient`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.httpclient) it is attached to.
This propagates the S2S JWT transparently across service boundaries.

# Class FileKunJwksProvider

Assembly: Kun.Security.dll

Loads a JSON Web Key Set from a local file and caches it in memory.
The cache is invalidated when the file's last-write time changes, enabling
key rotation without service restart.

### Classes

[JwksEndpointExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/jwksendpointextensions.md)

Extension methods for registering the S2S JWKS endpoint middleware.

[JwksEndpointMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/jwksendpointmiddleware.md)

ASP.NET Core middleware that serves the JWKS at `/.well-known/jwks.json`.
Includes both the current and previous signing keys (for graceful rotation).

[KunSecurityS2SJwtServiceCollectionExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/kunsecuritys2sjwtservicecollectionextensions.md)

Extension methods for registering Kun S2S JWT issuer and verifier services.

[S2SJwtIssueRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/s2sjwtissuerequest.md)

Input for [IS2SJwtIssuer.IssueAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/is2sjwtissuer.md#Kun_Security_S2SJwt_IS2SJwtIssuer_IssueAsync_Kun_Security_S2SJwt_S2SJwtIssueRequest_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).
Carries the full SAD v3.0 §12 legacy S2S claim set.

[S2SJwtIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/s2sjwtissuer.md)

ES256 implementation of [IS2SJwtIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/is2sjwtissuer.md). Emits the SAD v3.0 §12 claim
set (`sub`, `tenant_id`, `roles`, optional `membership_id`,
optional `project_id`, optional `trace_id`) and retains the pre-existing
`scope` / `session_id` claims for OAuth2-style callers.

[S2SJwtOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/s2sjwtoptions.md)

Configuration for S2S JWT issuance and verification using ES256 (ECDSA P-256).
Per the zero-trust policy, ES256 is the required algorithm for legacy S2S tokens.

[S2SJwtVerifier](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/s2sjwtverifier.md)

Verifies S2S JWT tokens using ES256 and the configured signing keys.
Supports key rotation by accepting both current and previous signing keys.

### Interfaces

[IS2SJwtIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/is2sjwtissuer.md)

Issues S2S JWT tokens signed with ES256 for internal service-to-service authentication.

[IS2SJwtVerifier](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-s2sjwt/is2sjwtverifier.md)

Verifies S2S JWT tokens issued by the gateway.

Configuration for S2S JWT issuance and verification using ES256 (ECDSA P-256).
Per the zero-trust policy, ES256 is the required algorithm for legacy S2S tokens.

# Class S2SJwtVerifier

Verifies S2S JWT tokens using ES256 and the configured signing keys.
Supports key rotation by accepting both current and previous signing keys.

# Class ContentDispositionPolicy

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Storage)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.Storage.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.dll

Policy for deciding when browsers must be forced to download (rather than render)
a stored object. Active-web MIME types (HTML/SVG/XML/JS/WASM) are served back as
`attachment` so that user-uploaded content cannot execute in the origin of
the download domain.

```csharp

```

# Interface IFileStorage

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Storage)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Storage.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.dll

Abstraction for object-storage operations. Supports multiple backends
(local filesystem, S3, MinIO) behind a uniform contract.

```csharp
[Obsolete("请引用 Kun.Storage.Abstractions 包里的 Kun.Storage.IFileStorage；旧包仅保留兼容。", DiagnosticId = "KUNLEGACY001")]
public interface IFileStorage
```

## Remarks

Implementations must enforce [ContentDispositionPolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/contentdispositionpolicy.md) on uploads
and presigned download URLs, so that browsers never render user-uploaded
active-web types (HTML, SVG, XML, JavaScript, WASM) inline.

## Methods

### CreatePresignedDownloadUrlAsync(string, PresignedDownloadRequest, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Abstractions_IFileStorage_CreatePresignedDownloadUrlAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_Abstractions_PresignedDownloadRequest_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Generates a short-lived URL that the client can use to download an object directly.

```csharp
Task<PresignedDownloadUrl> CreatePresignedDownloadUrlAsync(string path, PresignedDownloadRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default)
```

#### Parameters

`path` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

`request` [PresignedDownloadRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/presigneddownloadrequest.md)

`ct` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[PresignedDownloadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/presigneddownloadurl.md)>

#### Remarks

If the stored object's content-type is in [ContentDispositionPolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/contentdispositionpolicy.md)'s
unsafe-for-inline-display list and the request did not already specify
[PresignedDownloadRequest.ResponseContentDisposition](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-abstractions/presigneddownloadrequest.md#Kun_Storage_Abstractions_PresignedDownloadRequest_ResponseContentDisposition), implementations
MUST override the response disposition to force `attachment`.

Policy for deciding when browsers must be forced to download (rather than render)

## Remarks

Metadata (content-type, disposition, user metadata) is persisted in a sidecar
file alongside each object with the `.kunmeta` suffix.

**Not for production.** Presigned URLs use the opaque
`kun-local://` scheme signed with HMAC-SHA256; they must be mediated by
a dev-only middleware that validates the signature before serving bytes.

#### Remarks

MUST override the response disposition to force `attachment`.

### PublicBaseUrl \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileStorageOptions_PublicBaseUrl}

Base URL prefix used to build presigned URLs. The host app must expose an HTTP
endpoint at this prefix that streams files from [LocalFileStorageOptions.RootPath](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-local/localfilestorageoptions.md#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileStorageOptions_RootPath). The
final URL shape is `{PublicBaseUrl}/{objectKey}?expires=…&disposition=…`.

```csharp
public Uri PublicBaseUrl { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

Uri

### RootPath \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileStorageOptions_RootPath}

Root directory on the local filesystem where objects are stored. Absolute path.
The directory is created if it does not exist at first use.


[IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md) implementation that stores objects on the local filesystem.
Intended for development, tests, and single-node deployments. Presigned URLs are
developer-visible query-string-token URLs — validation is host responsibility.

### GetPresignedDownloadAsync(string, DownloadOptions?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedDownloadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can use to download the object directly
from the backing store. The URL MUST include `Content-Disposition: attachment`
when the stored content type is an active web content type (see remarks on
[IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md)).

```csharp
public Task<PresignedDownloadUrl> GetPresignedDownloadAsync(string objectKey, DownloadOptions? options = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`options` DownloadOptions?

Optional download behavior (download-name override, custom response headers).

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window for the presigned URL.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedDownloadUrl>

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedPostUpload> GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string objectKey, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Target object key.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedPostUpload>

#### Remarks

Not supported on the local-filesystem implementation: signing a POST policy is an
S3-specific construct with no meaningful analogue for a developer-local store.
Callers that need dev-time presigned uploads should use
[LocalFileSystemStorage.GetPresignedUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-local/localfilesystemstorage.md#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_);
callers that need MaxBytes-in-signature enforcement must swap to `Kun.Storage.S3`
against an S3-compatible endpoint (e.g. MinIO for dev).

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned
record carries the exact HTTP headers the caller must send so server-side
constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Size / content-type policy enforced by the URL signature.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

### ListAsync(string?, int, string?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_ListAsync_System_String_System_Int32_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

### OpenReadAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_OpenReadAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Opens a readable stream over the object's content for server-side reads (e.g.
computing a content diff). The caller MUST dispose the returned stream.

```csharp
public Task<Stream> OpenReadAsync(string objectKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[Stream](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.stream)>

#### Remarks

Optional capability. Backends that only expose presigned URLs leave the default,
which throws [`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) — callers should treat that as
"server-side read unavailable" and degrade (e.g. metadata-only diff). Overriding
implementations SHOULD throw [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception) when the object is missing.

### UploadAsync(string, Stream, string, UploadConstraints?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_UploadAsync_System_String_System_IO_Stream_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

# Class OssFileStorage

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage.Oss` 2026.10.25 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage.Oss`](https://github.com/idadawn/kun/tree/v2026.10.25/src/Kun.Storage.Oss)（`v2026.10.25`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；Qian 对 Kun 的选用与约束见[与 Qian 的关系](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.Storage.Oss](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-oss/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.Oss.dll

Alibaba Cloud OSS implementation of [IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md) using the native
`Aliyun.OSS.SDK.NetCore` client.

```csharp
public sealed class OssFileStorage : IFileStorage
```

#### Inheritance

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

**Why native and not the S3-compatible path:** OSS exposes an S3-compatible surface, but
its presigned URLs are validated with OSS's own signature algorithm — not AWS SigV4. An AWS
SDK client pointed at an OSS endpoint emits SigV4-signed URLs that OSS rejects, so presigned
upload/download (the core of this contract) does not work over `Kun.Storage.S3`. This
type therefore wraps the native SDK and is the supported way to target OSS.

**Security guarantee (M1):** [OssFileStorage.GetPresignedDownloadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-oss/ossfilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_GetPresignedDownloadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) ALWAYS sets
`response-content-disposition=attachment` on the signed URL when the stored object's
content type is one of [ActiveWebContentTypes.Value](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/activewebcontenttypes.md#Kun_Storage_ActiveWebContentTypes_Value), regardless of
[DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

**Async posture:** the Aliyun SDK exposes only synchronous and APM (Begin/End) operations,
no TAP. Network calls are offloaded with [`Run`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task.run--1)
so callers keep an async surface; the token cancels queueing, not an in-flight OSS request.
Presigned-URL generation is pure local signing (no I/O) and completes synchronously.

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the

content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

limits are baked into the policy.

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned

constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

`application/xhtml+xml`, `application/xml`. This holds regardless of whether
the caller sets [DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

```csharp

```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Target object key.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned

constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

which throws [`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) — callers should treat that as

implementations SHOULD throw [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception) when the object is missing.
